error-csv-schema: CSV (Indangagaciro Zitandukanyijwe n'Akitso)/TSV (Indangagaciro Zitandukanyijwe na Tab) yawe ntabwo irimo amakuru akwiye mu miterere iboneye
error-import-empty-board: Iyi dosiye yasohowe nta bikubiyemo by'ikibaho ifite (nta mirongo, ntonde cyangwa makarita). Ishobora kuba yarakozwe n'integuro ya kera ya WeKan yari ifite ikosa rizwi ryo gusohora. Ongera usohore ikibaho ukoresheje integuro iriho maze winjize dosiye nshya.
error-linked-card-not-allowed: Ushobora guhuza gusa n'ikarita isanzwe. Guhuza n'indi karita ihujwe, cyangwa n'ikarita ihuza igaruka kuri iki kibaho, ntibyemewe kuko byatuma amakarita adashobora kugerwaho.
export-card-excel-fields: Hitamo imirima yo gushyira mu gusohora kwa Excel:
export-card-excel-no-disk-space: Ntibishoboka gusohora muri Excel: nta mwanya uhagije uri kuri disiki
user-can-not-export-card-to-pdf: Ukoresha ntashobora gusohora ikarita muri PDF
user-can-not-export-card-to-excel: Ukoresha ntashobora gusohora ikarita muri Excel
filter-date-range-invalid: Hitamo amatariki nyayo; itariki ya nyuma igomba kuba imwe n'iyo gutangira cyangwa ikaza nyuma yayo.
filter-due-any: Itariki iyo ari yo yose ntarengwa (harimo n'adafite itariki)
filter-column-age-disabled: Ntuhishe ukurikije igihe ikarita imaze mu rutonde
filter-column-age-hint: Hisha amakarita yinjiye muri uru rutonde hashize iminsi irenga uyu mubare. Izindi ntonde n'amakarita afite amatariki yo kwinjira atazwi bikomeza kugaragara. Guhindura ikarita ntibituma igihe imaze mu rutonde gitangira bundi bushya.
filter-on-desc: Urimo gushungura amakarita kuri iki kibaho. Kanda hano kugira uhindure akayunguruzo.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Shungura amatariki y'amakarita ukoresheje @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt cyangwa @listEnteredAt. Urugero: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' cyangwa @endAt = none. Shyira izina ry'umwanya wihariye ritangirwa na @ hagati y'utwuguruzo n'utwugarizo.
advanced-filter-description: Akayunguruzo Gateye Imbere kagufasha kwandika inyandiko irimo abakoresha bakurikira: == != <= >= && || ( ) Umwanya ukoreshwa nk'igitandukanya hagati y'Abakoresha. Ushobora gushungura Imirima Yihariye yose wandika amazina n'indangagaciro byayo. Urugero: Field1 == Value1. Icyitonderwa: Niba imirima cyangwa indangagaciro birimo imyanya, ugomba kubishyira hagati y'utwuguruzo tumwe. Urugero: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Kugira ibimenyetso bigenzura kimwe (' \/) bisimbukwe, ushobora gukoresha \. Urugero: Field1 == I\'m. Ushobora kandi guhuza ibisabwa byinshi. Urugero: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Ubusanzwe abakoresha bose basobanurwa kuva ibumoso bajya iburyo. Ushobora guhindura urutonde ushyiraho udukubo. Urugero: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ushobora kandi gushakisha imirima y'inyandiko ukoresheje regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Bihura igihe ikarita iremwe, cyangwa umutwe wayo cyangwa ibisobanuro byayo bihinduwe, kandi umwandiko mushya ukubiyemo ibi (inyuguti nini n'intoya ntibitaho).
imported-member-no-account: Umunyamuryango winjijwe — nta konti ihuye na we
impersonate-emergency: Kwinjira byihutirwa: menyesha ubu abandi bayobozi bose
email-emergency-access-text:
__admin__ yakoresheje kwinjira byihutirwa kugira ngo yinjire nka __user__ kuri __url__ ku wa __time__.

Impamvu: __note__

Ibyakozwe byose muri icyo gihe biri muri Ubuyobozi / Abantu / Igitabo cy'igenzura na Ibibazo / Raporo yo kwiyitirira.
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Nimanika JSON yasohowe na Kanboard: ikintu gifite "columns" (cyangwa ibikorwa bifite column_name) n'urutonde rwa "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Inkingi ziba intonde, ibikorwa bikaba amakarita.
import-board-instruction-deck: Nimanika JSON y'ikibaho cya NextCloud Deck (ikibaho gifite "stacks", buri stack ifite "cards" zayo). Stacks ziba intonde, cards zikaba amakarita.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Nimanika JSON y'ikusanyirizo rya work-packages rya OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses ziba intonde, work packages zikaba amakarita.
import-board-instruction-issues: Nimanika urutonde JSON rw'ibibazo bya __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Ibibazo biba amakarita ashyizwe mu ntonde Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Nimanika JSON yasohowe y'ibikorwa bya Asana ({ "data": [...] } ivuye mu gusohora kwa Asana cyangwa GET /tasks). Ibikorwa bishyirwa mu bice (memberships); ibyuzuye bijya muri Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Nimanika JSON yasohowe y'urutonde rwa ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages ziba intonde, items zikaba amakarita.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Nimanika urutonde rw'imirimo rwa markdown (uburyo ibikoresho bya markdown-kanban nka Obsidian Kanban bikoresha): imitwe "## Izina ry'urutonde", hamwe n'ibintu "- [ ]"/"- [x]" munsi yayo. Imitwe iba intonde kandi ibintu bikaba amakarita; urutonde rusanzwe rw'utudomo rudafite utuzu two guhitamo na rwo rurinjizwa, nk'amakarita afunguye.
import-board-instruction-leo: Omekaho imiterere ya Leo (dosiye .leo). Ibice byo ku rwego rwo hejuru bihinduka intonde, ibice bibikomokaho ku rwego rukurikira bigahinduka amakarita, kandi inyandiko y'igice ikaba ibisobanuro by'ikarita. Ibice biri ku nzego zimbitse kurushaho bihinduka intonde zo kugenzura. Ibice byashyizweho ikimenyetso byinjizwa nk'ibyarangiye.
import-board-instruction-opml: Shyiramo incamake ya OPML, nk'uko Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq n'izindi porogaramu z'incamake ziyisohora. Ibintu byo hejuru biba intonde, ibibikomokaho biba amakarita afite inyandiko nk'ibisobanuro, naho ibintu byimbitse kurushaho biba intonde zo kugenzura. Ibintu byarangiye byinjizwa nk'ibyakozwe.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Shyiramo dosiye ya Org mode, nk'uko Emacs, Orgzly cyangwa Beorg ziyandika. Imitwe yo ku rwego rwa mbere iba intonde naho imitwe yo ku rwego rwa kabiri iba amakarita. TODO na DONE, ibyihutirwa, ibimenyetso, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE na CLOSED birabikwa, naho udusanduku two gutoranya n'imitwe yimbitse kurushaho biba intonde zo kugenzura.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Komeka dosiye ya todo.txt: umurimo umwe kuri buri murongo, nk'uko porogaramu ya todo.txt n'izindi zijyanye na yo zibyandika. Imirimo yarangiye ("x") ijya mu Yarangiye, +project na @context bihinduka ibirango, (A) ihinduka ikirango cy'ibyihutirwa, naho due: na t: bigahinduka amatariki ntarengwa n'ayo gutangira.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Shyiramo ibisohoka muri task export: urutonde rwa JSON cyangwa igikorwa kimwe kuri buri murongo. Ibikorwa byarangiye bijya muri Done, project na priority bihinduka ibirango, annotations ihinduka ibitekerezo, naho depends ihinduka ukwishingikiriza ku bikorwa bibibuza gukomeza.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Fungura dosiye ya .boardarchive uyikure mu bubiko butsindagiye, hanyuma ushyiremo ibiri muri board.jsonl y’ikibaho, hamwe n’umurongo wa verisiyo cyangwa utawushyizemo. Ikiranga cyo gushyira mu matsinda mu isura y’ikibaho gihinduka intonde, ibindi biranga byo guhitamo bigahinduka ibirango, ibice by’inyandiko n’udusanduku two gushyiraho akamenyetso bigahinduka ibisobanuro n’urutonde rwo kugenzura, kandi ibitekerezo bikagumaho. Amashusho n’imigereka ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-azuredevops: Muri Azure DevOps, fungura Boards, hanyuma Queries, koresha ikibazo kigaragaza inkingi ushaka, uhitemo Export to CSV; hanyuma uhitemo iyo dosiye ya .csv. Board Column (cyangwa State) ihinduka intonde, Board Lane igahinduka imirongo; ibintu by'akazi bihinduka amakarita hamwe n'ubwoko bwabyo na tags nk'ibirango, Assigned To, amatariki, ibisobanuro n'umubyeyi, izindi nkingi zigahinduka imyanya yihariye.
import-board-instruction-mslists: Muri Microsoft Lists, fungura urutonde, uhitemo Export, hanyuma Export to CSV, uhitemo iyo dosiye ya .csv. Inkingi ya Status (cyangwa Progress) ihinduka intonde, buri kintu kigahinduka ikarita, n'umutwe wacyo, ibisobanuro, abantu, amatariki na tags; izindi nkingi zihinduka imyanya yihariye.
import-board-instruction-msproject: Muri Microsoft Project, hitamo File, hanyuma Save As, n'ubwoko XML Format (*.xml), uhitemo iyo dosiye. Ibikorwa by'incamake bihinduka imirongo, ibikorwa bigahinduka amakarita muri Not started, In progress cyangwa Completed, n'amatariki yabyo, inyandiko, ibikoresho, ibikorwa bito n'ibibibanziriza.
import-board-instruction-outlook: Muri Outlook, kurura ubutumwa ubushyire mu bubiko kuri mudasobwa yawe, cyangwa ububike ukoresheje File, hanyuma Save As, nka Outlook Message Format (*.msg). Hitamo dosiye imwe ya .msg, cyangwa .zip y'amadosiye ya .msg na .eml. Buri kiganiro gihinduka ikarita muri Board View / Email, ibisubizo byacyo bikaba ibitekerezo n'imigereka ikaba amadosiye.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Muri MeisterTask, kanda ku izina ry'umushinga, hitamo Export project hanyuma usohore CSV, maze uyishyiremo. Ibice biba intonde naho imirimo iba amakarita, hamwe n'inyandiko zayo, itariki ntarengwa, uwahawe akazi n'ibimenyetso; imirimo yarangiye igumana itariki yarangiriyeho. CSV yandikiwe kwinjizwa muri MeisterTask nayo irakora.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Muri Obsidian, fungura dosiye y'ikibaho cya Kanban nka Markdown (cyangwa ufungure dosiye .md mu mwanditsi w'umwandiko), hanyuma uyishyiremo yose. Inzira ziba intonde zifite imipaka y'amakarita yazo, amakarita agumana ibimenyetso, amatariki, icyihutirwa, imyanya n'urutonde rwo kugenzura, naho Archive iba amakarita ari mu Bubiko.
import-board-instruction-linear: Muri Linear, sohora ibibazo nka CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, cyangwa isohora ry'igaragaza), hanyuma ushyiremo CSV. Imiterere iba intonde, amatsinda aba imirongo, naho ibibazo biba amakarita hamwe n'uwahawe akazi, ibirango, amatariki, ikibazo kibikomokaho, icyihutirwa, igereranya, umushinga n'icyiciro.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Muri TickTick, fungura Settings, Account, Backup & Import maze ukore ububiko bw'inyunganizi, hanyuma ushyiremo dosiye ya CSV. Buri rutonde rwa TickTick ruba umurongo naho inkingi zarwo ziba intonde; imirimo igumana ibimenyetso, amatariki, urutonde rwo kugenzura, icyihutirwa n'ibikorwa bito.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Muri ClickUp, sohora imirimo nka CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, cyangwa isohora ry'igaragaza rya List cyangwa Table rifite inkingi zose), hanyuma ushyiremo CSV. Imiterere iba intonde, intonde za ClickUp ziba imirongo, naho imirimo iba amakarita hamwe n'ibikorwa bito, abahawe akazi, ibimenyetso, amatariki, icyihutirwa n'igihe.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Muri Nullboard, fungura ikibaho, hitamo Export this board... muri menu, fungura dosiye .nbx mu mwanditsi w'umwandiko maze ushyiremo ibiyirimo. Intonde ziba intonde naho inyandiko ziba amakarita: umurongo wa mbere w'inyandiko ni umutwe w'ikarita naho ibisigaye ni ibisobanuro byayo. Inyandiko mbisi ihabwa ikirango raw. Dosiye ifite ibibaho byinshi yinjiza ikibaho cyayo cya mbere.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Muri Kanri, fungura Import & Export maze uhitemo Export individual board (cyangwa Export all data), hanyuma ushyiremo dosiye .json. Inkingi ziba intonde naho amakarita aba amakarita, hamwe n'ibisobanuro, itariki ntarengwa, ibimenyetso n'amabara; imirimo y'ikarita iba urutonde rwo kugenzura. Mu isohora ry'amakuru yose, ikibaho cya mbere ni cyo cyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-planka: Andika aderesi ya Planka yawe (urugero https://planka.example.com), izina ry'ukoresha n'ijambobanga rya Planka, hanyuma ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa». Bikoreshwa gusa mu kuzana ikibaho kandi ntibibikwa. Hitamo ikibaho hanyuma ukande «Zana»: WeKan igisoma ivanye kuri API ya Planka hamwe n'intonde zacyo, amakarita, ibisobanuro, amatariki ntarengwa, ibirango, abanyamuryango, intonde z'imirimo n'ibitekerezo, hanyuma ukomeze kwinjiza nk'uko bisanzwe. Amakarita ari mu bubiko bwa Planka yinjizwa nk'ayashyizwe mu bubiko; imigereka n'amakarita ari mu myanda ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Muri Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), injira, wemere uruhushya rwa Tasks.Read hanyuma wigane token uvuye ku gice cya Access token. Yishyire hano hanyuma ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa»; token ikoreshwa gusa muri uku kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Hitamo intonde zose cyangwa rumwe hanyuma ukande «Zana». Buri rutonde rwa To Do ruhinduka urutonde na buri murimo ugahinduka ikarita, hamwe n'inyandiko, amatariki ntarengwa n'ayo gutangira, intambwe nk'urutonde rwo kugenzura, ibyiciro nk'ibirango, akamaro kanini n'imiterere nk'ibirango; imirimo yarangiye ishyirwa mu bubiko. Ibyibutsa n'isubiramo ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-onenote: Muri Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), injira, wemere uruhushya rwa Notes.Read hanyuma wandukure token mu gice cya Access token. Uyomeke hano ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa»; token ikoreshwa kuri iri zana gusa kandi ntibikwa. Hitamo ikayi y'inyandiko ukande «Zana». Ibice bihinduka intonde, impapuro zigahinduka amakarita, n'inyandiko zazo, udusanduku tw'ibyo gukora nk'urutonde rwo kugenzura n'impapuro nto nk'ibikorwa bito.
import-board-instruction-teams: Omeka token yo kwinjira ya Microsoft Graph ifite Chat.Read (ivuye muri Graph Explorer, konti y'akazi cyangwa y'ishuri) ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa», hanyuma uhitemo ikiganiro cyangwa umuyoboro ukande «Zana»; token ntibikwa. Cyangwa uhitemo dosiye: .tar y'ibyo wohereje byawe bwite kuri teams.live.com/dataexport, cyangwa .json y'ubutumwa bw'ikiganiro. Buri kiganiro gihinduka ikarita muri Board View / Chat, ubutumwa bwacyo bukaba ibitekerezo.
import-board-instruction-sandstorm: Muri Sandstorm, fungura grain ya __app__, uhitemo "Download backup" mu murongo wo hejuru wa grain, maze uhitemo iyo dosiye ya .zip. Ibiri muri grain bihinduka ikibaho, ibintu byayo bigahinduka amakarita hamwe n'ibyo porogaramu ibika kuri byo. Hitamo porogaramu grain ari iyayo: grain ya porogaramu indi iranwa, kandi ivuga iyo porogaramu iyo ari yo.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Muri KanbanFlow, fungura menu y'ikibaho, hitamo Settings → API & Webhooks hanyuma wigane token ya API y'ikibaho. Shyira token hano, ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa», uhitemo ikibaho hanyuma ukande «Zana»; token ikoreshwa gusa muri uko kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Inkingi zihinduka intonde, imirongo ikaguma imirongo; imirimo igumana ibisobanuro, ibara, ibirango, itariki ntarengwa, imirimo mito nk'urutonde rwo kugenzura, igihe cyakoreshejwe, igereranya, abantu n'ibitekerezo.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Andika ID ya konti yawe ya Basecamp (umubare uri nyuma ya basecamp.com/ muri aderesi) na token yo kwinjira (ivuye kuri porogaramu ya OAuth 2 yanditswe kuri launchpad.37signals.com, cyangwa iyo uguhuza gusanzwe gufite), ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa», uhitemo umushinga hanyuma ukande «Zana». Token ikoreshwa gusa muri uko kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Buri mbonerahamwe y'amakarita ihinduka umurongo n'inkingi zayo nk'intonde, intonde z'ibyo gukora zigahinduka umurongo «To-dos»; amakarita n'ibyo gukora bigumana inyandiko, amatariki, abashinzwe n'ibitekerezo, intambwe z'ikarita zihinduka urutonde rwo kugenzura, ibyarangiye bigashyirwa mu bubiko.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Bona token yo kwinjira kuri OAuth 2.0 Playground: munsi ya Tasks API v1 hitamo tasks.readonly, kanda Authorize APIs, hanyuma Exchange authorization code for tokens, wigane token yo kwinjira. Yishyire hano hanyuma ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa», uhitemo intonde z'imirimo zose cyangwa rumwe, hanyuma «Zana». Token ikoreshwa gusa muri uku kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Intonde z'imirimo zihinduka intonde, imirimo ikaba amakarita, hamwe n'inyandiko, imiyoboro n'itariki ntarengwa; imirimo mito ihinduka urutonde rwo kugenzura, imirimo yarangiye ikinjizwa nk'iyashyizwe mu bubiko.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API ya Google Keep ni iya konti za Google Workspace gusa. Bona token yo kwinjira ya OAuth 2.0 ifite urwego https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (muri OAuth 2.0 Playground niba umuyobozi wa Workspace yawe abyemera, cyangwa ivuye kuri konti ya serivisi ifite uburenganzira ku rubuga rwose), uyishyire, ukande «Erekana ibishobora kwinjizwa» hanyuma «Zana». Token ikoreshwa gusa muri uku kuzana kandi ntibikwa. Inyandiko z'amagambo zihinduka amakarita mu rutonde «Notes», inyandiko z'urutonde rwo kugenzura zigahinduka amakarita mu rutonde «Lists» n'ibintu byazo nk'urutonde rwo kugenzura. Inyandiko ziri mu myanda, imigereka no gusangira ntibyinjizwa.
api-import-desc: Bizane uvuye kuri serivisi ukoresheje konti yawe bwite. Ibyo wanditse hano bikoreshwa gusa muri uku kuzana kandi ntibibikwa.
api-import-fetched: Byazanywe. Reba abanyamuryango bari hepfo hanyuma winjize.
api-import-nothing: Nta kintu cyo kwinjiza kiri kuri iyi konti.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Muri Pivotal Tracker, fungura agace MORE k'umushinga maze uhitemo Export CSV (cyangwa uhitemo inkuru maze uhitemo Bulk Actions, CSV), hanyuma ushyiremo CSV. Buri miterere y'inkuru iba urutonde naho inkuru ziba amakarita, hamwe n'ubwoko n'ibirango, ba nyirabyo, uwabisabye, amatariki, ibitekerezo, imirimo n'ibibangamira; Estimate iba Story points naho iterations ziba sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Muri Tasks.org, fungura Settings, Backups maze uhitemo Export tasks, hanyuma ushyiremo ibiri muri iyo dosiye .json. Intonde ziba intonde naho imirimo iba amakarita, hamwe n'inyandiko, ibimenyetso, amatariki, ibitekerezo n'ibikorwa bito; imirimo yarangiye igumana itariki yarangiriyeho, naho icyihutirwa kiba umwanya wihariye.
import-board-instruction-monday: Muri monday.com, fungura menu y'ikibaho, hitamo More actions na Export board to Excel (hamwe n'amakuru mashya n'ibice bito niba ubishaka), hanyuma uhitemo iyo dosiye .xlsx. Inkingi ya Status iba intonde naho amatsinda aba imirongo; abantu, amatariki, igihe ngengabihe n'ibimenyetso bigumana imyanya yabyo, izindi nkingi ziba imyanya yihariye naho amakuru mashya aba ibitekerezo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Muri Super Productivity, fungura Settings, hanyuma Sync & Backup, hitamo Export Data maze ushyiremo ibiri muri dosiye sp-backup .json. Buri mushinga uba umurongo naho imirimo iba amakarita muri To Do, In Progress, Backlog cyangwa Done, hamwe n'inyandiko, ibimenyetso, itariki ntarengwa, igihe cyakoreshejwe n'ibikorwa bito; imirimo iri mu bubiko iba amakarita ari mu Bubiko.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Muri Taiga, fungura Admin > Project > Export maze umanure ububiko bw'umushinga (banza ufungure dosiye .json.gz), hanyuma ushyiremo JSON yayo. Imiterere y'inkuru z'abakoresha iba intonde, inkuru z'abakoresha ziba amakarita hamwe n'imirimo yazo nk'ibikorwa bito, epics n'ibibazo bihabwa imirongo yabyo, naho sprints, ibimenyetso, ibitekerezo n'ibiranga byihariye biraza. Imigereka ntiyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Muri Vikunja, fungura Settings, hitamo Data Export maze umanure dosiye .zip ikoherereza, hanyuma uhitemo iyo dosiye, cyangwa ushyiremo data.json iyirimo. Ibiseke bya Kanban biba intonde naho imirimo iba amakarita, hamwe n'ibirango, abahawe akazi, amatariki, ibisobanuro, intonde z'imirimo nk'intonde zo kugenzura n'ibitekerezo; icyihutirwa, ijanisha ryakozwe na done biba imyanya yihariye. Imigereka ntiyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-quire: Muri Quire, fungura menu y'umushinga maze uhitemo Export CSV, hanyuma ushyiremo CSV. Imiterere iba intonde naho imirimo iba amakarita, hamwe n'ibikorwa bito byayo nk'amakarita akomoka kuri yo, abahawe akazi, ibimenyetso nk'ibirango, amatariki yo gutangira, ntarengwa n'ayo kurangiza, ibisobanuro n'icyihutirwa nk'umwanya wihariye. Ibitekerezo n'imigereka ntibiri muri CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Muri Wrike, sohora umushinga cyangwa ububiko muri Excel, cyangwa wuzuze inyandikorugero ya Excel yo kwinjiza ya Wrike, hanyuma uhitemo iyo dosiye .xlsx. Imirongo y'ububiko n'imishinga iba imirongo, Status iba intonde naho imirimo iba amakarita, hamwe na Key yayo, umurimo uyikomokaho, abahawe akazi, amatariki yo gutangira n'ayo kurangiza, ibyo ishingiyeho n'ibisobanuro; Priority, Duration n'izindi nkingi biba imyanya yihariye.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Muri Teamwork.com, uzuza inyandikorugero ya Excel yo kwinjiza imirimo (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) maze uyibike nka .xlsx, hanyuma uhitemo iyo dosiye. Intonde z'imirimo ziba intonde naho imirimo iba amakarita; umurimo utangiwe na -, # cyangwa > uba igikorwa gito cy'umurimo uri hejuru yawo (--, ## cyangwa >> urwego rumwe rwimbitse kurushaho). Abahawe akazi, amatariki n'ibimenyetso bigumana imyanya yabyo; Priority, Estimated time na Complete biba imyanya yihariye.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Muri Businessmap (yahoze ari Kanbanize), fungura Advanced Search, hitamo Configure results kugira ngo utoranye inkingi, umanure dosiye ya Excel, hanyuma uhitemo iyo dosiye .xlsx. Inkingi zisomwa hakurikijwe amazina yazo y'Icyongereza (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): niba konti yawe ikoresha urundi rurimi, banza uhindure umurongo w'imitwe mu Cyongereza. Column iba intonde naho Lane iba imirongo; ba nyirabyo, ibimenyetso, ibara, amatariki, ibitekerezo n'amahuza y'ibikomokwaho bigumana imyanya yabyo, naho Priority, Size, Type n'izindi nkingi biba imyanya yihariye.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Muri Redmine, fungura Issues z'umushinga, hitamo Also available in: CSV hasi ku rutonde, toranya inkingi (All columns, hamwe na Description) maze usohore, hanyuma ushyiremo CSV. Redmine yita inkingi mu rurimi rwawe, bityo shyira ururimi rwawe mu Cyongereza muri My account mbere yo gusohora. Buri miterere iba urutonde naho ibibazo biba amakarita, hamwe na tracker nk'ikirango, uwahawe akazi, umwanditsi, amatariki, umurimo ubikomokaho n'ibibazo bifitanye isano; icyihutirwa, icyiciro, verisiyo igamijwe, igihe giteganyijwe, % Done n'imyanya yihariye biba imyanya yihariye.
import-board-instruction-notion: Muri Notion, fungura ububikoshingiro nk'urupapuro rwuzuye, hitamo ••• na Export, toranya Markdown & CSV, maze uhitemo dosiye .zip imanurwa, cyangwa CSV imwe y'ububikoshingiro iyirimo, cyangwa ushyiremo iyo CSV. Inkingi yitwa Status iba intonde (niba itariho, inkingi ya mbere isa n'iyo guhitamo ni yo iba intonde, kandi raporo yo kwinjiza ivuga iyo ari yo); imirongo iba amakarita hamwe n'umutwe wayo, ibimenyetso nk'ibirango, abantu nk'abanyamuryango, amatariki, n'umwandiko w'urupapuro nk'ibisobanuro; izindi nkingi ziba imyanya yihariye. Isano, amashusho n'imigereka ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-plane: Muri Plane, fungura Workspace Settings, hitamo Exports, sohora imishinga nka JSON, CSV cyangwa Excel maze umanure dosiye .zip, hanyuma uhitemo iyo dosiye, cyangwa dosiye imwe iyirimo, cyangwa ushyiremo JSON cyangwa CSV. Imiterere iba intonde, imishinga iba imirongo, naho ibibazo biba amakarita hamwe n'ikiranga cyabyo, ibibikomokaho, abahawe akazi, ibirango, amatariki, amahuza n'ibitekerezo; icyihutirwa, igereranya, icyiciro na module biba imyanya yihariye. Isohora rya Plane nta bisobanuro cyangwa imigereka rifite, bityo ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-fizzy: Muri Fizzy, ohereza konti muri "Account settings", cyangwa amakarita yawe ukoresheje "Download my data", maze uhitemo dosiye ya .zip Fizzy ikoherereza, cyangwa dosiye ya .json y'ikarita imwe. Ibibaho biba imirongo, n'inkingi ziba intonde, hamwe na "Maybe?", "Not now" na "Done" nk'uko biri muri Fizzy; amakarita agumana ibisobanuro byayo, ibirango, abahawe akazi, intambwe nk'urutonde rwo kugenzura, ibitekerezo n'amadosiye.
import-board-instruction-mail: Hitamo dosiye ya .mbox, nk'uko Thunderbird, Apple Mail, mutt cyangwa Gmail binyuze kuri Google Takeout bayibika, cyangwa ubutumwa bumwe bwa .eml, cyangwa ushyiremo inyandiko yabwo. Buri kiganiro kiba ikarita imwe mu rutonde rwa Inbox, hamwe n'uwohereje, abakiriye n'umutwe wacyo, ku buryo kigaragara mu kureba kwa Email; ibisubizo biba ibitekerezo byacyo. Ibirango bya Gmail biba ibirango. Imigereka ntiyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-ical: Hitamo dosiye ya kalendari ya .ics, nk'uko Google Calendar, Apple Calendar cyangwa Reminders, Thunderbird, Nextcloud cyangwa Outlook biyohereza, cyangwa ushyiremo inyandiko yayo. Imirimo ijya muri To Do, In Progress, Done cyangwa Cancelled hakurikijwe uko ihagaze, n'ibikorwa bijya muri Events, hamwe n'amatariki yabyo yo gutangira n'ntarengwa, ku buryo bigaragara mu kureba kwa Calendar na Gantt. Ibyiciro n'ibyihutirwa biba ibirango. Ibintu bisubirwamo byinjizwa rimwe.
import-board-instruction-googletakeout: Kuri takeout.google.com, hitamo Tasks, Keep, Mail, Calendar na Google Chat, kora iyoherezwa maze ukure dosiye ya .zip, hanyuma uyihitemo hano. Buri gicuruzwa kiba umurongo: imeri ku kureba kwa Email, intonde z'imirimo n'inyandiko n'intonde zazo zo kugenzura, ibikorwa bya kalendari n'imirimo bifite amatariki, n'ahantu ho kuganirira ubutumwa bwaho buba ibitekerezo ku kureba kwa Chat. Ibindi bicuruzwa n'imigereka ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-slack: Muri Slack, fungura igenamiterere ry'aho mukorera, hitamo Import/Export Data, ohereza aho mukorera maze ukure dosiye ya .zip, hanyuma uyihitemo hano. Buri muyoboro uba ikarita muri Channels, Groups cyangwa Direct messages, kandi ubutumwa bwawo n'ibisubizo byo mu nsanganyamatsiko biba ibitekerezo by'ikarita, hakurikijwe uwabyanditse, ku buryo kureba kwa Chat kwerekana umuyoboro. Dosiye ntizinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-mattermost: Ohereza ukoresheje mmctl export create, kura iyoherezwa maze uhitemo dosiye yayo ya .jsonl, cyangwa ushyiremo inyandiko yayo. Buri muyoboro n'ubutumwa bwihariye biba ikarita, kandi inyandiko zabyo n'ibisubizo biba ibitekerezo by'ikarita, ku buryo kureba kwa Chat kwerekana umuyoboro. Amatsinda aba imirongo. Dosiye ntizinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-telegram: Muri Telegram Desktop, fungura Settings, Advanced, Export Telegram data, hitamo imiterere ya JSON maze wohereze, hanyuma uhitemo dosiye ya result.json, cyangwa ushyiremo inyandiko yayo. Buri kiganiro kiba ikarita muri Direct messages, Groups cyangwa Channels, kandi ubutumwa bwacyo buba ibitekerezo by'ikarita, ku buryo kureba kwa Chat kwerekana ikiganiro. Amafoto na dosiye ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-whatsapp: Muri WhatsApp, fungura ikiganiro, hitamo Export chat nta bitangazamakuru, maze uhitemo dosiye ya .txt hano, cyangwa ushyiremo inyandiko yayo. Ikiganiro kiba ikarita ubutumwa bwayo ari ibitekerezo byayo, hakurikijwe uwohereje n'igihe, ku buryo kureba kwa Chat kukigaragaza. Ibitangazamakuru n'ubutumwa bwa sisitemu ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-discord: Ohereza umuyoboro wa Discord ukoresheje DiscordChatExporter mu miterere ya JSON maze uhitemo dosiye ya .json, cyangwa ushyiremo inyandiko yayo. Umuyoboro uba ikarita mu cyiciro cyawo, kandi ubutumwa bwawo buba ibitekerezo by'ikarita, ku buryo kureba kwa Chat kwerekana umuyoboro. Seriveri iba umurongo. Imigereka ntiyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-rocketchat: Muri Rocket.Chat, ohereza amakuru yawe nka JSON muri "My Data" maze uhitemo dosiye ya .zip ikoherereza, cyangwa dosiye ya .json yoherejwe y'icyumba kimwe. Buri cyumba kiba ikarita, kandi ubutumwa bwacyo buba ibitekerezo by'ikarita, ku buryo kureba kwa Chat kwerekana icyumba. Dosiye ya .zip WeKan yohereza igenewe uburyo bwa Rocket.Chat bwo kwinjiza CSV na yo irasomwa.
import-board-instruction-evernote: Muri Evernote, ohereza inyandiko cyangwa ikaye nka dosiye ya .enex maze uyihitemo hano, cyangwa ushyiremo inyandiko yayo. Buri nyandiko iba ikarita ifite inyandiko yayo, udusanduku twayo tw'ibyo gukora nk'urutonde rwo kugenzura, ibimenyetso byayo nk'ibirango n'urwibutso rwayo nk'itariki ntarengwa; inyandiko zifite urwibutso rwarangiye zijya muri Done. Amashusho na dosiye zometseho ntibyinjizwa.
import-board-instruction-trello: Ku kibaho cyawe cya Trello, jya kuri 'Menu', hanyuma 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', maze ukope inyandiko ivuyemo.
import-board-instruction-csv: Nimanika Indangagaciro Zitandukanyijwe n'Akitso (CSV)/ Indangagaciro Zitandukanyijwe na Tab (TSV).
import-board-instruction-jira: Nimanika JSON ivuye mu gushakisha ibibazo kwa Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), cyangwa ikintu gihwanye na { "issues": [...] }. Statuses za Jira ziba intonde, issues zikaba amakarita. Ushobora no gushyiramo urutonde rwa "automationRules" kugira winjize amategeko.
import-board-instruction-excel: Hitamo urupapuro .xlsx rw'uburyo bwa WeKan (inkingi zimwe n'izisohorwa muri Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, amatariki, imirima yihariye). Umurongo wa mbere ni umutwe.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Ku kibaho cyawe, jya kuri 'Menu', hanyuma 'Export board', maze ukope inyandiko iri muri dosiye yamanutse.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Niba ubonye amakosa mu kwinjiza ikibaho, rimwe na rimwe kwinjiza birakomeza gukora, kandi ikibaho kiba ku rupapuro rw'Ibibaho Byose.
import-members-mode-map: Hitamo ukoresha usanzwe uhari kuri buri wese muri bo
import-members-mode-placeholder: Bagumane nk'abakoresha b'agateganyo bafite amazina yabo, bazahuzwe n'abakoresha nyabo nyuma
csv-mapping-description: Hitamo inkingi ya dosiye irimo buri mwanya w'ikarita. Amahitamo yakozwe hashingiwe ku mazina y'inkingi; hindura ayo ari yo yose atari yo, kandi uhitemo (ntiri muri dosiye) ku mwanya dosiye idafite.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Dosiye nta nkingi y'urutonde ifite. Hitamo imwe hejuru, cyangwa wandike izina ry'urutonde rumwe buri karita ijyamo.
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Izindi nkingi zo kwinjiza nk'imyanya yihariye y'umwandiko:
csv-mapping-list-required: Andika izina ry'urutonde buri karita ijyamo, cyangwa uhitemo inkingi irimo urutonde.
import-many-boards-hint: Hitamo dosiye nyinshi zasohowe n'iki gikoresho, cyangwa .zip imwe izirimo: buri dosiye iba ikibaho cyayo, cyinjizwa nta guhuza abanyamuryango. .zip ubwayo ari isohora rimwe (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, cyangwa WeKan ifite imigereka) ni ikibaho kimwe. Iyo dosiye zitoranyijwe hano, Kwinjiza kwinjiza izo aho kwinjiza umwanya uri hejuru.
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Buri murongo kwinjiza kwakora (umushinga, ububiko cyangwa urutonde rw'igikoresho) uba ikibaho cyawo. Amakarita akomokwaho n'ibyo bishingiyeho hagati y'ibyo bibaho byanditswe muri raporo yo kwinjiza.
export-all-boards-hint: Buri kibaho ushobora gusohora, mu imanura rimwe: Excel nk'igitabo kimwe gifite urupapuro kuri buri kibaho rwitiriwe icyo kibaho, ubundi buryo bwose nka .zip ifite dosiye kuri buri kibaho.
import-json-placeholder: Nimanika amakuru yawe ya JSON yemewe hano
import-csv-placeholder: Nimanika amakuru yawe ya CSV/TSV yemewe hano
import-json-file: Cyangwa uhitemo dosiye JSON ya Trello
import-attachments-zip: ZIP y'imigereka ya Trello (si ngombwa, iva muri Trello Card Attachments Downloader)
import-trello-json-file-hint: Ikibaho kimwe cya Trello cyasohowe nka .json. Niba warabitse urufunguzo na token bya Trello API, imigereka yacyo, ishusho y'inyuma y'ikibaho n'amashusho y'abanyamuryango na byo biramanurwa.
import-trello-zip-file-hint: .zip ifite dosiye .json imwe cyangwa nyinshi z'ibibaho n'imigereka yazo mu bubiko buto bwitiriwe ibibaho (bivuye muri Trello Card Attachments Downloader). Ibibaho byose birinjizwa.
import-trello-zip-no-boards: Nta dosiye .json z'ibibaho bya Trello zabonetse muri .zip.
import-trello-zip-progress: Ibibaho birimo kwinjizwa bivuye muri .zip, tegereza…
import-timeout: Kwinjiza byatinze cyane maze birahagarikwa. Ongera ugerageze; nibikomeza, ikibaho gishobora kuba kinini cyane cyangwa ububiko bw'amakuru bukaba buhuze.
import-too-large: Dosiye ni nini cyane ku buryo itakwinjizwa icyarimwe. Yigabanyemo dosiye nto, urugero ukurikije umushinga cyangwa itariki, hanyuma winjize buri imwe.
import-trello-zip-too-large: .zip ni nini cyane ku buryo itinjizwa.
import-trello-zip-too-many-files: .zip ifite amadosiye menshi cyane ku buryo atinjizwa.
import-trello-zip-file-too-large: Dosiye iri muri .zip ni nini cyane ku buryo itinjizwa.
import-trello-zip-unsafe-path: .zip irimo inzira z'amadosiye zidatekanye maze irangwa.
import-attachment-auth-hint: Ibyoherejwe hanze bivuga amazina y'imigereka ariko ntibizana amadosiye. Kugira ngo uyazane, tanga aderesi ya serivisi n'uburyo bwo kwinjira: bikoreshwa kuri iri yinjiza gusa, byoherezwa kuri iyo aderesi gusa, kandi ntibibikwa na rimwe. Siga ubusa kugira ngo winjize nta madosiye.
import-attachment-auth-token: Tokeni ya API, urufunguzo rwa API cyangwa ijambobanga rya porogaramu
import-trello-workspace-placeholder: Ikibaho cyinjijwe gishyirwa munsi y'aha hantu ho gukorera, hakaremwa niba hatabaho
import-trello-parent-workspace: Shyira aho gukorera hinjijwe munsi ya
trello-api-import: Injiza uhereye muri Trello ukoresheje urufunguzo na token bya API
trello-api-import-desc: Nimanika urufunguzo na token bya Trello API kugira utondeke aho gukorera n'ibibaho bya Trello, hanyuma winjize ibyahiswemo hamwe n'imigereka yabyo.
trello-api-key: Urufunguzo rwa Trello API (ruva kuri https://trello.com/app-key)
trello-api-token: Token ya Trello API (ikorwa n'intoki munsi y'urufunguzo rwa API)
trello-api-credentials-required: Injiza urufunguzo na token bya Trello API byombi.
trello-api-credentials-saved: Urufunguzo na token bya Trello API byabitswe. Ushobora gutondeka aho gukorera utabyongeye kwinjiza.
trello-export-desc: Kora kopi y'iki kibaho muri Trello ukoresheje API ya Trello, n'urufunguzo rwawe rwa API ya Trello na token. Imirongo iba ibirango byitwa "Swimlane: …", ibyo kwinjiza kwa Trello muri WeKan gusubiza mu mirongo.
sandstorm-trello-access-needed: Grain ya Sandstorm nta murandasi wayo bwite ifite. Banza wemerere iyi grain kugera kuri Trello.
sandstorm-trello-access-granted: Iyi grain ishobora kugera kuri Trello.
sandstorm-trello-save-label: Trello, yo kwinjiza no gusohora ibibaho
trello-select-boards: Hitamo nibura ikibaho kimwe cyo kwinjiza.
trello-cancel-delete-confirm: Hagarika kwinjiza kandi usibe ibibaho bimaze kwinjizwa n'iki gikorwa? Ibi ntibishobora gusubizwa inyuma.

import-members-map-note: Icyitonderwa: Abanyamuryango batahujwe bazashingwa ukoresha uriho.
import-user-select: Hitamo ukoresha wawe usanzweho ushaka gukoresha nk'uyu munyamuryango
invalid-year: Umwaka ntiwemewe. Andika imibare ine yose, urugero 2026.
just-invited: Ubu ni bwo utumiwe kuri iki kibaho
shared-labels-desc: Ibirango bibitswe hano bishobora gukoreshwa ku bibaho byinshi, iruhande rw'ibirango bya buri kibaho. Guhindura izina cyangwa ibara by'ikirango hano bigihindura ku kibaho cyose kigikoresha; gusiba ikirango bigisiga kuri ibyo bibaho nk'ikirango cyabyo bwite.
label-delete-pop: Nta gusubiza inyuma. Ibi bizakura aka kamenyetso ku makarita yose kandi bisibe amateka yako.
last-admin-desc: Ntushobora guhindura inshingano kuko hagomba kuba nibura umuyobozi umwe.
hide-board: Va kuri iki kibaho: kihishe muri Ibibaho byose. Ubunyamuryango bwawe mu itsinda cyangwa ikigo burakomeza, kandi Igenamiterere ry'umunyamuryango / Ibibaho byahishwe birakigarura.
group-members-read-only: Abayobozi b'iri tsinda bonyine ni bo bashobora guhindura abarimo. Itsinda rivuye kuri LDAP cyangwa ku kindi gitabo cy'amazina rihindurirwa aho, si muri WeKan.
leave-board-pop: Uzi neza ko ushaka kuva kuri __boardTitle__? Uzakurwa ku makarita yose yo kuri iki kibaho.
linkCardToNewBoard: Rema ikibaho uhereye kuri iyi karita
list-archive-cards: Imurira amakarita yose yo muri uru rutonde mu Bubiko
list-archive-cards-pop: Ibi bizakura amakarita yose yo muri uru rutonde ku kibaho. Kugira urebe amakarita ari mu Bubiko kandi uyagarure ku kibaho, kanda “Menu” > “Archive”.
list-move-cards: Imura amakarita yose yo muri uru rutonde
list-select-cards: Hitamo amakarita yose yo muri uru rutonde
list-delete-pop: Ibikorwa byose bizakurwa mu ruhererekane rw'ibikorwa kandi ntuzashobora kugarura urutonde. Nta gusubiza inyuma.
list-delete-suggest-archive: Ushobora kwimurira urutonde mu Bubiko kugira urukure ku kibaho kandi ubike ibikorwa.
log-out-everywhere-confirm: Ibi bigusohora muri buri mushakisha, telefoni na porogaramu winjiyemo, harimo n'iyi.

passkeys-unsupported: Uyu mushakisha ntushobora gukora imfunguzo zo kwinjira.
passkey-invalid: Urwo rufunguzo rwo kwinjira ntirwashoboye gukoreshwa.
passkey-sign-in-failed: Kwinjira ukoresheje urufunguzo rwo kwinjira ntibyakunze. Ongera ugerageze, cyangwa winjire mu bundi buryo.
passkey-expired: Byatwaye igihe kirekire cyane. Ongera ugerageze.
passkey-exists: Urwo rufunguzo rwo kwinjira rwamaze kongerwaho.
passkey-too-many: Ufite imfunguzo zo kwinjira nyinshi konti ishobora kugira. Banza ukureho rumwe.
passkey-needs-https: Imfunguzo zo kwinjira zisaba WeKan kuri aderesi ya https://.

notify-watch: Akira amakuru mashya y'ibibaho, intonde cyangwa amakarita ukurikirana

custom-public-desc-placeholder: Siga ubusa kugira ngo ukoreshe ibisobanuro mburabuzi by'ikibaho rusange

remove-member-pop: Kura __name__ (__username__) kuri __boardTitle__? Umunyamuryango azakurwa ku makarita yose yo kuri iki kibaho. Azakira imenyesha.
sandstorm-remove-member-warning: Ibi bihisha gusa umunyamuryango muri WeKan. Ntibimwambura uburenganzira bwo kugera kuri grain ya Sandstorm. Mwambure uburenganzira no mu kiganiro cya Share access cya Sandstorm.

r-import-workflow-note: Injiza urukurikirane rw'ibikorwa rugaragara rwasohowe muri n8n cyangwa Node-RED. Node z'imbarutso/ibikorwa zimenyekanye zihuzwa n'amategeko ya WeKan; node zidahujwe ziratangazwa.
r-wrike-workflow-note: Urujya n'uruza rw'akazi rwa Wrike ni urutonde rw'imiterere, buri yose iri mu itsinda rya Active, Completed, Deferred cyangwa Cancelled. Gusohora kwandika intonde z'iki kibaho nk'urumwe, rwitiriwe ikibaho, muri JSON API ya Wrike isubiza ku rujya n'uruza rw'akazi: kora urwo rujya n'uruza muri Wrike mbere yo kwinjiza isohora rya Excel rya Wrike ry'ikibaho, kugira ngo imiterere yarwo ikoreshwe. Kwinjiza gusoma iyo JSON yashyizwe hejuru, ivuye muri WeKan cyangwa muri GET /workflows ya Wrike, ikayishyira ku kibaho cyatoranyijwe: imiterere idafite urutonde iba urutonde, kandi itegeko rishyira ikarita nk'iyarangiye iyo yimuriwe mu miterere ya Completed cyangwa Cancelled, n'iyitarangiye mu ya Active cyangwa Deferred. Amategeko y'ikoresha-ryikora ya Wrike ubwayo ntashobora gusohorwa muri Wrike.

Umuntu wese uzi izina ry'insanganyamatsiko rusange ashobora kuyisoma, rero yigire ndende kandi y'ibanga, cyangwa ukoreshe seriveri yawe bwite ya ntfy ifite token yo kwinjira.

ntfy-invalid-token: Token yo kwinjira ifite inyuguti zitemewe.

delete-linked-cards-before-this-list: Ntushobora gusiba uru rutonde utabanje gusiba amakarita ahujwe yerekeza ku makarita ari muri uru rutonde

Hitamo urugero rumwe cyangwa nyinshi hasi kugira werekane inyandikorugero zisangiwe zihuye. Abakoresha bafite Ikibaho cy'Inyandikorugero kitari ubusa gusa ni bo batondekwa.

globalSearch-instructions-description: Ishakisha rishobora kubamo opereteri kugira ngo risobanuke neza. Opereteri zigaragazwa no kwandika izina rya opereteri n'agaciro bitandukanyijwe n'utudomo tubiri. Urugero, `list:Blocked` yatuma ishakisha rigarukira ku makarita ari mu rutonde rwitwa *Blocked*. Niba agaciro karimo imyanya cyangwa ibimenyetso byihariye kagomba gushyirwa mu twuguruzo (urugero `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-board: `__operator_board__:<title>` - amakarita ari ku bibaho bihuye na *<title>* yatanzwe
globalSearch-instructions-operator-list: `__operator_list__:<title>` - amakarita ari mu ntonde zihuye na *<title>* yatanzwe
globalSearch-instructions-operator-swiml: `__operator_swimlane__:<title>` - amakarita ari mu mirongo ihuye na *<title>* yatanzwe
globalSearch-instructions-operator-label: `__operator_label__:<color>` `__operator_label__:<name>` - amakarita afite akamenyetso gahuye na *<color>* cyangwa *<name>
globalSearch-instructions-operator-org: `__operator_org__:<display name|short name>` - amakarita ari ku kibaho cyahawe ikigo *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-team: `__operator_team__:<display name|short name>` - amakarita ari ku kibaho cyahawe itsinda *<name>*
globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - amakarita azageza ku gihe mu minsi itarenze *<n>* kuva ubu. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ yerekana amakarita yose yarengeje igihe cyo kurangira.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - amakarita yakozwe mu minsi *<n>* ishize cyangwa munsi yayo
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - amakarita yahinduwe mu minsi *<n>* ishize cyangwa munsi yayo
globalSearch-instructions-operator-statu: `__operator_status__:<status>` - aho *<status>* ari kimwe muri ibi bikurikira:
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - amakarita yose, ari mu bubiko n'atari mu bubiko
globalSearch-instructions-status-public: `__predicate_public__` - amakarita ari ku bibaho rusange gusa
globalSearch-instructions-status-private: `__predicate_private__` - amakarita ari ku bibaho bwite gusa
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - aho *<field>* ari kimwe muri `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` cyangwa `__predicate_member__`. Gushyira `-` imbere ya *<field>* bishakisha aho uwo murima udafite agaciro (urugero `has:-due` ishakisha amakarita adafite itariki yo kurangira).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - aho *<sort-name>* ari kimwe muri `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` cyangwa `__predicate_modified__`. Kugira ngo bitondekwe mu buryo bugabanuka, shyira `-` imbere y'izina ry'itondeka.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - aho *<n>* ari umubare wuzuye uruta zeru ugaragaza umubare w'amakarita yerekanwa kuri buri paji.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Opereteri zisa zihuzwa na *OR*. Amakarita ahuye na kimwe mu bisabwa aragaragazwa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` yagaragaza amakarita ari mu rutonde urwo ari rwo rwose rwitwa *Blocked* cyangwa *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Opereteri zitandukanye zihuzwa na *AND*. Hagaragazwa gusa amakarita ahuye na opereteri zose zitandukanye. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` igaragaza gusa amakarita ari mu rutonde *Available* afite akamenyetso *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Iminsi ishobora gutangwa nk'umubare wuzuye uruta cyangwa uri munsi ya zeru, cyangwa hakoreshejwe `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` cyangwa `__predicate_year__` ku gihe turimo.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Ishakisha ry'amagambo ntirita ku nyuguti nkuru cyangwa nto.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Mu buryo busanzwe, amakarita ari mu bubiko ntashakishwa.

mongodb-compact-description: Nyuma yo kwimura dosiye muri MongoDB GridFS, dosiye y'ububikoshingiro kuri disiki ntiyigabanya ubwayo. Gukoresha Compact bigarura umwanya warekuwe byongera kwandika amakuru y'ikusanyirizo. Bikoreshe gusa nyuma y'uko kwimura dosiye nyinshi birangiye.

Ku matsinda ya replica, izisimbura zose zibanza gukorerwa compact (mu buryo bwikora), hanyuma iy'ibanze. Ku matsinda ya replica agizwe n'igice kimwe akoreshwa kuri oplog (imiterere ya Meteor isanzwe), iy'ibanze gusa ni yo ikorerwa compact.

password-pwned: Iri jambobanga ryagaragaye mu makuru yamenyekanye. Hitamo irindi.
password-length-report-desc: Konti zinjiye zikoresheje ijambobanga rigufi kurusha uburebure buto bushoboka. Mushakisha yonyine ni yo izi uburebure bw'ijambobanga, bityo itanga raporo y'ijambobanga rigufi nyuma yo kwinjira; ijambobanga n'uburebure bwaryo ntibijya biyivamo. Byakosowe ni igihe ijambobanga rya konti ryahinduwe - konti yongeye kwinjira ikoresheje ijambobanga rigufi yongera kugaragazwa nk'irigufi cyane.
password-min-length-description: Kwinjira ukoresheje ijambobanga rigufi kurushaho bigaragara hepfo. Kwinjira ntibijya byangwa kubera ibyo.
password-min-length-enforce-description: Ijambobanga rishya rigufi kurushaho ryangwa, kandi konti yinjiye ikoresheje ijambobanga rigufi kurushaho igomba kurihindura mbere y'ikindi cyose. Kurihindura bisohora konti ahantu hose yinjiye. Amagambobanga ya LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS na Sandstorm ni ay'ababitanga, kandi ntagenzurwa.
password-length-from-environment: Agaciro kashyizwe mu bidukikije bya seriveri ni ko gakurikizwa; kubika hano birakasimbura.
password-change-required-text: Uru rubuga ubu rusaba amagambobanga afite nibura inyuguti __min__, kandi iryawe ni rigufi kurushaho. Hitamo irirerire kugira ngo ukomeze. Hanyuma konti yawe isohorwa ahantu hose yinjiye, kandi ukongera kwinjira ukoresheje ijambobanga rishya.
password-same-as-username: Ijambobanga ntirigomba kuba izina ry'ukoresha cyangwa aderesi ya imeyili.

activity-feed-empty: Nta kintu kirakorwa ku bibaho byawe.
share-target-empty: Nta kintu cyasangijwe. Sangiza WeKan urupapuro, inyandiko cyangwa ubutumwa uvuye muri porogaramu indi.
support-info-only-for-logged-in-users: Amakuru y'ubufasha aboneka gusa ku bakoresha binjiye.
accessibility-page-enabled: Paji yo korohereza abantu bose irakora
accessibility-info-not-added-yet: Amakuru yo korohereza abantu bose ntarongerwamo
accounts-lockout-settings: Igenamiterere ryo kurinda ibitero byo kugerageza amagambobanga menshi
accounts-lockout-info: Iri genamiterere rigena uko kugerageza kwinjira birindwa ibitero byo kugerageza amagambobanga menshi.
accounts-lockout-known-users: Igenamiterere ry'abakoresha bazwi (izina ry'ukoresha ni ryo, ijambobanga ni ribi)
accounts-lockout-settings-updated: Igenamiterere ryo kurinda ibitero byo kugerageza amagambobanga menshi ryavuguruwe
data-access-info: Ninde wamanuye iki: isohora ryose ry'ikibaho, ry'ibibaho byose, ry'amakuru y'umuntu cyangwa ry'urutonde rwo mu Kanama k'Umuyobozi, ribarwa ku muntu no ku munsi.
compliance-info: Igenamiterere GDPR, HIPAA, NIS2, ISO 27001 na SOC 2 bikunze gushakisha. Uru rupapuro rutanga raporo gusa: ibifite akamaro biterwa n'ukoresha iyi WeKan n'uwo ayikoresheza.
compliance-2fa-admins: Kwemeza mu bice bibiri ni itegeko, nibura ku bayobozi
compliance-login-retention: Aderesi zo kwinjira zibikwa igihe gito
compliance-audit-retention: Igitabo cy'igenzura kibikwa iminsi 2190 cyangwa irenga (HIPAA)
compliance-imprint-published: Amakuru y'uwasohoye yatangajwe (ni ngombwa ku serivisi y'ubucuruzi mu Budage no muri Otirishiya)
compliance-security-contact: Uwo kuvugana ku mutekano yashyizweho, kuri security.txt
compliance-backup-encrypted: Kopi y'umutekano ihoraho ihishwe hakoreshejwe kode
admin-audit-log-info: Ibyo abayobozi b'urubuga bakoze: impinduka z'abakoresha, kwinjira, ububiko na kopi z'umutekano, ibishya mbere. Amagambobanga n'amabanga ntabwo yandikwa na rimwe. Bibikwa umwaka umwe.
accounts-lockout-locked-users-info: Abakoresha bafunzwe ubu kubera kugerageza kwinjira kwananiranye kenshi cyane
accounts-lockout-confirm-unlock: Uremeza ko ushaka gufungura uyu ukoresha?
accounts-lockout-confirm-unlock-all: Uremeza ko ushaka gufungura abakoresha bose bafunzwe?
accounts-lockout-click-to-unlock: Kanda kugira ngo ufungure uyu ukoresha
admin-people-user-active: Ukoresha arakora — kanda kugira ngo umuhagarike
admin-people-user-inactive: Ukoresha ntakora — kanda kugira ngo umukoreshe
add-cron-job-placeholder: Uburyo bwo kongeraho igikorwa giteganyijwe buzaza vuba
board-archive-failed: Guteganya gushyira ikibaho mu bubiko byanze
board-archive-scheduled: Gushyira ikibaho mu bubiko byateganyijwe neza
cron-job-delete-confirm: Uremeza ko ushaka gusiba iki gikorwa giteganyijwe?
cron-no-failed-migrations: Nta kwimura amakuru kwanze ko kongera kugeragezwa
cron-no-paused-migrations: Nta kwimura amakuru kwahagaritswe by'akanya ko gukomeza
cron-migrations-retried: Iyimurwa ry'amakuru ryari ryanze ryongeye kugeragezwa neza
filesystem-enabled: Ububiko bwa sisitemu ya dosiye burakora
filesystem-disabled: Ububiko bwa sisitemu ya dosiye burahagaritswe
filesystem-enabled-description: Koresha sisitemu ya dosiye yo kuri mudasobwa mu kubika dosiye
s3-minio-storage-description: Ububiko bw'ibintu buhuye na S3: AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces n'ibindi.
s3-force-path-style-description: Bisabwa na MinIO na seriveri nyinshi zihuye na S3 zitari iza AWS.
s3-sse-none: Nta na kimwe cyasabwe (igenamiterere risanzwe rya bucket)
s3-sse-description: S3 ifunga umugereka wose, ishusho y'ukoresha yose na kopi y'umutekano yose WeKan yandika, ikabifungurira WeKan iyo bisomwa.
s3-sse-kms-key-id: ID y'urufunguzo rwa KMS rwa SSE-KMS (ubusa = urufunguzo rusanzwe rwa konti)
azure-connection-string-description: Si ngombwa: koresha umurongo w'ihuzanzira wuzuye aho gukoresha izina rya konti n'urufunguzo.
database-migration-description: Imura amakuru ashingiye ku mwandiko (byose uretse imigereka n'amashusho y'imyirondoro biguma kuri sisitemu ya dosiye) hagati ya MongoDB na FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Ubundi bubikoshingiro bugomba kuba burimo gukora kandi bugerwaho (ibyambu bisanzwe: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; hindura ukoresheje WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Birangiye, erekeza MONGO_URL ku bundi bubikoshingiro maze wongere utangire WeKan (kuri Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb cyangwa =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Imurira amakuru y'umwandiko muri FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: Kopororera amakusanyirizo yose ashingiye ku mwandiko muri __db__? Imigereka n'amashusho y'imyirondoro biri kuri sisitemu ya dosiye ntibihinduka. Ububikoshingiro bugenewe kwakira bugomba kuba burimo gukora.
sandstorm-migration-description: Iyo WeKan ikorera muri grain ya Sandstorm, ububikoshingiro bwayo bwa kera bwa MongoDB 3 bwimurirwa muri FerretDB v1 (SQLite) ku itangira rya mbere, kandi imigereka n'amashusho y'imyirondoro bikavanwa mu bubikoshingiro bikimurirwa mu bubiko files/attachments na files/avatars bwa grain. Ibi byerekana niba uko kwimura kwaragenze neza n'umwanya dosiye mbisi za kera za MongoDB zigikoresha kuri disiki muri grain, kandi bikagufasha gusiba izo dosiye mbisi kugira ngo ubone umwanya.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Siba dosiye mbisi z'ububikoshingiro bwa MongoDB
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Nyuma y'iyimurwa ryagenze neza, amakuru aba muri FerretDB no kuri sisitemu ya dosiye, bityo dosiye mbisi za kera z'ububikoshingiro bwa MongoDB 3 zishobora gusibwa kugira ngo haboneke umwanya kuri disiki ya grain. Ntibishobora gusubirwaho.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Siba dosiye mbisi z'ububikoshingiro bwa MongoDB 3 kugira ngo haboneke umwanya kuri disiki? Amakuru yamaze kwimurirwa muri FerretDB no kuri sisitemu ya dosiye. Ntibishobora gusubirwaho.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Dosiye mbisi z'ububikoshingiro bwa MongoDB zasibwe, umwanya warekuwe
features-desc: Ibiranga by'inyongera iyi WeKan itanga. Ikiranga kitashyizweho akamenyetso gihishwa ku mugaragarire wa buri wese. Amakuru yacyo arabikwa kandi uburenganzira ntibuhinduka.
feature-views-overview-desc: Imibare, gushyira mu matsinda hakurikijwe uwahawe inshingano, gahunda y'inzira, ikibaho cy'igenzura n'ikibaho kinini.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Urutonde rw'imirimo y'igicuruzwa, ibihe bigufi by'akazi, raporo y'igihe cy'akazi n'umuvuduko.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Akazi gasigaye n'akarangiye, imigendekere ikomatanyijwe, igihe cy'umuzenguruko n'icyo gutanga, ingano y'akazi karangiye, igihe akazi kamaze, imbogamizi, Monte Carlo n'ibindi bipimo by'imigendekere.
feature-approval-required: Gumisha ibiranga byongerwa n'amavugurura ya WeKan bizimye kugeza umuyobozi abifunguye
feature-preview-admins: Abayobozi babona ibiranga bizimye kugira ngo babanze babigerageze
feature-pilot-users: Abakoresha b'igerageza na bo babona ibiranga bizimye
feature-profiles-desc: Umwirondoro uhisha ibiranga byatoranyijwe ku bakoresha, amatsinda n'ibigo wahawe. Ukoresha amenyeshwa umwirondoro afite. Udafite umwirondoro ntacyo bimutwara, nta makuru asibwa kandi nta burenganzira buhinduka.
feature-profile-notice: Umwirondoro wawe w'ibiranga __name__ uhisha ibiranga __count__. Baza umuyobozi niba ukeneye kimwe muri byo.
card-field-visibility-desc: Imyanya ya Igenamiterere ry'Ikibaho / Ikarita ibibaho bishobora kwerekana. Umwanya udatoranyijwe uhishwa ku ikarita yose, ikarita ntoya yose na Igenamiterere ry'Ikibaho / Ikarita by'ikibaho cyose. Nta makuru y'ikarita cyangwa igenamiterere ry'ikibaho bihinduka, kandi kongera kuwutoranya byerekana buri kibaho uko cyari giteguwe. Uko imyanya ikurikirana ni ukwa buri kibaho.
cards-loading-auto: Byikora (gutangiza agaragara gusa ku bibaho binini)
cards-loading-description: WeKan itangiza amakarita y'ikibaho mu buryo bwikora: ikibaho kinini (kirengeje ingano ntarengwa) gitangiza gusa amakarita agaragara ubu (gukomeza kumanuka kutagira iherezo) hamwe n'umubare uvugururwa, kugira ngo gikomeze kwihuta kandi gikoreshe ububiko n'umuyoboro bike; ibibaho bito byo bigatangiza buri karita kugira ngo ikoreshwe mu buryo bworoshye kandi bwuzuye. Nta cyo kugena. Abayobozi ba sisitemu bashobora guhatiriza uburyo bakoresheje impinduragaciro za CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) na CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Gutangiza amakarita agaragara gusa biracyageragezwa: ibarura ry'amakarita n'imipaka ya WIP ni byo, ariko imigaragarire ya Calendar/Table/Gantt no guhitamo byinshi byerekana gusa amakarita amaze gutangizwa. Ongera utangize ibibaho bifunguye nyuma yo guhindura ibi.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Iyo bikora, amahuza yose (amahuzwa ya markdown nka [label](url) n'utumenyetso twa HTML <a href> mbisi) buri gihe yerekanwa nk'umwandiko usanzwe udakandwa mu mirima yose y'umwandiko ukungahaye (imitwe y'ibibaho n'amakarita, ibisobanuro, ibitekerezo, intonde z'igenzura n'ibindi). Ibi birinda amahuza akandwa ayobya. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze, bityo amahuza agakomeza gukandwa.
always-show-code-as-text: Buri gihe erekana kode yose nk'umwandiko usanzwe
always-show-code-as-text-description: Iyo bikora, umwandiko ukungahaye ntiwerekanwa nka markdown cyangwa HTML: inkomoko yose ihora yerekanwa nk'umwandiko usanzwe mu mirima yose y'umwandiko ukungahaye (imitwe y'ibibaho n'amakarita, ibisobanuro, ibitekerezo, intonde z'igenzura n'ibindi). Ibi bigaragaza ibikubiye byari bihishwe — ibitekerezo bya HTML (<!-- -->), aho amahuza ya markdown yerekeza, JavaScript n'indi kode yose — bityo kode yose igahora igaragara, ntikandwe kandi ntikore. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze, bityo markdown ikerekanwa bisanzwe.
disable-all-import-description: Iyo bikora, uburyo bwose bwo kwinjiza burahagarikwa: kwinjiza ikibaho kivuye muri WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea na Forgejo, ndetse no gukoporora ikibaho. Amahitamo yo kwinjiza arahishwa kandi seriveri ikanga ubusabe bwose bwo kwinjiza. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
import-max-megabytes-description: Dosiye nini cyane urupapuro rwo Kwinjiza rwemera, muri megabytes. Ubusa bisobanura ko nta mbibi: dosiye ishobora kuba nini uko umwanya usigaye kuri disiki wemerera kwinjiza kurangira. Buri dosiye ishyirwaho yandikwa kuri disiki ya seriveri igice ku kindi, kandi kwinjiza kwakuzuza disiki kwangwa.
import-disk-full: Nta mwanya uhagije usigaye kuri disiki ya seriveri wo kwinjiza ibi.
disable-all-export-description: Iyo bikora, uburyo bwose bwo gusohora burahagarikwa: gusohora ikibaho nka WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, cyangwa muri NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, hamwe no gusohora umugereka umwe. Amahitamo yo gusohora arahishwa kandi seriveri ikanga ubusabe bwose bwo gusohora. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
disable-import-avatars-description: Iyo bikora, amashusho y'imyirondoro y'abakoresha ntiyigera yinjizwa. Ibi bireba kwinjiza WeKan JSON, kwinjiza Trello no guhuza amashusho y'imyirondoro aturuka ku batanga umwirondoro bo hanze igihe cyo kwinjira (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Amazina n'andi makuru biracyinjizwa; amashusho y'imyirondoro gusa ni yo asimbukwa. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
disable-export-avatars-description: Iyo bikora, amashusho y'imyirondoro ntiyigera ashyirwa mu isohora ry'ikibaho (isohora rya WeKan JSON na CSV). Amazina y'abakoresha n'andi makuru biracyasohorwa; amashusho y'imyirondoro gusa ni yo asigara. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
anonymize-import-users-description: Iyo bikora, kwinjiza ikibaho cya WeKan JSON bisimbuza izina ry'ukoresha, izina ryuzuye n'inyuguti z'ibanze bya buri ukoresha winjijwe n'ibimenyetso bibarwa (user1, user2, ...), bigakuraho ishusho ye y'umwirondoro kandi bikongera kwandika @username ivugwa (n'imirima requested-by / assigned-by) mu bikubiye mu makarita no mu bitekerezo byinjijwe. Nta mwirondoro nyakuri w'ukoresha wo ku kibaho cy'inkomoko ubikwa. Ijambo "ukoresha" rikurikiza ururimi rw'umuntu winjiza. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
anonymize-export-users-description: Iyo bikora, gusohora ikibaho bisimbuza izina ry'ukoresha, izina ryuzuye n'inyuguti z'ibanze bya buri ukoresha usohorwa n'ibimenyetso bibarwa (user1, user2, ...), bigakuraho ishusho ye y'umwirondoro kandi bikongera kwandika @username ivugwa (n'imirima requested-by / assigned-by) mu bikubiye mu makarita no mu bitekerezo. Dosiye isohowe nta mwirondoro nyakuri w'ukoresha itwara. Ijambo "ukoresha" rikurikiza ururimi rw'umuntu usohora. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Uzi neza ko ushaka guhisha umwirondoro w'iyi konti? Ibi bisimbuza burundu izina ry'ukoresha, izina ryuzuye n'aderesi ya imeyili n'indangagaciro zihishe, bigakuraho ishusho y'umwirondoro kandi bigahagarika kwinjira. Bitandukanye no gusiba, ibibaho, amakarita n'ibitekerezo bigumana amateka yabyo kandi bigakomeza kwerekana iyi konti, ariko yahishwe umwirondoro. Iki gikorwa ntigishobora gusubizwa inyuma.
disable-activities-description: Iyo bikora, ibyandikwa mu rutonde rw'ibikorwa ntibyigera bibikwa cyangwa ngo byerekanwe ahantu hose (urubari rwo ku ruhande rw'ikibaho n'agace k'ibikorwa by'ikarita). Nta mateka y'uwakoze iki abikwa. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
disable-notifications-description: Iyo bikora, WeKan ntiyigera yohereza imenyesha zo gukurikirana (muri porogaramu, imeli cyangwa izindi serivisi) ku gikorwa icyo ari cyo cyose. Ibikorwa biracyashobora kwandikwa (keretse na byo byahagaritswe hejuru); imenyesha gusa ni zo zihagarikwa. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
disable-watch-description: Iyo bikora, uburyo bwo gukurikirana burahagarikwa — abakoresha ntibashobora kwiyandikisha ku bibaho, intonde cyangwa amakarita ngo bahabwe imenyesha, kandi kugerageza guhindura urwego rwo gukurikirana birangwa. Mu buryo busanzwe birafunze.
backup-description: Bika kopi y'umutekano y'Imigereka, Amashusho y'imyirondoro na/cyangwa Amakuru (amakusanyirizo yose ashingiye ku mwandiko atari imigereka cyangwa amashusho y'imyirondoro). Dosiye .zip yoherezwa ako kanya mu bubiko bwatoranyijwe — nta dosiye y'agateganyo — nka backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, irimo YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars na /data. Ububiko bwo mu gicu (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) bukoresha ibyangombwa byagenwe mu duce twabwo tw'ububiko.
backup-scope-description: Urugero rwose, cyangwa Ikigo kimwe. Kopi y'umutekano y'Ikigo irimo ibibaho byacyo n'ibiri kuri byo byose, harimo imigereka y'ibyo bibaho — ariko nta konti z'abakoresha cyangwa igenamiterere ry'urugero, kuko ibyo bisangiwe n'Ibigo byose. Kugarura kopi y'umutekano y'Ikigo byandika gusa ku bibaho icyo Kigo gifite.
theme-override-all-tenants: Igenamiterere risimbura irindi ku bakodesha bose
continuous-backup-description: Yohereza buri mpinduka mu bubikoshingiro, mu migereka, mu mashusho y'imyirondoro no mu nyandiko z'ibyabaye mu bubiko bwa dosiye mu masegonda make, kugira ngo amakuru ashobore kugarurwa uko yari ameze igihe icyo ari cyo cyose. Ikorana na kopi y'umutekano yateganyirijwe igihe, ikora ububiko bwuzuye.
continuous-backup-enabled: Koresha kopi y'umutekano ikomeza kuri iyi seriveri
continuous-backup-target: Ububiko bwa dosiye bugenewe (inzira yuzuye ku yindi disiki, ahantu hasangiwe ku muyoboro cyangwa ahantu hahujwe na rclone)
wekan-data-no-database: Nta bubikoshingiro bwa WeKan busomeka bwabonetse.
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Amapaji ya SQLite (amapaji yahindutse muri buri ntera y'igihe)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Nta moteri y'ububikoshingiro ishobora gukora kuri iyi seriveri
continuous-backup-key-file: Dosiye y’urufunguzo rwo guhisha ukoresheje kode (inzira yuzuye iri hanze y’ububiko bwa dosiye bugenewe; inyuguti 64 zo mu buryo bw’imibare bufite ishingiro rya 16 cyangwa interuro y’ibanga ifite nibura inyuguti 16). Bika kopi: iyo dosiye idahari, kopi y’umutekano ntishobora kugarurwa.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Nta hantu (mu bubiko bwa dosiye bugenewe gusa)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Ububiko bwa dosiye buri mu gikoresho cyo kubikamo
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Dosiye y'ububikoshingiro ya SQLite (ikorwa iruhande rwa kopi y'umutekano, ntizigera yandika hejuru ya dosiye iri gukoreshwa)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Koresha ububikoshingiro bwa SQLite bwongeye kubakwa igihe ubutaha sisitemu izongera gutangira (ububikoshingiro bwa kera busimbuwe buzabikwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Garura igisekuru cyatoranyijwe uko cyari kimeze ku gihe cyatoranyijwe? Kopi y'umutekano ikomeza izahagarara by'agateganyo mu gihe cyo kugarura.
continuous-backup-saved: Igenamiterere rya kopi y'umutekano ikomeza ryabitswe
backup-restore-select-first: Banza uhitemo kopi y'umutekano ku rutonde.
backup-restore-confirm: Garura kopi y'umutekano yatoranyijwe? Imigereka/amashusho y'imyirondoro byandikwa muri sisitemu ya dosiye, naho amakuru akandikwa mu bubikoshingiro hakurikijwe uburyo bwatoranyijwe.
gcs-key-filename: Inzira ya dosiye y'urufunguzo rwa konti ya serivisi
gcs-key-filename-description: Si ngombwa: inzira ya dosiye y'urufunguzo rwa JSON rwa konti ya serivisi kuri seriveri.
gcs-credentials-description: Si ngombwa: komeka urufunguzo rwa JSON rwa konti ya serivisi. Siga ubusa kugira ngo ukoreshe dosiye y'urufunguzo cyangwa ibyangombwa bisanzwe.
gcs-permissions-note: Ha konti ya serivisi ya WeKan uburenganzira bwo gusoma/kwandika kuri bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → bucket yawe → Permissions → Grant access. Muri "New principals", komeka imeli ya konti ya serivisi — agaciro ka "client_email" kari mu rufunguzo rwawe rwa JSON — hanyuma uhitemo uruhare "Storage Object Admin" maze ukande Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Siga ubusa kugira ngo ugumane agaciro kariho.
azure-account-name-description: Izina rya konti yawe ya Azure Storage.
gcs-project-id-description: ID y'umushinga wawe wa Google Cloud.
gcs-bucket-description: Izina rya bucket ya Cloud Storage ibikwamo dosiye.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: siga ubusa (ikoresha endpoint y'akarere). Ihuzwa na S3: Endpoint URL yo muri konsole yawe ya MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → bucket yawe → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → izina rya bucket yawe (cyangwa Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → ukoresha wawe → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → hitamo 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Ryerekanwa nka 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Ni kuri paji imwe na Access key ID; 'Secret access key' yerekanwa rimwe gusa igihe urufunguzo rukozwe — ruhite ukoporora (cyangwa Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → konti yawe → izina ryerekanwa hejuru (no munsi ya Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → konti yawe → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → konti yawe → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → konti yawe → Data storage → Containers → kontineri yawe (cyangwa + Container kugira ngo uyikore).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → uhitemo umushinga hejuru → ID y'umushinga wawe (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → izina rya bucket yawe (cyangwa Create kugira ngo uyikore).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Inzira kuri seriveri ya WeKan igana kuri dosiye y'urufunguzo rwa JSON rwa konti ya serivisi wamanuriye (ikorwa hasi). Koresha iyi NZIRA CYANGWA komeka JSON mu murima uri hasi.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → konti yawe ya serivisi → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (imanura dosiye). Komeka ibiyirimo hano, cyangwa ubike dosiye maze ushyire inzira yayo hejuru.
cloud-settings-desc: Hamwe na WeKan muri Weddy, Cloud Panel itanga domeni nyinshi za WeKan kuri seriveri imwe, buri imwe ifite amakuru yayo. Kuri domeni ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin acunga domeni na CloudFlare.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Cloud Panel ni iya SuperAdmin gusa, kuri domeni ya Cloud Panel.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ufite urufunguzo rwa CloudFlare API, domeni ifite zone iri muri konti yawe ya CloudFlare ihabwa inyandiko ya DNS inyura kuri proxy n'icyemezo cya CloudFlare Origin. Izindi domeni zihabwa icyemezo cya Let's Encrypt. Urufunguzo rubikwa kuri seriveri kandi ntiruzongera kugaragazwa.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Nta rufunguzo rwa CloudFlare API rwabitswe: buri domeni ihabwa icyemezo cya Let's Encrypt.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Imurira umugereka muri Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Imurira umugereka muri Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Koresha MongoDB GridFS mu kubika dosiye
migration-stop-confirm: Uremeza ko ushaka guhagarika iyimurwa ry'amakuru ryose?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Kugira ngo imigereka n'amashusho y'imyirondoro bigaragare, bivane muri CollectionFS ubijyane mu bundi bubiko ubwo ari bwo bwose.
s3-access-key-description: Urufunguzo rwa AWS S3 rwo kwemeza umwirondoro
s3-bucket-description: Izina rya bucket ya S3 ibikwamo dosiye
s3-enabled-description: Koresha AWS S3 cyangwa MinIO mu kubika dosiye
s3-endpoint-description: URL ya endpoint ya S3 (urugero, s3.amazonaws.com cyangwa minio.example.com)
s3-port-description: Nomero y'icyambu cya endpoint ya S3
s3-secret-key-description: Urufunguzo rw'ibanga rwa AWS S3 rwo kwemeza umwirondoro
s3-ssl-enabled-description: Koresha SSL/TLS ku mahuzanzira ya S3
writable-path-description: Inzira y'ububiko bw'ibanze bwo kubika dosiye
comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Bikora igenzura n'isana ryuzuye ry'ubusugire bw'amakuru y'ikibaho, harimo itondeka ry'intonde, imyanya y'amakarita n'imiterere y'imirongo.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Bisiba neza intonde zirimo ubusa zisubiwemo. Bikuraho gusa intonde zidafite amakarita KANDI zifite urundi rutonde rufite umutwe umwe rurimo amakarita.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Bishakisha kandi bikagarura amakarita n'intonde bibura swimlaneId cyangwa listId. Bikora umurongo wa 'Amakarita yazimiye' kugira ngo ibintu byose byazimiye byongere kugaragara.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Bigarura imirongo, intonde n'amakarita byose byashyizwe mu bubiko. Bihita bisana swimlaneId cyangwa listId ibura kugira ngo ibintu bigaragare.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Bimenya kandi bigasana intonde zibura cyangwa zangiritse mu miterere y'ikibaho.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Bivugurura URL z'amashusho y'imyirondoro y'abanyamuryango b'ikibaho kugira ngo zikoreshe ububiko bwo inyuma bukwiye kandi bigasana amahuza y'amashusho yangiritse.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Bivugurura URL z'imigereka ya dosiye yose kuri iki kibaho kugira ngo zikoreshe ububiko bwo inyuma bukwiye kandi bigasana amahuza ya dosiye yangiritse.
migrations-admin-only: Abayobozi b'ikibaho gusa ni bo bashobora kwimura amakuru
migrations-description: Koresha igenzura n'isana ry'ubusugire bw'amakuru kuri iki kibaho. Buri kwimura amakuru gushobora gukorwa ukwabwo.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Ibi birakora iyimurwa ryuzuye kugira ngo bigenzure kandi bisane ubusugire bw'amakuru y'ikibaho. Bishobora kumara akanya. Komeza?
run-delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migrati: Ibi birabanza guhindura intonde zisangiwe zibe intonde za buri murongo, hanyuma bisibe intonde zirimo ubusa zifite urundi rutonde rwisubiramo rufite umutwe umwe kandi rurimo amakarita. Intonde zirimo ubusa zidakenewe koko gusa ni zo zizakurwaho. Komeza?
run-restore-lost-cards-migration-confirm: Ibi birakora umurongo wa 'Amakarita yazimiye' kandi bigarure amakarita n'intonde byose bibura swimlaneId cyangwa listId. Bireba gusa ibintu bitari mu bubiko. Komeza?
run-restore-all-archived-migration-confi: Ibi biragarura imirongo, intonde n'amakarita BYOSE byashyizwe mu bubiko, byongere bigaragare. Ibintu byose bibura ID bizahita bisanwa. Ibi ntibyoroshye gusubiraho. Komeza?
run-fix-missing-lists-migration-confirm: Ibi biramenya kandi bisane intonde zibura cyangwa zangiritse mu miterere y'ikibaho. Komeza?
run-fix-avatar-urls-migration-confirm: Ibi biravugurura URL z'amashusho y'imyirondoro y'abanyamuryango b'ikibaho kugira ngo zikoreshe ububiko bwo inyuma bukwiye. Komeza?
run-fix-all-file-urls-migration-confirm: Ibi biravugurura URL z'imigereka ya dosiye yose kuri iki kibaho kugira ngo zikoreshe ububiko bwo inyuma bukwiye. Komeza?
restore-lost-cards-nothing-to-restore: Nta mirongo, ntonde cyangwa makarita byazimiye byo kugarura
migration-progress-note: Nyamuneka tegereza mu gihe twimurira ikibaho cyawe mu miterere mishya...
step-ensure-per-swimlane-lists: Emeza ko buri murongo ufite intonde zawo
step-ensure-lost-cards-swimlane: Emeza ko umurongo w'amakarita yazimiye uhari
conversion-info-text: Iri hindura rikorwa rimwe kuri buri kibaho kandi ritezimbere imikorere. Ushobora gukomeza gukoresha ikibaho bisanzwe.
converting-board-description: Guhindura imiterere y'ikibaho kugira ngo gikore neza kurushaho. Bishobora kumara akanya.
migrate-all-to-filesystem: Imurira byose muri sisitemu ya dosiye
migration-batch-size-description: Umubare w'imigereka ikorwa muri buri tsinda (1-100)
migration-cpu-threshold-description: Hagarika by'akanya iyimurwa ry'amakuru iyo imikoreshereze ya CPU irenze iri janisha (10-90)
migration-delay-ms-description: Igihe cyo gutinda hagati y'amatsinda muri milisegonda (100-10000)
migration-info-text: Iyimurwa ry'ububikoshingiro rikorwa rimwe kandi rigateza imbere imikorere ya sisitemu. Igikorwa gikomeza inyuma nubwo wafunga mucukumbuzi yawe.
migration-warning-text: Nyamuneka ntufunge mucukumbuzi yawe mu gihe cyo kwimura amakuru. Igikorwa kizakomeza inyuma ariko gishobora kumara igihe kirekire kugira ngo kirangire.
showChecklistAtMinicard: Erekana urutonde rw'igenzura ku ikarita nto
sign-in-to-upload: Injira kugira ngo ushyireho ububiko bwa kode
account-locked: Konti yafunzwe by'agateganyo kubera kugerageza kwinjira kwananiranye kenshi cyane. Nyamuneka wongere ugerageze nyuma.
username-too-short: Izina ry'ukoresha rigomba kugira nibura ibimenyetso 3
problems-summary-help: Shyira akamenyetso ku bice by'ibibazo wamaze gusuzuma, hanyuma ukande Emeza ko wabibonye kugira ngo usubize kuri zeru umubare w'ibibazo bishya.
problems-in-progress-help: Iri yimurwa ry'amakuru cyangwa isana birimo gukora ubu. Kwinjira bishobora kugenda buhoro, cyangwa bikerekana "Ugomba kuba winjiye" cyangwa ikimenyetso cya "Birimo gutangira, nyamuneka tegereza", kugeza birangiye kandi imikoreshereze ya CPU ikagabanuka.
problems-none-in-progress: Nta kwimura amakuru cyangwa gusana birimo gukorwa.
repair-broken-cards-done-unfixable: Hasanwe amakarita __fixed__. Amakarita __unfixable__ nta kibaho afite kandi ntashobora gusanwa mu buryo bwikora.
export-card-details: Ibisobanuro by'ikarita (buri karita nk'uko iba mu isohora ry'ikarita)
import-here-instruction: Injiza hano isohora rya WeKan (.json cyangwa .zip):
import-not-wekan-export: Iyo dosiye si isohora rya WeKan
globalSearch-instructions-operator-numbe: `__operator_number__:<number>` - amakarita afite nomero y'ikarita ingana na *<number>*
import-board-source: Injiza ikibaho (Trello, Jira, isohora rya WeKan, CSV, Excel, …)
import-report-description: Ikibaho cyarakozwe, ariko ibice bimwe bya dosiye ntibyashoboye kwimurwa. Iyo raporo ibikwa muri Ubuyobozi → Ibibazo → Kugarura.
import-parts-instruction: Ibice byashyizweho akamenyetso gusa ni byo byinjizwa. Ihitamo rimwe rikoreshwa no mu gusohora.
import-wekan-file: Injiza bivuye muri dosiye y'isohora ya .json cyangwa .zip:
import-file-label: Hitamo dosiye yasohowe, cyangwa ushyiremo umwandiko wayo hasi:
sum-of-number-fields: Igiteranyo cy'imyanya y'imibare yihariye igaragazwa hejuru y'urutonde
date-range-of-fields: Igihe cy'itariki cy'imyanya yihariye y'itariki yashyizweho ikimenyetso ngo igaragazwe hejuru y'urutonde
twoFactorAuth-enabled: Kwemeza mu bice bibiri byarakozwe kuri konti yawe.
twoFactorAuth-explanation: Ongeraho urwego rw'umutekano kuri konti yawe. Igihe byatangijwe, uzajya winjiza kode iva muri porogaramu y'kwemeza buri gihe winjira.
twoFactorAuth-scan-instructions: Sikana iyi kode ya QR ukoresheje porogaramu y'kwemeza (urugero, Google Authenticator, Authy), hanyuma winjize kode y'imibare 6 igaragara kugira ngo wemeze.
two-factor-required-text: Uru rubuga rusaba kwemeza mu bice bibiri kuri konti yawe. Bishyireho kugira ngo ukomeze.
twoFactorCode-prompt: Injiza kode yawe y'imibare 6 yo kwemeza
twoFactorCode-invalid: Kode yo kwemeza ntabwo ari nziza. Nyamuneka ongera ugerageze.
subtask-done-no-permission: Ntushobora guhindura niba iki gikorwa gito cyakozwe
chart-forecast-none-remaining: Nta kintu gisigaye kugena - buri karita yarangiye.
chart-forecast-no-velocity: Hasigaye amakarita __remaining__ afunguye; nta byarangiye vuba byo gushingiraho mu kugereranya itariki.
chart-forecast-projected: Ku muvuduko wa vuba w'amakarita __average__ ku cyumweru, amakarita __remaining__ akiri afunguye agomba kuba yarangiye bitarenze __date__.
list-sync-description: Gumisha uru rutonde rugezweho uhereye ku gikoresho cyo hanze gikurikirana ibibazo. Igikorwa cyo inyuma kirugenzura buri minota 15; koresha "Huza nonaha" kugira ngo ugenzure ako kanya.
drag-to-reorder: Kurura kugira ngo uhindure urukurikirane. Utubuto tw’imyambi ijya hejuru no hasi twimura umwanya umwe.
map-view-empty: Iki kibaho ntikiragira ishusho y'ikarita y'ahantu. Umuyobozi w'ikibaho ashobora gushyiraho ishusho — igishushanyo cy'igorofa, ikarita y'ahantu cyangwa igishushanyo — hanyuma amakarita y'imirimo akayishyirwaho.
map-view-place-hint: Kurura ikarita y'umurimo uyishyire ku ikarita y'ahantu, cyangwa uyihitemo hanyuma ukande aho igomba kujya.
map-view-all-placed: Amakarita y'imirimo yose ari ku ikarita y'ahantu.
flow-note-agingWip: Urutonde: Tangira → Igihe bimara. P85: n ≥ 5. (ntibizwi): —.
flow-note-monteCarlo: Monte Carlo: 2000 × Amateka. iminsi: UTC; 0 ✓. 50%, 70%, 85%, 95%. Amakarita ≥; Igihe bimara ≤. Imipaka: 3650 iminsi.
flow-note-processBehavior: XmR: Igihe cy'umuzenguruko; Tangira → Byarangiye. n ≥ 2. X: x̄ ± 3 × MR̄ / 1.128; MR: 0…3.267 × MR̄.
flow-note-sizeCycleTime: X: Planning Poker / Umubare. Y: Igihe cy'umuzenguruko (iminsi). (ntibizwi): —.
time-adjustment-note: Amateka: Δ amasaha; Izina ry'ukoresha ≠ Abahawe akazi.
blockly-CANNOT_DELETE_VARIABLE_PROCEDURE: Ntibishoboka gusiba impinduragaciro '%1' kuko ari igice cy'isobanura ry'imikorere '%2'
blockly-COLOUR_BLEND_TOOLTIP: Ivanga amabara abiri hakurikijwe igipimo cyatanzwe (0.0 - 1.0).
blockly-COLOUR_RGB_TOOLTIP: Kora ibara rifite ingano yagenwe y'umutuku, icyatsi n'ubururu. Agaciro kose kagomba kuba hagati ya 0 na 100.
blockly-CONTROLS_FLOW_STATEMENTS_TOOLTIP: Simbuka ibisigaye by'iri subiramo, ukomeze ku cyiciro gikurikira.
blockly-CONTROLS_FLOW_STATEMENTS_WARNING: Umuburo: Iki gice gishobora gukoreshwa mu isubiramo gusa.
blockly-CONTROLS_FOREACH_TOOLTIP: Kuri buri kintu kiri ku rutonde, shyira impinduragaciro '%1' kuri icyo kintu, hanyuma ukore amabwiriza amwe.
blockly-CONTROLS_FOR_TITLE: bara na %1 uhereye kuri %2 kugeza kuri %3 usimbuka %4
blockly-CONTROLS_FOR_TOOLTIP: Reka impinduragaciro '%1' ifate agaciro kuva ku mubare utangira kugeza ku mubare usoza, ibara hakurikijwe intera yagenwe, kandi ukore ibice byagenwe.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_ELSEIF_TOOLTIP: Ongeraho icyangombwa ku gice cya niba.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_ELSE_TOOLTIP: Ongeraho icyangombwa cya nyuma gifata ibisigaye byose ku gice cya niba.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_IF_TOOLTIP: Ongeraho, kuraho, cyangwa usubiremo uko ibice bikurikirana kugira ngo uhindure iki gice cya niba.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_1: Niba agaciro ari ukuri, kora amabwiriza amwe.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_2: Niba agaciro ari ukuri, kora igice cya mbere cy'amabwiriza. Bitabaye ibyo, kora igice cya kabiri cy'amabwiriza.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_3: Niba agaciro ka mbere ari ukuri, kora igice cya mbere cy'amabwiriza. Bitabaye ibyo, niba agaciro ka kabiri ari ukuri, kora igice cya kabiri cy'amabwiriza.
blockly-CONTROLS_IF_TOOLTIP_4: Niba agaciro ka mbere ari ukuri, kora igice cya mbere cy'amabwiriza. Bitabaye ibyo, niba agaciro ka kabiri ari ukuri, kora igice cya kabiri cy'amabwiriza. Niba nta gaciro na kamwe ari ukuri, kora igice cya nyuma cy'amabwiriza.
blockly-CONTROLS_WHILEUNTIL_TOOLTIP_UNTI: Mu gihe agaciro ari ikinyoma, kora amabwiriza amwe.
blockly-CONTROLS_WHILEUNTIL_TOOLTIP_WHIL: Mu gihe agaciro ari ukuri, kora amabwiriza amwe.
blockly-HELP_PROMPT: Kanda %1 kugira ngo ubone ubufasha ku igenzura rya mwandikisho.
blockly-KEYBOARD_NAV_BLOCK_NAVIGATION_HI: Koresha %1 kugira ngo ugendagende imbere mu bice.
blockly-KEYBOARD_NAV_CONSTRAINED_MOVE_HI: Koresha utubuto tw'imyambi kugira ngo wimuke, hanyuma %1 kugira ngo wemeze umwanya.
blockly-KEYBOARD_NAV_FLYOUT_LABEL_HINT: Koresha utubuto tw'imyambi kugira ngo ugere ku gice, cyangwa ukande %1 kugira ngo ujye ku mutwe ukurikira.
blockly-KEYBOARD_NAV_UNCONSTRAINED_MOVE_: Fata %1 maze ukoreshe utubuto tw'imyambi kugira ngo wimuke uko ushaka, hanyuma %2 kugira ngo wemeze umwanya.
blockly-KEYBOARD_NAV_WORKSPACE_NAVIGATIO: Koresha utubuto tw'imyambi kugira ngo ugendagende.
blockly-LISTS_CREATE_EMPTY_TOOLTIP: Isubiza urutonde rufite uburebure bwa 0, rudafite amakuru
blockly-LISTS_CREATE_WITH_CONTAINER_TOOL: Ongeraho, kuraho, cyangwa usubiremo uko ibice bikurikirana kugira ngo uhindure iki gice cy'urutonde.
blockly-LISTS_CREATE_WITH_TOOLTIP: Kora urutonde rufite umubare uwo ari wo wose w'ibintu.

blockly-LISTS_GET_INDEX_TOOLTIP_GET_FROM: Isubiza ikintu kiri ku mwanya wagenwe ku rutonde.
blockly-LISTS_GET_INDEX_TOOLTIP_GET_LAST: Isubiza ikintu cya nyuma ku rutonde.

blockly-LISTS_GET_INDEX_TOOLTIP_REMOVE_F: Ikuraho ikintu cya mbere ku rutonde.
Ikuraho ikintu kiri ku mwanya wagenwe ku rutonde.
blockly-LISTS_GET_INDEX_TOOLTIP_REMOVE_L: Ikuraho ikintu cya nyuma ku rutonde.
blockly-LISTS_GET_SUBLIST_START_FIRST: fata urutonde ruto uhereye ku cya mbere
blockly-LISTS_GET_SUBLIST_START_FROM_END: fata urutonde ruto uhereye kuri # uhereye ku iherezo
blockly-LISTS_INDEX_OF_FIRST: shaka aho ikintu kibonekera bwa mbere
blockly-LISTS_INDEX_OF_LAST: shaka aho ikintu kibonekera bwa nyuma
blockly-LISTS_INDEX_OF_TOOLTIP: Isubiza umwanya ikintu kibonekeraho bwa mbere/bwa nyuma ku rutonde. Isubiza %1 niba ikintu kitabonetse.
blockly-LISTS_ISEMPTY_TOOLTIP: Isubiza ukuri niba urutonde rurimo ubusa.
blockly-LISTS_REPEAT_TITLE: kora urutonde rufite ikintu %1 gisubiwemo inshuro %2
blockly-LISTS_REPEAT_TOOLTIP: Ikora urutonde rugizwe n'agaciro katanzwe gasubiwemo inshuro zagenwe.
