blockly-LISTS_SET_INDEX_TOOLTIP_INSERT_F: Ishyira ikintu ku mwanya wagenwe ku rutonde.
blockly-LISTS_SET_INDEX_TOOLTIP_INSERT_R: Ishyira ikintu ahantu h'impanuka ku rutonde.
blockly-LISTS_SET_INDEX_TOOLTIP_SET_FIRS: Ishyiraho ikintu cya mbere ku rutonde.
blockly-LISTS_SET_INDEX_TOOLTIP_SET_FROM: Ishyiraho ikintu kiri ku mwanya wagenwe ku rutonde.
blockly-LISTS_SET_INDEX_TOOLTIP_SET_LAST: Ishyiraho ikintu cya nyuma ku rutonde.
blockly-LISTS_SORT_TYPE_IGNORECASE: hakurikijwe inyuguti, utitaye ku nyuguti nkuru n'into
blockly-LISTS_SPLIT_TOOLTIP_JOIN: Huza urutonde rw'imyandiko mu mwandiko umwe, itandukanyijwe n'igitandukanya.
blockly-LISTS_SPLIT_TOOLTIP_SPLIT: Gabanya umwandiko mu rutonde rw'imyandiko, uce kuri buri gitandukanya.
blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_EQ: Isubiza ukuri niba ibyinjijwe byombi bingana.
blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_GT: Isubiza ukuri niba icyinjijwe cya mbere kiruta icya kabiri.
blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_GTE: Isubiza ukuri niba icyinjijwe cya mbere kiruta cyangwa kingana n'icya kabiri.
blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_LT: Isubiza ukuri niba icyinjijwe cya mbere ari gito kurusha icya kabiri.
blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_LTE: Isubiza ukuri niba icyinjijwe cya mbere ari gito cyangwa kingana n'icya kabiri.
blockly-LOGIC_COMPARE_TOOLTIP_NEQ: Isubiza ukuri niba ibyinjijwe byombi bitangana.
blockly-LOGIC_NEGATE_TOOLTIP: Isubiza ukuri niba icyinjijwe ari ikinyoma. Isubiza ikinyoma niba icyinjijwe ari ukuri.
blockly-LOGIC_OPERATION_TOOLTIP_AND: Isubiza ukuri niba ibyinjijwe byombi ari ukuri.
blockly-LOGIC_OPERATION_TOOLTIP_OR: Isubiza ukuri niba nibura kimwe mu byinjijwe ari ukuri.
blockly-LOGIC_TERNARY_TOOLTIP: Genzura icyangombwa kiri muri 'igerageza'. Niba icyangombwa ari ukuri, isubiza agaciro ka 'niba ari ukuri'; bitabaye ibyo isubiza agaciro ka 'niba ari ikinyoma'.
blockly-MATH_ARITHMETIC_TOOLTIP_DIVIDE: Isubiza igisubizo cyo kugabanya imibare ibiri.
blockly-MATH_ARITHMETIC_TOOLTIP_POWER: Isubiza umubare wa mbere ushyizwe ku gipimo cy'umubare wa kabiri.
blockly-MATH_ATAN2_TOOLTIP: Isubiza arctangent y'akadomo (X, Y) muri dogere kuva kuri -180 kugeza kuri 180.
blockly-MATH_CONSTANT_TOOLTIP: Isubiza imwe mu mibare idahinduka isanzwe: π (3.141…), e (2.718…), φ (1.618…), sqrt(2) (1.414…), sqrt(½) (0.707…), cyangwa ∞ (ibitagira iherezo).
blockly-MATH_CONSTRAIN_TOOLTIP: Garukiriza umubare kugira ngo ube hagati y'imipaka yagenwe (harimo n'iyo mipaka).
blockly-MATH_IS_NEGATIVE: ni umubare uri munsi ya zeru
blockly-MATH_IS_POSITIVE: ni umubare uri hejuru ya zeru
blockly-MATH_IS_TOOLTIP: Genzura niba umubare ari igiharwe, igiharwe-tumbo, umubare w'ibanze, umubare wuzuye, uri hejuru ya zeru, uri munsi ya zeru, cyangwa niba ugabanywa n'umubare runaka. Isubiza ukuri cyangwa ikinyoma.
blockly-MATH_MODULO_TOOLTIP: Isubiza igisigara cyo kugabanya imibare ibiri.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_AVERAGE: Isubiza impuzandengo y'imibare iri ku rutonde.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_MAX: Isubiza umubare munini kurusha iyindi ku rutonde.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_MEDIAN: Isubiza umubare wo hagati ku rutonde.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_MIN: Isubiza umubare muto kurusha iyindi ku rutonde.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_MODE: Isubiza urutonde rw'ikintu (ibintu) gikunze kugaragara ku rutonde.
blockly-MATH_ONLIST_TOOLTIP_SUM: Isubiza igiteranyo cy'imibare yose iri ku rutonde.
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_FLOAT_TOOLTIP: Isubiza igice cy'impanuka hagati ya 0.0 (harimo) na 1.0 (hatarimo).
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_INT_TITLE: umubare wuzuye w'impanuka kuva kuri %1 kugeza kuri %2
blockly-MATH_RANDOM_INT_TOOLTIP: Isubiza umubare wuzuye w'impanuka hagati y'imipaka ibiri yagenwe, harimo n'iyo mipaka.
blockly-MINIMAP_ARIA_LABEL: Ikarita ntoya y'aho ukorera. Koresha utubuto tw'imyambi kugira ngo wimure aho ukorera.
blockly-NO_PARENT_ANNOUNCEMENT: Igice kiriho nta gice gikomokaho gifite
blockly-PASTE_ALL_FROM_BACKPACK: Shyiramo Ibice Byose biri mu Gikapu
blockly-PROCEDURES_CALLRETURN_TOOLTIP: Koresha imikorere '%1' yasobanuwe n'ukoresha kandi ukoreshe igisubizo cyayo.
blockly-PROCEDURES_CALL_DISABLED_DEF_WAR: Ntibishoboka gukoresha imikorere '%1' yasobanuwe n'ukoresha kuko igice cy'isobanura cyahagaritswe.
blockly-PROCEDURES_DEF_DUPLICATE_WARNING: Umuburo: Iyi mikorere ifite ibipimo bisubiramo.
blockly-PROCEDURES_IFRETURN_TOOLTIP: Niba agaciro ari ukuri, subiza agaciro ka kabiri.
blockly-PROCEDURES_IFRETURN_WARNING: Umuburo: Iki gice gishobora gukoreshwa mu isobanura ry'imikorere gusa.
blockly-PROCEDURES_MUTATORCONTAINER_TOOL: Ongeraho, kuraho, cyangwa usubiremo uko ibyinjizwa by'iyi mikorere bikurikirana.
blockly-SCREENREADER_HINT: Koresha utubuto tw'imyambi kugira ngo ugendagende. Kanda %1 kugira ngo ufungure cyangwa ufunge uburyo bw'usoma ecran.
blockly-SCREENREADER_MODE_DISABLED: Uburyo bw'usoma ecran burafunze, kanda %1 kugira ngo ubufungure
blockly-SCREENREADER_MODE_ENABLED: Uburyo bw'usoma ecran burafunguye, kanda %1 kugira ngo ubufunge
blockly-SHORTCUTS_TOGGLE_SCREENREADER_MO: Fungura cyangwa ufunge uburyo bw'usoma ecran
blockly-TEXT_CHANGECASE_TOOLTIP: Isubiza kopi y'umwandiko mu buryo butandukanye bw'inyuguti.
blockly-TEXT_CHARAT_TOOLTIP: Isubiza inyuguti iri ku mwanya wagenwe.
blockly-TEXT_COUNT_TOOLTIP: Bara inshuro umwandiko ugaragara mu wundi mwandiko.
blockly-TEXT_CREATE_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Ongeraho, kuraho, cyangwa usubiremo uko ibice bikurikirana kugira ngo uhindure iki gice cy'umwandiko.
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_END_FROM_END: kugeza ku nyuguti # uhereye ku iherezo
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FIRST: fata igice cy'umwandiko uhereye ku nyuguti ya mbere
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FROM_EN: fata igice cy'umwandiko uhereye ku nyuguti # uhereye ku iherezo
blockly-TEXT_GET_SUBSTRING_START_FROM_ST: fata igice cy'umwandiko uhereye ku nyuguti #
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_OPERATOR_FIRST: shaka aho umwandiko ubonekera bwa mbere
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_OPERATOR_LAST: shaka aho umwandiko ubonekera bwa nyuma
blockly-TEXT_INDEXOF_TOOLTIP: Isubiza umwanya umwandiko wa mbere ubonekeraho bwa mbere/bwa nyuma mu mwandiko wa kabiri. Isubiza %1 niba umwandiko utabonetse.
blockly-TEXT_ISEMPTY_TOOLTIP: Isubiza ukuri niba umwandiko watanzwe urimo ubusa.
blockly-TEXT_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Kora igice cy'umwandiko uhuza hamwe umubare uwo ari wo wose w'ibintu.
blockly-TEXT_LENGTH_TOOLTIP: Isubiza umubare w'inyuguti (harimo n'imyanya) ziri mu mwandiko watanzwe.
blockly-TEXT_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Andika umwandiko, umubare cyangwa ikindi gaciro byagenwe.
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Simbuza aho umwandiko ugaragara hose mu wundi mwandiko.
blockly-TEXT_REVERSE_TOOLTIP: Ihindukiza uko inyuguti zikurikirana mu mwandiko.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_BOTH: kuraho imyanya ku mpande zombi za
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_LEFT: kuraho imyanya ku ruhande rw'ibumoso rwa
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_OPERATOR_RIGHT: kuraho imyanya ku ruhande rw'iburyo rwa
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Isubiza kopi y'umwandiko yakuweho imyanya ku mpera imwe cyangwa zombi.
blockly-VARIABLES_SET_TOOLTIP: Ishyira iyi mpinduragaciro ku gaciro kangana n'icyinjijwe.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Impinduragaciro yitwa '%1' isanzwe ihari ku bundi bwoko: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Impinduragaciro yitwa '%1' isanzwe ihari nk'igipimo mu mikorere '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Shakisha aho ukorera. Kanda Enter ku gihuye gikurikira, Shift+Enter ku gihuye kibanza. Kanda Escape kugira ngo ufunge ishakisha kandi werekeze ku gihuye kiriho.
r-blocks-help: Huza imbarutso imwe n'igikorwa kimwe. Kurura ibice uvana mu gasanduku k'ibikoresho. Koresha umwanditsi w'ifishi ku mahitamo yisumbuye.
r-blocks-unavailable: Amakuru y'itegeko ntaboneka. Koresha umwanditsi w'ifishi kugira ngo usuzume iri tegeko.
r-blocks-invalid: Huza imbarutso imwe gusa n'igikorwa kimwe. Kuraho ibice bitahujwe cyangwa birenze mbere yo kubika.
r-blocks-conflict: Iri tegeko ryahindutse mu gihe warimo urihindura. Ongera ufungure itegeko ryabitswe mbere yo kubika.
r-blocks-permission: Uruhushya rw'umuyobozi w'ikibaho rurakenewe kugira ngo uhindure amategeko.
scrum-policy-doneLists: Ikarita iri mu rutonde rwo mu cyiciro cya Done
scrum-releases-select-help: Ikarita ishobora kuba mu masohora menshi. Fata Ctrl (Cmd kuri Mac) kugira ngo uhitemo arenze rimwe; yakureho yose kugira ngo ukure ikarita mu masohora yose.
scrum-select-sprint: Hitamo sprint kugira ngo urebe raporo yayo.
scrum-backlog-help: Tondeka akazi hakurikijwe urwego mu bitegereje. Ha amakarita sprint iteganyijwe cyangwa iri gukora.
scrum-no-closed-sprints: Nta foto ya sprint yafunzwe iboneka.
scrum-report-help: Raporo zigumana igereranya ryo mu mafoto ya sprint. Igereranya ritazwi ribarwa ukwaryo; si igereranya rya zeru. Gereranya umuvuduko gusa hagati y'ibipimo by'igereranya na politiki bihuye.
scrum-confirm-close: Gufunga iyi sprint no kubika ibyavuyemo? Amakarita atarangiye azimurirwa aho watoranyije.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Guhagarika iyi sprint? Amakarita yayo agumana ubunyamuryango kugeza ahawe ahandi.
scrum-list-category: Icyiciro cy'urujya n'uruza rw'akazi rwa Scrum
scrum-partial-report: Raporo ituzuye: amakarita wahawe ubu gusa ni yo arimo.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Iyi sprint irimo igice gusa cy'ifoto y'umwimerere.
scrum-rollover-progress: Kwimura amakarita ya sprint imbere: __done__ muri __total__
scrum-history-job-running: Gusubiza inyuma cyangwa kongera gukora impinduka nini: __done__ mu mirongo y’amateka __total__
scrum-history-job-failed: Gusubiza inyuma cyangwa kongera gukora impinduka nini byahagaze. Ongera ukande gusubiza inyuma cyangwa kongera gukora kugira ngo ukomeze:
scrum-daily-observations: Ibigize akazi bya buri munsi n'akazi gasigaye (ibyagaragaye)
scrum-daily-observations-help: Buri murongo werekana icyagaragaye cya mbere cyanditswe ku munsi wa UTC, ku isaha yerekanwa. Iminsi ibura ntigaragazwa. Ibi byagaragaye ntibyandika buri mpinduka cyangwa ngo byerekane igiteranyo cyo ku iherezo ry'umunsi. Igereranya ritazwi si zeru. Koresha igikorwa cya Sohora cy'iki gice ku byagaragaye bya buri munsi; igikorwa cya Sohora cyo ku murongo w'ibikoresho gisohora ibyavuye muri sprint.
scrum-daily-truncated: Ibyagaragaye 366 biheruka gusa ni byo byerekanwa.
scrum-daily-empty: Nta byagaragaye bya buri munsi byanditswe kuri iyi sprint.
scrum-scope-history: Ingano y’akazi n’akazi gasigaye, kuri buri mpinduka
scrum-scope-history-help: Byongeye kubakwa hifashishijwe amateka y’ikibaho kuva sprint itangiye: umurongo umwe kuri buri mpinduka ku makarita ya sprint, ku bigereranyo cyangwa ku kazi karangiye.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Amateka ntashobora kongera gukora ishusho y’imiterere ya sprint ubwayo: impinduka zimwe zakozwe zitanditswe mu mateka, bityo ibi bipimo ntibyuzuye.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Impinduka za mbere gusa ni zo zashoboye gusomwa; kongera kubaka ntibyuzuye.
scrum-scope-history-empty: Nta mpinduka zabaye kuva sprint itangiye.
scrum-scope-cause-lifecycle: Ikarita yashyizwe mu bubiko cyangwa yagaruwe
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Icyagaragaye cya mbere cyanditswe kuri buri munsi wa UTC; iminsi ibura ntigaragazwa. Ibyagaragaye ntibyandika buri mpinduka cyangwa igiteranyo cyo ku iherezo ry'umunsi. Igereranya ritazwi si zeru.
scrum-import-pending: Kwinjiza Scrum ntikurarangira. Guhindura Scrum no gusohora raporo ntibiboneka.
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Kwinjiza kwahagaritswe no kongera gutangiza bishobora gusozwa hano nyuma yo guhagarara. Niba gahunda yabyo itarabitswe yose, bishobora gusa guhagarikwa; ibyo nta cyo bihindura ku kibaho.
scrum-import-into-board: Injiza igenamigambi rya Scrum muri iki kibaho
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Hitamo isohora ry'ikibaho cya WeKan cyangwa dosiye yo kwimura Scrum. Sprints n'amasohora iki kibaho gisanzwe gifite birahuzwa, ntibikorerwa kopi. Amakarita ahuzwa hakurikijwe ID, cyangwa nimero y'ikarita n'umutwe; amakarita adahuye arandikwa kandi ntahindurwa. Banza urebe mbere kugira ngo umenye ibizahinduka.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Sprints: __created__ nshya, __matched__ zisanzwe kuri iki kibaho, __skipped__ zitinjijwe
scrum-import-preview-releases: Amasohora: __created__ mashya, __matched__ asanzwe kuri iki kibaho, __skipped__ atinjijwe
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Nta cyo guhindura: iki kibaho gisanzwe gifite iri genamigambi.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Igenamigambi rya Scrum ryinjijwe kandi ryanditswe mu Mateka.
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Ikarita ihuye n'amakarita arenze imwe kuri iki kibaho: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Ikarita ni iy'ikindi kibaho kandi ntiyahinduwe: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: Sprint cyangwa isohora bihuye n'ibirenze kimwe kuri iki kibaho: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: Sprint, isohora cyangwa igikorwa ntibyashoboye kwinjizwa: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Hitamo agaciro kuri buri kimbirane. Sync yongera kugerageza nyuma ya buri hitamo. Nta kintu cyoherezwa kuri sisitemu y'inkomoko.
sync-conflict-refresh: Ongera ukoreshe Sync kugira ngo usuzume agaciro kariho.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Amakarita wahawe yasuzumwe. Nta makimbirane y'imyanya asigaye. Sync y'urutonde rwose ntiyakozwe.
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Kuraho gusa ihuza rya Sync ry'iyi kopi. Ibiyirimo bigumana muri WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Kujyana mu Bubiko byabujijwe n'amakarita mato akiri gukora
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Ikintu cy'inkomoko cyavuyeho, ariko amakarita mato akiri gukora abuza kujyana mu Bubiko. Gumana iyi karita hano ukuraho ihuza ryayo rya Sync. Amakarita mato ntahindurwa.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Gumana ikarita yabanje uko iri maze ukore ikarita nshya ya Sync muri uru rutonde. Kongera kugerageza bikoresha iyo isimbura.
sync-preview-saved: Bishingiye ku igenamiterere ryabitswe. Sync nonaha izana kandi ikongera kugenzura inkomoko.
sync-preview-unavailable: Bika inkomoko ya Sync mbere yo gusaba irebamberere.
sync-preview-blocked: Kemura amakimbirane ari hasi mbere yo gusuzuma igenamigambi ry'impinduka.
sync-preview-scope: Imibare yerekeza ku myanya y'inkomoko yatunganyijwe. Andi makuru ashobora gusigwa n'usesengura inkomoko.
sync-source-heading: Imyanya y'inkomoko idakopororwa mu buryo butaziguye
sync-source-scope: Inzira zishyira hamwe aho imyanya igaragara mu bintu by'inkomoko. Ibintu bidahujwe bitangazwa byose hamwe; agaciro kabyo ntikerekanwa.
sync-source-occurrences: Aho imyanya cyangwa ibintu byagaragaye byatangajwe
sync-source-truncated: Raporo igarukira ku nzira 100 n'amazina y'imyanya yagabanyijwe.
sync-report-partial: Sync zanze cyangwa zitarangiye zishobora kuba zarahinduye amakarita amwe. Izi raporo ntizikomeza cyangwa ngo zisibe Sync.
sync-report-unfinished: Birimo gukorwa cyangwa byahagaze; ibyavuyemo ntibyanditswe
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Byarangiye hari imyanya yasizwe cyangwa yahinduwe
sync-report-unavailable: Raporo za Sync zisaba uburenganzira bwo kwandika ku rutonde rwose na seriveri iboneka.
sync-recovery-description: Raporo za Sync zabitswe zo mu minsi 30 ishize. Shakisha ukoresheje ID y'ikibaho cyangwa y'urutonde. Ibitararangiye bishobora kuba bigikorwa cyangwa byarahagaze. Ongera ufungure kugira ngo wongere urebe; izi raporo ntizishobora gukomeza cyangwa gusiba impinduka.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gusoma isuzuma rya Sync. Genzura uburenganzira bw'umuyobozi n'uko seriveri iboneka.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Hitamo umwanya w'imibare ufite ID y'umwanya wa Jira n'igipimo cy'igereranya, nk'uko wakozwe n'iyinjiza rya Jira ryahujwe. Impinduka zo hano zisuzumwa nk'amakimbirane. Agaciro k'inkomoko kabura kirengagizwa; null yeruye isiba agaciro kahujwe.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Uburemere cyangwa ikigereranyo cy’igihe cya GitLab byandikwa mu mwanya w’imibare wahisemo. Impinduka zo muri sisitemu yawe zisuzumwa nk’amakimbirane; ikibazo kidafite uburemere gisiba agaciro gahujwe na cyo.
email-recovery-description: Umurongo umwe kuri buri wakira. Shakisha ukoresheje ID y'ukoresha. Ibiri mu butumwa n'imyanya ya imeyili y'uwakira ntibyerekanwa. Guhagarika by'akanya bifata ubutumwa busanzwe n'ubuzaza; Gukomeza byongera kugerageza kohereza ubutumwa buri ku murongo ubu. Guhagarika burundu bikuraho ubutumwa bwashyizwe ku murongo kugeza igihe cy'ubusabe. Niba kohereza bikiri gukorwa, ongera ugerageze mu kanya. Ubutumwa bwatangiye koherezwa ntibushobora kugarurwa, kandi kohereza kutazwi neza uko kwagenze gushobora gusubirwamo. Ibitaragenze neza burundu n'ubutumwa bwageze ku mubare ntarengwa w'igerageza bigumaho kugira ngo bisuzumwe. Kongera kugerageza ubutumwa butoherejwe neza bitangira icyiciro gishya cy'igerageza kandi bikomeza kubahiriza ihagarikwa ry'akanya risanzwe.
email-recovery-attempts: Umubare munini kurusha indi wo kongera kugerageza
email-recovery-oldest: Igihe bwashyiriwe ku murongo bwa mbere
email-recovery-cancel: Hagarika burundu ubutumwa buri ku murongo
email-recovery-empty: Nta butumwa buri ku murongo kandi nta bakira bahagarikiwe koherezwa by'akanya.
email-recovery-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gusoma umurongo wa imeyili. Reba uburenganzira bw'umuyobozi n'uko seriveri iboneka.
email-recovery-busy: Kohereza cyangwa ikindi gikorwa cy'umurongo birakorwa. Vugurura hanyuma wongere ugerageze mu kanya.
email-recovery-failed: Igikorwa nticyashoboye kwemezwa. Vugurura umurongo kandi wongere ugerageze igikorwa kimwe niba bikenewe.
email-recovery-superseded: Igikorwa gishya cy'ushinzwe ibikorwa cyasimbuye ubu busabe. Harerekanwa uko umurongo umeze ubu.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Guhagarika burundu ubutumwa bwose buri ku murongo ubu bugenewe uyu wakira? Ibirimo bizakurwaho kandi ntibishobora kugarurwa. Ubutumwa bushya bwakozwe nyuma y'ubu busabe buzagumaho.
email-recovery-retry: Ongera ugerageze kohereza ubutumwa butoherejwe neza
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Kugeza ntibyashoboye kwemezwa; suzuma mbere yo kongera kugerageza
sync-time-estimate-hint: Igereranya ry'igihe rikoresha imyanya y'imibare y'igihe cy'umwimerere/gisigaye yakozwe n'iyinjiza rya Jira. Hagomba kubaho umwanya umwe gusa uhuye kuri iki kibaho. Impinduka zo hano zisuzumwa nk'amakimbirane; agaciro k'inkomoko kabura kirengagizwa naho null yeruye isiba agaciro.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint n'amasohora bihuzwa gusa iyo Scrum ifunguye kuri iki kibaho. Sprint cyangwa isohora bibura bikorwa kuri iki kibaho, n'amatariki inkomoko itanga; ibisanzwe bihari bihuzwa mbere na mbere hakurikijwe ID y'inkomoko, hanyuma izina. Impinduka y'igenamigambi yo hano igumaho kugeza inkomoko ihinduye igenamigambi ry'icyo kibazo, kandi Sync ya mbere ntijya ikuraho igenamigambi.
activity-recovery-description: Amamenyesha atarangiye yongera kugeragezwa ku buryo bwikora. Suzuma ibikorwa bibura cyangwa byahindutse mbere yo kongera kugerageza. Kongera kugerageza ntikugarura igikorwa.
activity-recovery-busy: Undi mukozi arimo gukemura iri menyesha. Ongera ufungure maze wongere ugerageze.
activity-recovery-denied: Uburenganzira bw'uwakira cyangwa ibyo yahisemo ku mamenyesha ntibikemera kugeza.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Igikorwa cy'umwimerere kirabura cyangwa cyarahindutse. Nta kintu cyongeye gukorwa.
activity-recovery-failed: Ntibishoboka kurangiza kugeza amamenyesha. Akazi gategereje karabitswe.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Iri menyesha ryahindutse kuva ryafungurwa. Suzuma uko rimeze ubu mbere yo kongera kugerageza.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Ntibishoboka kwemeza igenamiterere ryo kugeza. Ongera ufungure maze usuzume uko rimeze ubu.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Guhagarika burundu kugeza gusigaye kw'iki gikorwa? Ntibishobora gukomezwa. Imeyili zamaze gushyirwa ku murongo n'amamenyesha yamaze kugezwa ntibigarurwa.
rule-email-recovery-description: Suzuma igerageza ryanditswe ryo kohereza imeri z'amategeko. Igerageza ritaremezwa rishobora kuba rigikomeza kohereza cyangwa ryarahagaritswe. Fungura rimwe ukoresheje "Suzuma" kugira ngo uryohereze bundi bushya, urishyireho ko ryoherejwe cyangwa urihagarike.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Nta gerageza ryo kohereza imeri z'amategeko rihuye n'iri shakisha.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gufungura igerageza rya imeyili z'amategeko. Ongera ufungure kugira ngo wongere ugerageze.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan ntizigera yongera kohereza ubwayo imeri itaremezwa. Kongera kohereza bikorwa ku bakira batararemezwa gusa. Niba uzi ko yageze, shyiraho ko yoherejwe, cyangwa uhagarike kuyohereza.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Kohereza kwa mbere bishobora kuba bigikomeje. Ushobora gufata icyemezo nyuma ya __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Wongere wohereze iyi meri ku bakira batararemezwa? Uwo seriveri ye y'imeri yakiriye ubutumwa ariko ntiyamenyeshe WeKan azabwakira kabiri.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Ushyireho ko iyi meri yoherejwe kuri bose? Kora ibi gusa niba uzi ko yageze.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Uhagarike kohereza iyi meri? Ntizoherezwa ku bakira batararemezwa.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Kohereza kwa mbere bishobora kuba bigikomeje. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Kongera kohereza kwabanje bishobora kuba bigikomeje. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Abakira bose bamaze kwemezwa. Ahubwo shyiraho ko yoherejwe.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Seriveri y'imeri ntiyasubije. Ubutumwa bwongeye koherezwa bushobora kuba bwageze cyangwa butageze; bwerekanwa nk'ubukiri koherezwa.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Undi muyobozi arimo gukemura iyi meri. Ongera ugerageze mu kanya.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imeri yabitswe ntikijyanye n'iri gerageza, bityo ntishobora gukemurwa hano.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Inyandiko yabitswe y'iri gerageza ntiyemewe, bityo ntishobora gukemurwa hano.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Iyi meri ntiyashoboye gukemurwa. Vugurura urupapuro wongere ugerageze.
rule-email-legacy-description: Izi meri z'amategeko zateguwe na verisiyo ya kera ya WeKan itandikaga aho ibizikubiyemo byaturutse, bityo WeKan ntizizohereza ubwayo. Nyuma yo kugenzura ko uwanditse itegeko agifite uburenganzira bwo kugera ku ikarita, ongera uhuze imeri kugira ngo yongere gutegurwa hakurikijwe uko ikarita imeze ubu, cyangwa uyijugunye.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Ibisobanuro by'ikarita byo muri verisiyo ya kera
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Wongere utegure iyi meri ukurikije uko ikarita imeze ubu? Ibiyikubiyemo bishobora gutandukana n'ibyateguwe mbere.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Imeri z'amategeko zitegereje gusuzumwa ntizashoboye gufungurwa. Vugurura urupapuro wongere ugerageze.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Uwanditse itegeko ntakifite uburenganzira bwo kugera kuri iyi karita, cyangwa itegeko ryarahindutse, bityo imeri ntishobora kongera guhuzwa. Ushobora kuyijugunya.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Igikorwa cyatumye iyi meri itegurwa cyarahindutse, bityo ntishobora kongera guhuzwa. Ushobora kuyijugunya.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Ikarita iyi meri yaturutseho ntikiboneka, bityo ntishobora kongera guhuzwa. Ushobora kuyijugunya.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Iyubahirizwa ry'itegeko ryateguye iyi meri ntirikibitswe, bityo ntishobora kongera guhuzwa. Ushobora kuyijugunya.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Iyi meri yamaze koherezwa, hageragejwe kuyohereza, cyangwa yarajugunywe.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Iki gikorwa nticyashoboye kurangira. Vugurura urupapuro wongere ugerageze.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Ibikorwa bya Sync y'Urutonde bidashobora kongera gukorwa
stuck-sync-operation-description: Buri gikorwa muri ibi bya Sync y'Urutonde byabitswe cyahagaze kigeze hagati kandi ntigishobora kurangizwa, kuko urutonde rwacyo rwakuweho, rwongeye gukorwa cyangwa rwahinduriwe igenamiterere, cyangwa ukoresha wagitangije yatakaje uburenganzira bwo kwandika. Mu gihe kimwe gitegereje, urwo rutonde ntirushobora gukora Sync. Gikureho kugira ngo urutonde rwongere rukore Sync: impinduka zamaze gushyirwamo zigumaho, impinduka zisigaye zabitswe ntizizigera zandikwa, kandi Sync ikurikira yongera kugereranya urutonde n'inkomoko yarwo.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Urutonde rwakuweho, rwongeye gukorwa cyangwa igenamiterere ryarwo rya Sync ryarahindutse
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Ukoresha wagitangije ntakigira uburenganzira bwo kwandika ku rutonde rwose
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Cyabitswe na verisiyo ya WeKan ya kera hatanditswe icyagitangije
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Gishobora kongera gukorwa ubu kandi kizirangiza ubwacyo, bityo ntigishobora gukurwaho.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Gukuraho iki gikorwa cya Sync y'Urutonde cyabitswe? Impinduka cyamaze gushyiramo zigumaho; izisigaye ntizizigera zandikwa. Urutonde ruzashobora kongera gukora Sync.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Nta bikorwa bya Sync y'Urutonde bitegereje gusuzumwa.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: 50 bya kera cyane gusa ni byo byerekanwa. Kuraho bimwe maze wongere ufungure kugira ngo ubone ibindi.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gufungura ibikorwa bya Sync y'Urutonde. Ongera ufungure kugira ngo wongere ugerageze.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Iki gikorwa ntikiraboneka ko cyahagaze, bityo ntigishobora gukurwaho.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Iki gikorwa gishobora kongera gukorwa ubu kandi kizirangiza ubwacyo, bityo nticyakuweho.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Uru rutonde rurimo gukora Sync ubu. Ongera ugerageze mu kanya.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Iki gikorwa nticyashoboye kurangira. Vugurura urupapuro wongere ugerageze.
interrupted-import-description: Buri kwinjiza ikibaho muri aya kwahagaze kugeze hagati - seriveri yongeye gutangira, cyangwa kwinjiza kwanze - kandi kwasize ikibaho kituzuye. Kwinjiza ntikushobora gukomezwa, kuko dosiye y'inkomoko yako itabikwa. Gumana ikibaho uko kiri, cyangwa ugikureho maze wongere winjize dosiye. Gukuraho bisiba ikibaho uku kwinjiza kwakoze n'ibikiriho byose, harimo n'ibyacyongeweho nyuma.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Birimo gukurwaho; ongera ukureho kugira ngo birangire
interrupted-import-scrum: Icyiciro cyako cya Scrum gifite aho kibikirwa hacyo (__state__, intambwe __next__ kuri __total__). Niba ugumanye ikibaho, rangiza cyangwa ukureho uvuye mu kugarura iyinjiza rya Scrum ry'ikibaho.
interrupted-import-counts: Imirongo __swimlanes__, intonde __lists__, amakarita __cards__, intonde zo kugenzura __checklists__, ibitekerezo __comments__, imigereka __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Gumana iki kibaho kituzuye uko kiri? Nta kintu gikurwaho, kandi kwinjiza ntikuzongera kugaragara hano.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Gukuraho uku kwinjiza? Ikibaho kwakoze n'ibikiriho byose bisibwa burundu.
interrupted-import-empty: Nta kwinjiza ibibaho kwahagaze gutegereje gusuzumwa.
interrupted-import-truncated: 50 bya kera cyane gusa ni byo byerekanwa. Gumana cyangwa ukureho bimwe maze wongere ufungure kugira ngo ubone ibindi.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Ntibishoboka gufungura kwinjiza ibibaho kwahagaze. Ongera ufungure kugira ngo wongere ugerageze.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Ikibaho gifite iyi id ntikyakozwe n'uku kwinjiza, bityo nticyakozweho.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Icyiciro cyako cya Scrum kiracyandikwa cyangwa kigarurwa. Ongera ugerageze nyuma y'iminota mike.
interrupted-import-failed: Iki gikorwa nticyashoboye kurangira. Vugurura urupapuro wongere ugerageze.
saml-login-not-started: Uku kwinjira ukoresheje SAML ntikwatangiriye muri iyi tabi ya mushakisha. Ongera winjire.
history-request-pending-undo: Seriveri ntiremeza gusubiza inyuma impinduka yawe ya nyuma.
history-request-pending-redo: Seriveri ntiremeza kongera gukora impinduka yawe ya nyuma.
history-request-hint: Kongera kugerageza bisubiramo ubusabe bumwe, bityo ntibishobora na rimwe gusubiza inyuma indi mpinduka.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Gusiba, gusubiramo cyangwa kugarura impinduka za Scrum byahagaze kubera amakimbirane. Guhindura Scrum kuri iki kibaho birabujijwe kugeza bikemuwe.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Impinduka __applied__ kuri __total__ zanditswe, __pending__ ntizanditswe, naho __conflicted__ zahinduwe n'undi muntu kuva icyo gihe.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Gusubiza inyuma bisubiza buri nyandiko yahindutse uko yari iri mbere; bitangwa gusa iyo nta wundi wahinduye izo nyandiko kuva icyo gihe. Kugumana ikibaho uko kiri bikuraho igikorwa cyahagaze kandi ntibihindura inyandiko. Uko byagenda kose, byandikwa mu Buyobozi, Ibibazo, Kugarura.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Gumana buri nyandiko uko iri ubu, harimo n'impinduka igikorwa cyahagaze cyamaze kwandika?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Umuyobozi w'ikibaho ashobora kubisubiza inyuma cyangwa kugumana ikibaho uko kiri.
login-setting-after-restart: Bitangira gukora nyuma yo kongera gutangiza WeKan
login-setting-env-only: Ibidukikije bya seriveri gusa ni byo bishyiraho ibi. Byerekanwa hano ku buryo bwo gusoma gusa.
email-to-card-description: Imeyili yoherejwe kuri aderesi y'ikibaho cyawe ihinduka ikarita kuri icyo kibaho.
email-to-card-webhook: URL ya webhook yinjira y'utanga imeyili (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark cyangwa MIME relay idatunganyijwe)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Byabitswe - siga ubusa kugira ngo rigumeho
email-to-card-imap-accounts: Agasanduku k'iposita ka IMAP ko gusoma
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Ikibaho imeyili yoherejwe kuri iyi grain ijyaho
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Nta na kimwe - imeyili zifite ikimenyetso cy'ikibaho mu ngingo gusa
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Shyira ibi mu ngingo kugira ngo ugere kuri iki kibaho mu izina ryawe:
email-to-card-address-private: Yigumane mu ibanga: uwo ari we wese uyifite ashobora kongeraho amakarita mu izina ryawe.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Umuyobozi w'ikibaho ntiyafunguye imeyili kuri iki kibaho.
email-to-card-off-member-off: Wazimije aderesi z'ibibaho byawe mu Igenamiterere ry'umunyamuryango.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain ntiragira aderesi imeyili yayo. Ongera ufungure urupapuro.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Ukeneye uburenganzira bwo kwandika kuri iki kibaho.
inbound-domain-invalid: Iryo si izina rya domeni ryemewe.
inbound-account-invalid: Agasanduku k'iposita ka IMAP gakeneye izina rya seriveri ryemewe.
feature-views-email-desc: Ikibaho nk'agasanduku k'iposita: urutonde rw'imeyili ni Izinjiye, intonde ni ububiko, ibirango ni ibirango, abanyamuryango bandika kandi basubiza imeyili bakoresheje aderesi y'ikibaho.
email-view-not-receiving: Iki kibaho ntikirakira imeyili. Gifungure mu Igenamiterere ry'imenyesha ry'ikibaho → Imeyili ijya ku ikarita.
email-view-invalid-address: Imwe muri aderesi si aderesi y'imeyili yemewe.
email-view-too-many: Imeyili nyinshi cyane zoherejwe mu isaha ishize. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
feature-views-chat-desc: Ikibaho nk'umwanya w'ikiganiro: imyanya y'akazi, ibibaho, imirongo, intonde n'amakarita nk'igiti cy'imiyoboro, ikarita hagati n'ibitekerezo byayo nk'ubutumwa bw'ikiganiro.
chat-view-pick-card: Hitamo ikarita mu miyoboro kugira ngo uyibone hano.
chat-view-no-messages: Nta butumwa buraba. Andika ubwa mbere.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Amakarita amwe mu matsinda menshi y'inkingi afite amazina - hakurikijwe kurangira, ibyihutirwa, intambwe cyangwa ikindi icyo ari cyo cyose - yimurwa hagati y'inkingi uyakurura.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menu y'ikibaho → Amategeko atanga amategeko ashingiye ku byo abantu bakora n'intoki kenshi.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menu y'ikibaho → Incamake yerekana ibyo buri muntu yakoze ku kibaho ku munsi cyangwa mu cyumweru giheruka, n'ibyarengeje igihe.
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menu y'ikibaho → Kuva wasura ubwa nyuma herekana ibyo abandi bahinduye ku kibaho.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Gushakisha hose kumva interuro nka "amakarita yanjye yarengeje igihe".
column-sets-empty: Nta matsinda y'inkingi arahari. Umuyobozi w'ikibaho ashobora gukora rimwe: urihe izina, hanyuma wongereho inkingi zaryo.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Ikibaho nk'ikurikirana ry'ibibazo bya GitHub cyangwa Gitea: amakarita nk'ibibazo, ibirango n'intambwe, ibitekerezo nk'ikiganiro, imigereka nka dosiye, n'amateka y'ikibaho hamwe no gusubiza inyuma.
vcs-no-milestones: Nta ntambwe irahari. Ikirango gifite itariki ntarengwa ni intambwe.
vcs-no-list: Iki kibaho nta rutonde cyangwa inzira gifite ku kibazo.
card-qr-code-desc: Yisikane kugira ngo ufungure iyi karita kuri telefoni cyangwa tabuleti.
card-qr-code-too-long: Ihuza ry'iyi karita ni rirerire cyane kuri kode ya QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Nta wiki iraboneka. Kwinjiza ikigo cya GitHub bizana hano wiki y'ububiko bwa kode.
github-org-import-desc: Buri bubiko bwa kode bw'ikigo cyangwa bw'ukoresha buhinduka ikibaho cyabwo, gifunguwe muri Board View / Version Control: ibibazo byabwo n'ibitekerezo, ibirango n'amadosiye byabyo, ibisohowe byabwo, imigendekere y'akazi ya GitHub Actions nk'Amategeko, na wiki yabwo.
github-org-import-token-hint: Irakenewe ku bubiko bwigenga no ku rugero rwa API rwisumbuye. Ikoreshwa gusa igihe kwinjiza birimo gukorwa kandi ntibikwa na rimwe.
github-org-import-actions: Imigendekere y'akazi ya GitHub Actions nk'Amategeko
github-org-import-result: Ibibazo %s, ibisohowe %s, amategeko %s, impapuro za wiki %s
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Andika izina ry'ikigo cyangwa ry'ukoresha, cyangwa aderesi yaryo ya GitHub.
optional-apis-desc: API za REST zifite isura ya API z'izindi sisitemu zikurikirana ibibazo, kugira ngo porogaramu zazo n'inyandiko-porogaramu zazo zishobore gukoresha iyi WeKan nk'inyuma yazo: ibyo zibika bibikwa muri WeKan, ku bibaho bya WeKan. Buri imwe irafunze kugeza ishyizweho akamenyetso hano. Nta n'imwe ifite uburenganzira bwayo bwite: umukiliya yinjira akoresheje token ya API ya WeKan, kandi ashobora kubona no guhindura gusa ibyo uwo muntu ashobora kubona no guhindura muri WeKan. Zose zisaba ko REST API ya WeKan iba ifunguye (WITH_API=true). Aderesi iri munsi ya buri imwe ni yo umukiliya akoresha nka seriveri ye.
optional-api-trello-desc: Porogaramu n'inyandiko-porogaramu zandikiwe REST API ya Trello (urugero Trellinator) zikora na WeKan: ibibaho, intonde, amakarita, ibirango, abanyamuryango, ibitekerezo n'intonde zo kugenzura. Token ya Trello ni token ya API ya WeKan. Gusiba ikarita biyijyana mu bubiko muri WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Abakiliya ba REST API v2 ya Jira bakora na WeKan: umushinga ni ikibaho (urufunguzo rwawo ni urufunguzo rw'ikibaho), ikibazo ni ikarita (DEV-7), imimerere ni urutonde, kandi inzibacyuho yimura ikarita. Gushakisha byakira JQL yoroshye: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text na ORDER BY. Injira ukoresheje token ya API ya WeKan nk'ijambo ry'ibanga. Gusiba ikibazo bikijyana mu bubiko.
optional-api-github-desc: Abakiliya ba REST API ya GitHub y'ibibazo bakora na WeKan: ububiko bwa kode ni ikibaho, ikibazo ni ikarita, gifite ibirango, intambwe (ibirango bifite itariki ntarengwa), ibitekerezo, kandi gifunguye cyangwa gifunze nko muri Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara / Igenzura ry'amaverisiyo. Token ni token ya API ya WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Abakiliya ba REST API ya Gitea na Forgejo y'ibibazo bakora na WeKan, kimwe na API ihuye na GitHub: ububiko bwa kode ni ikibaho kandi ikibazo ni ikarita. Token ni token ya API ya WeKan.
bots-none: Nta robo ziraba. Robo ni igikoresho gikora kuri seriveri yawe bwite - umukozi wa AI, akazi ka CI, inyandiko-porogaramu - iki kibaho giha amakarita.
bot-not-found: Iyo robo ntiri kuri iki kibaho.
bot-option-not-found: Icyo gisubizo si kimwe mu byo robo yatanze.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhooks zisohoka ntizishobora kugera kuri aderesi ziri ku murandasi bwite wa WeKan, kugira ngo hatagira umuntu werekeza webhook y'ikibaho kuri serivisi y'imbere. Andika hano host ziri kuri uwo murandasi webhooks zemerewe kugeraho - Node-RED, seriveri y'ibiganiro - imwe ku murongo, nk'izina cyangwa aderesi, hamwe n'icyambu kugira ngo hemererwe icyo cyambu gusa. Ubusa: nta na kimwe. Abayobozi b'urubuga bonyine ni bo bashobora guhindura uru rutonde.
account-webhook-desc: Aderesi imwe WeKan imenyesha iyo umuntu yinjiye cyangwa konti nshya ikozwe. Nta kintu cyoherezwa kugeza igikorwa kiri hasi gishyizweho akamenyetso. Itwara igikorwa, izina ry'ukoresha n'igihe; shyira akamenyetso ku yindi myanya ari uko uwakira ayikeneye gusa.
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Hagarika amamenyesha yose ategereje y'ibikorwa bimaze iminsi ingahe?
vcs-synced-from: Byahujwe biturutse kuri %s: bifungure kandi ubifunge aho.
vcs-synced-issue: Iki kibazo kirahujwe: gifungure kandi ugifunge mu gikurikirana cyacyo.
sync-write-back: Andika impinduka usubize kuri GitLab: umutwe, ibisobanuro, ibitekerezo, gufunga no kongera gufungura
email-bounces-description: Ibyo WeKan ikora ku meli zigaruka: aderesi yanditswe nabi, agasanduku kuzuye, igisubizo cy'uko umuntu adahari, ikirego cya spam. Ubwoko bwose bufite ibikorwa byabwo, bikorwa iyo bwagarutse inshuro nk'izo.
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Guhagarika kohereza imeli kuri iyo aderesi
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Aderesi ntibaho: ikosa ryo kwandika, konti yasibwe, domeni itazwi.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Ntiyagezeyo ubu: agasanduku kuzuye, seriveri irahuze. Izinshi zikurikiranye gusa ni zo zivuga ikintu.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Ibisubizo by'uko adahari, ari mu kiruhuko cyangwa by'uburyo bw'amatike. Imeli yageze.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Uwakiriye yashyize imeli mu za spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Muri Amazon SES, ohereza amatangazo ya Bounce na Complaint, n'itegeko ryo kwakira rya aderesi WeKan yoherezaho, ku nsanganyamatsiko ya SNS, hanyuma wiyandikishe iyi aderesi kuri yo ukoresheje HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN z'insanganyamatsiko za SNS zemewe, imwe ku murongo
email-bounces-clear-hint: Kwibagirwa ibigaruka by'iyi aderesi no kongera kuyoherereza imeli
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Icyo si ARN y'insanganyamatsiko ya SNS.
email-bounces-providers-description: Niba WeKan yohereza inyuze kuri imwe muri izi serivisi, yifungure, uhe iyo serivisi iyi aderesi ya webhook ku byabaye byayo bya meli zagarutse n'ibirego bya spam, hanyuma ushyire hano urufunguzo isinyisha, cyangwa ijambobanga washyize muri aderesi nka https://user:password@… cyangwa ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Serivisi ifunguye ikeneye urufunguzo rwayo rwo gusinya cyangwa ijambobanga.
activity-pub-enabled: Ibibaho rusange bitangaza ibikorwa by'amakarita yabyo kuri fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Bisanzwe bifunze. Iyo bifunguye, buri kibaho rusange gishobora gukurikirwa kuva kuri Mastodon n'izindi seriveri za fediverse nka @board-<id> kuri aderesi y'iyi WeKan, kandi ibikorwa bishya by'amakarita bigera ku bagikurikira. Ni ibyo gusoma gusa: nta kintu seriveri ya fediverse yohereza gihindura ikibaho, kandi ibibaho bwite ntibitangazwa na rimwe.
caldav-sync-desc: Shyira amatariki ntarengwa y'amakarita y'iki kibaho muri kalendari - Nextcloud Calendar cyangwa kalendari iyo ari yo yose ya CalDAV. Itariki ntarengwa yimuriwe muri kalendari isubira ku ikarita. Koresha ijambobanga rya porogaramu, si iryawe bwite.
caldav-invalid-url: Aderesi ya kalendari igomba kuba aderesi ya http:// cyangwa https://, nta zina ry'ukoresha cyangwa ijambobanga birimo.
caldav-not-linked: Banza ubike aderesi ya kalendari kandi ufungure guhuza.
webdav-storage-description: Bika imigereka mu bubiko bwa dosiye kuri seriveri ya WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud cyangwa indi iyo ari yo yose. Koresha ijambobanga rya porogaramu ryakorewe WeKan. Seriveri iri ku muyoboro wa WeKan ubwayo ishobora gukoreshwa hano, kuko umuyobozi w'urubuga wenyine ari we ushyiraho iyi aderesi.
sqrl-desc: Bisanzwe bizimije. Iyo bifunguwe, urupapuro rwo kwinjira rutanga SQRL, kandi abanyamuryango babanza kongeraho umwirondoro wabo wa SQRL mu Igenamiterere ry'umunyamuryango. SQRL ikenera ko WeKan iba kuri aderesi ya https://.
sqrl-scan: Sikana kode ukoresheje porogaramu yawe ya SQRL, cyangwa ufungure umukiriya wawe wa SQRL kuri iki gikoresho.
sqrl-expired: Iyi kode ya SQRL yarangiye. Ongera utangire.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL ikenera ko WeKan iba kuri aderesi ya https://.
sqrl-description: Injira ukoresheje umwirondoro wawe wa SQRL aho gukoresha ijambobanga. Wongereho hano rimwe ukoresheje umukiriya wawe wa SQRL; ushobora kuwukuraho hano igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Kwinjira ukoresheje SQRL kuri iyi konti byahagaritswe n'umukiriya wawe wa SQRL. Bisubize ho aho ngaho ukoresheje kode yawe yo gutabara.
sqrl-only-on: Umukiriya wawe wa SQRL yafunze iyi konti kuri SQRL gusa: ubundi buryo bwose bwo kwinjira buranzwe.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Umukiriya wawe wa SQRL yafunze iyi konti burundu: gusubiramo ijambobanga no guhindura imeyili biranzwe.
sqrl-only: Iyi konti yinjira ikoresheje SQRL gusa.
sqrl-hardlock: Iyi konti ifungiye kuri SQRL: ntishobora kugarurwa cyangwa guhindurwa mu bundi buryo.
windows-sso-failed: Kwinjira ukoresheje Windows byanze. Konti yawe ya Windows ishobora kuba itemerewe hano.
enrollment-password-instructions: Emeza ijambobanga ryawe kugira ngo utangire. Ibi ntibikwinjiza. Ikintu gisanzwe gikora ntigishobora gusimburwa hano.
enrollment-setup-denied: Ntibishoboka gutangira gushyiraho. Reba ibyangombwa byawe n'uko kode zikoreshwa rimwe zaba zarafunguwe.
enrollment-code-instructions: Koresha kode zishingiye ku gihe: SHA1, imibare itandatu, amasegonda 30. Bika ibanga ryawe. Iri shyirwaho rirangira mu minota itanu.
enrollment-confirmed-instructions: Kode yo kwemeza yamaze gukoreshwa. Tegereza kode nshya muri authenticator yawe mbere yo kwinjira.
registration-first-admin: Iyi konti ya mbere izaba Domain Global Admin.
auth-too-many-attempts: Kugerageza kwinjira byabaye byinshi. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
registration-global-admin-disabled: Konti za Global Admin zitunganywa hano. Kwiyandikisha kwa bose kwahagaritswe.
expedite-limit: Ikarita imwe gusa ifunguye y'ikibaho ishobora kuba Byihutirwa icyarimwe.
list-policy-placeholder: Ikarita yinjira ryari muri uru rutonde, kandi irangira ryari hano?
commitment-point-hint: Guhera kuri uru rutonde akazi karemerwa; intonde ziri mbere yarwo ni amahitamo.
person-wip-over: __user__ afite amakarita __count__ afunguye; urugero rwa WIP ku muntu ni __limit__.
feature-list-policies-desc: Politiki ya buri rutonde - igihe ikarita yinjira n'igihe irangirira aho - ku mutwe w'urutonde. Ifungurwa kuri buri kibaho muri Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho / Urutonde.
feature-commitment-point-desc: Urutonde akazi kemerwa guhera kurwo, rugaragazwa ku mutwe warwo. Ruhitwamo kuri buri kibaho muri Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho / Urutonde.
feature-person-wip-limit-desc: Umubare w'amakarita afunguye umuntu umwe ashobora gufata ku kibaho; ikarita ifunguye iburira ku muntu wese urenzeho. Ushyirwaho kuri buri kibaho muri Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho / Urutonde.
feature-standup-timer-desc: Inama ya buri munsi muri menu y'ikibaho: abanyamuryango b'ikibaho mu buryo buvanze, buri wese afite igihe kimwe. Izimywa kuri buri kibaho mu Igenamiterere rya Scrum ryacyo.
feature-retrospective-board-desc: Ikibaho cy'isubiramo muri menu y'ikibaho: ikibaho gishya cyihariye gifite intonde Tangira gukora, Reka gukora, Komeza gukora n'Ibikorwa bikenewe. Kizimywa kuri buri kibaho mu Igenamiterere rya Scrum ryacyo.
show-split-lists: Emera ko intonde zigabanywamo Birimo gukorwa na Byarangiye
feature-split-lists-desc: Urutonde rugabanyijwemo Birimo gukorwa na Byarangiye: ikarita yashyizweho ikimenyetso ko yarangiye aho itegereza, yijimye, gukururwa mu rutonde rukurikira, kandi umutwe w'urutonde ubara byombi. Byemerwa kuri buri kibaho muri Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho / Urutonde, hanyuma bigafungurwa mu bikubiyemo bya buri rutonde.
workload-intro: Amasaha yagereranyijwe n'amanota y'inkuru y'amakarita yahawe buri muntu, icyumweru ku kindi, ugereranyije n'amasaha afite: igihe cye cy'akazi, igihe adahari n'iminsi mikuru. Kanda ku cyumweru kugira ngo ubone amakarita yacyo.
workload-truncated: Ni byinshi cyane ku kwerekana icyarimwe: raporo yerekana gusa abantu n'amakarita bya mbere. Hitamo ibyumweru bike cyangwa ibibaho bike.
workload-allocations-intro: Igice cy'igihe cy'umuntu kijya ku kibaho, cyangwa inshingano ikibaho kizakenera mbere y'uko hagira ugenwa.
workload-invalid-estimate: Igereranya rigomba kuba hagati ya 0 na 10000 by'amasaha.
feature-workload-desc: Umutwaro w'akazi n'ubushobozi muri menu y'ukoresha: amasaha yagereranyijwe n'amanota y'inkuru y'amakarita ya buri muntu, icyumweru ku kindi, ugereranyije n'igihe cye cy'akazi, igihe adahari n'iminsi mikuru, hamwe n'igabanya ku bibaho n'inshingano z'agateganyo.
billing-intro: Ibibaho uri umuyobozi wabyo: ingengo y'imari yabyo, ibyo akazi kabyo katwaye n'ibyo kazatwara ku biciro by'isaha ushyiraho, n'inyemezabuguzi z'amasaha yakoreshejwe. Abayobozi b'ikibaho bonyine ni bo babibona.
billing-no-boards: Ntabwo uri umuyobozi w'ikibaho na kimwe.
billing-unrated: __hours__ h ntibifite igiciro cy'isaha kandi ntibibariwe. Shyiraho igiciro cy'ikibaho cyangwa cy'abo bantu.
billing-set-rate-first: Banza ushyireho igiciro cy'isaha cy'iki kibaho.
feature-billing-desc: Ingengo y'imari n'inyemezabuguzi muri menu y'ukoresha: ingengo y'imari y'ikibaho mu mafaranga cyangwa mu masaha, ibiciro by'isaha, ikiguzi n'iteganya ry'akazi kacyo, n'inyemezabuguzi z'amasaha yishyuzwa yakoreshejwe. Abayobozi b'ikibaho bonyine ni bo bayibona.
billing-field-url: Umurongo wo kwishyura, hamwe na {amount}, {currency}, {reference} cyangwa {number}
billing-include-undated: Shyiramo igihe cyanditswe mbere y'uko amatariki abikwa
billing-method-fi-bank: Kode y'imirongo ya banki yo muri Finilande
billing-method-link: Umurongo wo kwishyura (ikarita, ikofi, kwishyura kuri interineti)
billing-pay-by-scanning: Ishyura usikana na porogarama ya banki cyangwa yo kwishyura
billing-undated-included: Harimo amasaha __hours__ yanditswe mbere y'uko amatariki abikwa.
billing-method-zbp: Kode QR ya banki yo muri Polonye
billing-method-mnb: Kode QR yo kohereza ako kanya yo muri Hongiriya
billing-field-promptpay-target: Nimero ya telefoni, indangamuntu cyangwa ID y'agakapu k'ikoranabuhanga
billing-field-proxy: Nimero ya telefoni, UEN, ID ya FPS cyangwa imeri
billing-reference-no: Nomero ya KID yo muri Noruveje
billing-reference-se: Indango ya OCR yo muri Suwede
billing-uncosted: __hours__ h ntizifite ikiguzi cy'isaha kandi ntiziri mu kiguzi.
billing-bill-time: Ishyuza igihe ku isaha (byazimye: igiciro kidahinduka, amafaranga adahinduka n'ayakoreshejwe ni yo yonyine yishyuzwa)
billing-fees-intro: Intambwe cyangwa igiciro kidahinduka byishyuzwa rimwe, guhera ku munsi wabyo; amafaranga y'ukwezi buri kwezi guhera ku munsi wayo kugeza ku iherezo ryayo.
billing-unapproved: __hours__ h zitegereje kwemezwa kandi ntiziri kuri iyi nyemezabuguzi.
billing-quotes-intro: Igiciro gitanzwe kigena igiciro cy'akazi gasigaye - igereranya rya buri karita ifunguye ukuyemo igihe cyakoreshejwe - n'amafaranga ataratangirwa inyemezabuguzi.
billing-accept-sets-budget: Igiciro gitanzwe cyemewe gihinduka ingengo y'imari y'ikibaho
workload-utilization-title: Amasaha yishyuzwa yanditswe ugereranyije n'igihe cy'akazi cy'ibi byumweru
cloud-panel-settings-intro: Kuri Domeni ya Cloud Panel, SuperAdmin acunga domeni z'abakiriya, ububiko bwabo bw'amakuru, DNS ya CloudFlare n'inzira za Caddy, kandi buri mukiriya abona inyemezabuguzi ze akaganira na SuperAdmin. SuperAdmin ni umuyobozi wa WeKan usanzwe uhari.
cloud-panel-cloudflare-target: Aderesi domeni zerekezaho (aderesi ya IP cyangwa izina rya host)
cloud-panel-dns-apply: Kora kandi uvugurure inyandiko za DNS
cloud-panel-dns-conflict: __name__ isanzwe ifite inyandiko ya __type__: isigwa uko imeze.
cloud-panel-caddy-intro: Caddy yohereza Domeni ya Cloud Panel na buri domeni isangiwe kuri iyi WeKan, na buri domeni ifite ububiko bwayo kuri kontineri yayo ya WeKan.
cloud-panel-caddy-admin: Aderesi ya API y'ubuyobozi bwa Caddy
cloud-panel-database-uri: Umurongo wo kwihuza (cyangwa ibice biri hasi)
cloud-panel-customers: Abakiriya binjira hano (amazina y'abakoresha cyangwa aderesi za imeri)
cloud-panel-domain-cloudflare: Bika inyandiko yayo ya DNS kuri CloudFlare
cloud-panel-import-files: Imigereka __count__: kandi wandukure amadosiye avuye mu bubiko bw'amadosiye bwa WeKan ishaje.
cloud-admin-not-allowed: Cloud Admin iri gusa kuri aderesi yitwa n'impinduka y'ibidukikije CLOUD ya seriveri, ku bayobozi bayo ba Cloud no ku bakiriya b'amazina y'imbuga ikubiyemo.
cloud-allowed-addresses-desc: Aderesi za IPv4 na IPv6, n'ibyiciro by'aderesi nka 203.0.113.0/24, umuyobozi wa Cloud ashobora kwinjiriraho. Imwe kuri buri murongo. Ubusa: aderesi iyo ari yo yose.
cloud-allowed-addresses-lockout: Aderesi yawe __address__ ntiri kuri uru rutonde. Kuyibika byagufungirana hanze, ni cyo cyatumye itabikwa.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-desc: Aderesi za IPv4 na IPv6 n'ibyiciro by'aderesi, imwe kuri buri murongo, aho Ubuyobozi na REST API y'ubuyobozi bishobora gukoreshwa. Ubusa: aderesi iyo ari yo yose.
admin-panel-allowed-addresses-env: Impinduka y'ibidukikije ya seriveri ADMIN_PANEL_ALLOWED_IP_ADDRESSES ni yo ifata icyemezo, aho kuba uru rutonde.
admin-panel-address-refused: Ubuyobozi ntibushobora gukoreshwa uvuye kuri aderesi yawe __address__.
website-view-empty: Nta kintu na kimwe kirashyirwa ahagaragara kuri uru rubuga.
feature-views-website-desc: Ikibaho nk'urubuga: amakarita y'urutonde rwacyo Published, umurongo Pages nk'ibikubiyemo n'andi makarita nk'inyandiko, inshya mbere, hamwe n'imigereka yazo. Ikibaho rusange gishobora gufungukira muri iyi migaragarire, kugira ngo abashyitsi babone urubuga kuri aderesi y'ikibaho.
feature-views-shop-desc: Ibicuruzwa biri ku makarita y'ikibaho nk'iduka ryo kuri interineti: ikarita ifite igiciro ni igicuruzwa, ibirango byayo ni ibyiciro, naho komande ni ikarita iri mu rutonde rwa Komande. Ikibaho rusange gishobora gufungukira muri ubu buryo, kugira ngo abashyitsi bagurire kuri aderesi y'ikibaho.
shop-sale-lists: Intonde zigurishwa (nta na rumwe rwatoranyijwe: intonde zose uretse urutonde rwa Komande)
shop-category-labels: Ibirango byerekanwa nk'ibyiciro (nta na kimwe cyatoranyijwe: ibirango byose)
shop-orders-private: Komande zandikwa ku kibaho cyihariye, kuko ikibaho rusange cyereka buri wese ikarita yose.
shop-show-on-public: Erekana Iduka aho kwerekana ikibaho rusange
shop-show-on-public-note: Ikibaho rusange gifungukira mu buryo bumwe gusa. Guhitamo Iduka hano bisimbura __view__ ku bashyitsi, naho guhitamo Urubuga cyangwa ubundi buryo muri Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho / Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara bisimbura Iduka.
shop-empty: Nta bicuruzwa birahari. Ikarita ifite igiciro iri ku rutonde rugurishwa ni igicuruzwa.
shop-privacy-note: Izina ryawe n'amakuru yo kukugeraho byandikwa kuri komande kugira ngo iduka riyikugezeho, nta handi.
shop-price-changed: Igiciro cyahindutse. Reba igiteranyo gishya maze wongere utumize.
shop-confirmation-email: Oherereza umuguzi kwemeza komande kuri imeyili
import-board-instruction-wordpress: Muri WordPress, hitamo 'Tools', 'Export', 'All content' na 'Download Export File', uhitemo iyo dosiye ya .xml hano, cyangwa ushyiremo inyandiko yayo. Squarespace, Wix n'izindi mbuga zohereza dosiye ya WordPress zikora kimwe. Buri paji na buri nyandiko bihinduka ikarita mu rutonde rw'imimerere yabyo, paji mu murongo Pages n'inyandiko muri Posts, hamwe n'ibirimo, ibyiciro na tags nk'ibirango, n'ibitekerezo byemejwe.
import-board-instruction-wordpressjson: Bika inyandiko na paji bya WordPress REST API (/wp-json/wp/v2/posts na /wp-json/wp/v2/pages) nka dosiye imwe ya .json, uyihitemo hano cyangwa uyishyiremo. Buri paji na buri nyandiko bihinduka ikarita mu rutonde rw'imimerere yabyo.
import-board-instruction-ghost: Muri Ghost, hitamo 'Settings', 'Labs', 'Export your content', uhitemo dosiye ya .json hano cyangwa uyishyiremo. Buri paji na buri nyandiko bihinduka ikarita mu rutonde rw'imimerere yabyo, na tags zabyo nk'ibirango.
import-board-instruction-blogger: Muri Blogger, hitamo 'Settings', 'Back up content', uhitemo dosiye ya .xml hano cyangwa ushyiremo inyandiko yayo. Buri nyandiko na buri paji bihinduka ikarita, igitarangira mu rutonde Draft, hamwe n'ibirango n'ibitekerezo byabyo.
import-board-instruction-markdownsite: Kusanya muri .zip inkomoko z'urubuga rwa Hugo, Jekyll, Eleventy, Astro cyangwa urundi rubuga rudahinduka - dosiye za Markdown na front matter yazo, n'amashusho yazo - uhitemo .zip hano. Buri dosiye ya Markdown ihinduka ikarita: inyandiko zo mu bubiko bwa posts cyangwa zifite itariki mu izina rya dosiye, izisigaye ni paji, ibitarangira mu rutonde Draft, n'amashusho ikoresha nk'imigereka yayo.
import-board-instruction-htmlsite: Kusanya muri .zip dosiye z'urubuga - paji zarwo za .html n'amashusho, nk'uko byabitswe na wget cyangwa HTTrack, cyangwa ibyoherejwe na Medium - uhitemo .zip hano. Buri paji ihinduka ikarita n'inyandiko yayo nyamukuru, n'amashusho ikoresha nk'imigereka; scripts, ibikubiyemo n'amafishi birasigara.
import-board-instruction-substack: Muri Substack, hitamo 'Settings', 'Exports', 'Create new export', uhitemo .zip wakuruye hano. Buri nyandiko ihinduka ikarita n'inyandiko yayo, yashyizwe ahagaragara cyangwa itarangira.
help-board-view-swimlanes-what-it-is-des: Imirongo igabanya ikibaho mu bice bitambitse, ku buryo buri karita iba iri mu rutonde no mu murongo icyarimwe. Umurongo ushobora guhagararira itsinda, umuntu, umukiriya cyangwa ubwoko bw'akazi, mu gihe intonde zikomeza kwerekana ibyiciro by'akazi.
help-board-view-swimlanes-how-it-works-d: Kanda + mu mutwe w'umurongo, cyangwa uhitemo Ongeraho umurongo muri menu yawo, wandike izina hanyuma uhitemo niba ujya hejuru cyangwa munsi y'umurongo wahiswemo. Gushyiramo imirongo myinshi y'inyandiko bishobora kurema umurongo umwe kuri buri murongo w'inyandiko. Kanda ku izina kugira ngo urihindure, koresha akamenyetso ko guhina cyangwa kwagura umurongo, kurura agafashe kawo kugira ngo uhindure uko ikurikirana, kandi ukurure impera yo hasi kugira ngo uhindure uburebure bwawo, keretse umuyobozi w'ikibaho yabibujije.
help-board-view-lists-what-it-is-descrip: Intonde ni inkingi zirimo amakarita. Ku kibaho cya kanban, buri rutonde ni icyiciro cy'akazi, kandi ikarita iva ku rutonde ijya ku rundi uko akazi gakomeza. Mu buryo bw'Imirongo, urutonde rushobora kuba urw'umurongo umwe.
help-board-view-lists-how-it-works-descr: Kanda ku kamenyetso ko kongeraho urutonde ku mpera y'iburyo y'umutwe w'urutonde, cyangwa Ongeraho muri menu y'urutonde, wandike izina hanyuma uhitemo urutonde ruzakurikira; gushyiramo imirongo myinshi bishobora kurema urutonde rumwe kuri buri murongo. Kanda ku mutwe w'urutonde kugira ngo uwuhindure, kandi akamenyetso kari mu mutwe warwo kararuhina cyangwa kakarwagura kuri wowe gusa. Menu y'urutonde irimo kandi gukoporora, kwimura no gushyira mu bubiko, kandi ushobora gukurura agafashe kari hagati y'intonde kugira ngo uhindure ingano yazo iyo byemewe.
help-board-view-table-what-it-is-descrip: Imigaragarire y'imbonerahamwe yerekana amakarita y'ikibaho mu mbonerahamwe imeze nk'urupapuro rw'imibare, umurongo umwe kuri buri karita, hamwe n'urutonde rwayo, umurongo, abantu, ibirango n'amatariki. Ifasha kureba amakarita menshi icyarimwe no kongeraho cyangwa kwimura amakarita utayakuruye mu ntonde.
help-board-view-table-how-it-works-descr: Kanda ku mutwe w'inkingi kugira ngo utondeke, wongere ukande kugira ngo uhindure uko bikurikirana. Andika mu gasanduku ko gushakisha kugira ngo ushake imitwe y'amakarita, intonde, imirongo n'ibirango, kandi ukoreshe Ibanza na Ibikurikira kugira ngo unyure mu mirongo 25 icyarimwe. Buto Hindura ifungura ikarita hejuru y'imbonerahamwe. Gupfunyika imitwe no Gutondekanya ukurikije umurongo bihindura imiterere kandi byibukwa muri iyi mushakisha. Amakarita yabitswe ntagaragara, kandi Muyunguruzi yo ku ruhande igabanya imirongo.
help-board-view-cal-what-it-is-descripti: Imigaragarire ya Kalendari ishyira amakarita y'ikibaho kuri kalendari ukurikije amatariki yayo: ikarita ifite itariki yo gutangira n'iyo kurangira igaragara nk'umurongo hagati yazo, kandi amatariki yo kwakirwa, ntarengwa n'iyo kurangira agaragara ukwayo. Ibintu by'urutonde rw'igenzura bifite amatariki na byo biragaragara.
help-board-view-cal-how-it-works-descrip: Koresha Uyu munsi, Ibanza na Ibikurikira kugira ngo ugendagende, kandi uhindure hagati y'umunsi, icyumweru n'ukwezi, buri kimwe nk'urusobe cyangwa nk'urutonde. Kurura ikarita kugira ngo uyihe itariki ntarengwa nshya, cyangwa uyirambure kugira ngo uhindure itariki yo kurangira. Kanda ku munsi, cyangwa ukurure ku masaha mu rusobe rw'icyumweru cyangwa rw'umunsi, kugira ngo urema ikarita nshya ifite iyo tariki ntarengwa; ijya mu murongo wa mbere no mu rutonde rwa mbere rw'ikibaho.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-what-it-is: Uburyo bwa Kalendari bwerekana buri karita ku munsi w'itariki ntarengwa yayo, hamwe n'ibirango byayo n'umutwe wayo wose, mu rusobe rw'ukwezi cyangwa rw'icyumweru. Ni incamake yo gusoma gusa y'ibigomba kurangira n'igihe, nk'iya kalendari ya Trello.
help-board-view-calendar-mode-how-it-wor: Koresha Uyu munsi, Ibanza na Ibikurikira kugira ngo ugende ukwezi cyangwa icyumweru, na Icyumweru cyangwa Ukwezi kugira ngo uhindure urusobe; amahitamo yawe yibukwa muri iyi mushakisha. Kanda ku ikarita kugira ngo uyifungure. Amakarita yabitswe ntagaragara kandi Muyunguruzi yo ku ruhande irakora. Kugira ngo uhindure amatariki ukoresheje gukurura, koresha imigaragarire ya Kalendari.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-what-it-i: Kalendari (Ibibaho byose) yerekana amakarita afite amatariki y'ibibaho byose uri umunyamuryango wabyo muri kalendari imwe, ku buryo ubona ibigomba kurangira iki cyumweru byose aho byaba biri hose. Buri kintu gitangirwa n'umutwe w'ikibaho cyacyo mu dukubo.
help-board-view-multiboard-cal-how-it-wo: Yifungure uhereye muri menu Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara y'ikibaho icyo ari cyo cyose hanyuma utegereze ko amakarita y'ibibaho byawe byose agera. Koresha Uyu munsi, Ibanza na Ibikurikira n'imigaragarire y'umunsi, icyumweru n'ukwezi, buri kimwe kandi nk'urutonde. Amatariki yo kwakirwa, ntarengwa n'iyo kurangira agaragara ukwayo. Kanda ku kintu kugira ngo ufungure iyo karita ku kibaho cyayo. Hano amatariki ntashobora gukururwa.
help-board-view-time-what-it-is-descript: Imigaragarire y'Igihe ikusanyiriza hamwe ikurikirana ry'igihe ry'ikibaho: igihe cyakoreshejwe, uwagikoresheje n'amakarita cyakoreshejweho, hamwe n'igihe gisigaye kugeza amakarita arangiye. Igihe cyinjizwa ku makarita ubwayo; iyi migaragarire irakimenyesha gusa.
help-board-view-time-how-it-works-descri: Soma incamake y'igihe cyakoreshejwe iri hejuru, hanyuma isesengura ukurikije uwahawe akazi n'ikarita, amakarita yarengeje igihe ashyizweho ikimenyetso. Munsi yaho, impinduka zose z'amasaha yanditswe ku ikarita zitondekwa ukurikije uwazikoze. Kanda Sohora kugira ngo ubike raporo nka PDF cyangwa Excel. Abanyamuryango bashobora kubona gusa amakarita bahawe babona incamake y'amakarita yabo, ibindi bice bigasigara ari ubusa.
help-board-view-timeline-what-it-is-desc: Imigaragarire y'Umurongo w'igihe yerekana ikibaho uko cyari kimeze mu kanya kashize, ikoresheje amateka y'ikibaho. Igufasha kubona ibyahindutse no gusubiza ikarita uko yari imeze.
help-board-view-timeline-how-it-works-de: Kanda ku kadomo kari ku murongo kugira ngo ubone buri karita uko yari imeze icyo gihe, itondekanyije ukurikije urutonde yarimo, hamwe n'umutwe wayo, ibisobanuro, ibirango, abanyamuryango n'itariki ntarengwa. Kanda Ubu kugira ngo usubire ku bihe by'ubu. Ku ikarita, Garura kuri iyi mimerere isubizaho ibyo bintu umaze kwemeza. Nta kintu gisibwa: kugarura byandikwa nk'amateka mashya, kandi buto yerekwa gusa abashobora guhindura iyo karita.
help-board-view-stats-what-it-is-descrip: Imibare yerekana uko ikibaho kimeze mu kanya gato: uko amakarita yacyo atangirwa n'umubare w'imirongo, intonde, amakarita, amakarita yabitswe, ibirango, abanyamuryango n'imyanya yihariye gifite.
help-board-view-stats-how-it-works-descr: Fungura Imibare mu itsinda ry'Incamake rya menu Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara hanyuma usome imbonerahamwe Imimerere y'ikibaho. Uburyo amakarita atangirwa bwerekana niba iki kibaho gitangiza gusa amakarita agaragara cyangwa amakarita yose, kandi niba ibyo byarahiswemo byikora ku kibaho kinini. Imibare ibarirwa kuri seriveri, ku buryo ari ukuri no ku kibaho kinini. Agaciro kose gashobora guhitwamo no gukopororwa, kandi gufungura iyi migaragarire nta cyo bihindura.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-what-i: Tondekanya ukurikije uwahawe ishyira buri karita munsi y'umuntu yahawe, aho kuba munsi y'urutonde rwayo, ku buryo ubona ufite iki udafunguye buri rutonde. Ibereye inama y'itsinda.
help-board-view-group-by-assignee-how-it: Yifungure uhereye muri menu Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara. Buri wahawe akazi abona igice cy'amakarita ye, itariki ntarengwa aho iri n'isaha iyo ikarita yarengeje igihe; amakarita adafite uwahawe ari munsi ya Nta washizweho. Kanda ku mutwe w'ikarita kugira ngo uyifungure. Iri tondekanya rikoresha umwanya Uwahawe akazi w'ikarita, si Abanyamuryango bayo. Abantu inshingano zabo zibemerera kubona gusa amakarita bahawe nta makuru babona hano.
help-board-view-gantt-what-it-is-descrip: Imigaragarire ya Gantt ishyira amakarita y'ikibaho kuri kalendari ku buryo ubona ibitangira, ibigomba kurangira n'ibihurirana. Gantt ni imbonerahamwe ifite umurongo umwe kuri buri karita n'akamenyetso kuri buri tariki yayo, mu gihe Frappe Gantt na DHTMLX Gantt bishushanya buri karita nk'umurongo kuva itangiye kugeza irangiye.
help-board-view-gantt-how-it-works-descr: Hitamo Gantt, Frappe Gantt cyangwa DHTMLX Gantt mu itsinda Kalendari n'igihe rya menu Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara; amakarita akenera nibura itariki imwe yo kwakirwa, gutangira, ntarengwa cyangwa kurangira. Muri Gantt, buri cyumweru gifite amatariki kibona imbonerahamwe yacyo; kanda ku izina ry'ikarita kugira ngo uyifungure cyangwa ku kamenyetso k'itariki kugira ngo uyihindure. Muri Frappe Gantt na DHTMLX Gantt, abanyamuryango bafite uburenganzira bwo kwandika bashobora gukurura umurongo kugira ngo bahindure igihe cy'ikarita.
help-board-view-product-backlog-what-it-: Urutonde rw'ibikenewe ku gicuruzwa ni urutonde rutondekanyije rw'akazi itsinda rya Scrum ritarashyira muri sprint. Rwerekana amakarita y'ikibaho adafite sprint iriho, atondekanyije ukurikije Urwego mu bitegereje, atavuye mu ntonde zayo.
help-board-view-product-backlog-how-it-w: Shakisha ikarita mu mbonerahamwe, hanyuma mu gice cyayo cy'Ibikorwa, ushyireho Sprint, Urwego mu bitegereje, Isohora, Ubwoko bw'igice cy'akazi n'Ibisabwa ngo byemerwe, hanyuma ukande Bika. Inzego nto ziza mbere. Fata Ctrl, cyangwa Cmd kuri Mac, kugira ngo ushyire ikarita mu masohora menshi. Kanda ku mutwe w'ikarita kugira ngo uyifungure, na Erekana ibindi kugira ngo utangize amakarita 100 akurikira. Guhindura bikurikiza uburenganzira busanzwe bw'amakarita.
help-board-view-sprints-what-it-is-descr: Sprint ni igihe gito kandi kidahinduka itsinda rya Scrum rirangizamo akazi kahiswemo kagana ku ntego. Imigaragarire y'Ibyiciro by'akazi ni ho sprint z'ikibaho ziteganyirizwa, zitangirwa, zifungwa cyangwa zihagarikwa, hamwe n'amasohora yacyo n'ibikorwa bya Scrum.
help-board-view-sprints-how-it-works-des: Umuyobozi w'ikibaho abanza gufungura Igenamiterere rya Scrum, agafungura igenamigambi rya Scrum hanyuma agahitamo aho ikigereranyo kiva, igipimo, amabwiriza yo kurangiza n'iminsi y'akazi. Hanyuma rema sprint iteganyijwe ifite izina, intego, itariki yo gutangira n'iyo kurangira, uyihe amakarita uhereye mu Rutonde rw'ibikenewe ku gicuruzwa, hanyuma ukande Tangira sprint. Kugira ngo uyirangize, hitamo aho akazi katarangiye kajya hanyuma ukande Funga sprint, cyangwa utange impamvu ukande Hagarika sprint. Abayobozi b'ikibaho bonyine ni bo bacunga sprint.
help-board-view-sprint-report-what-it-is: Raporo ya sprint ivuga ibyabaye muri sprint imwe yafunzwe: ibyo biyemeje, ibyarangiye, ibyongeweho, ibyakuweho n'ibyasigaye bitarangiye. Umuvuduko utondeka ibyo byavuyemo kuri buri sprint yafunzwe, ku buryo sprint ikurikira iteganywa hashingiwe ku byo itsinda ryakoze koko.
help-board-view-sprint-report-how-it-wor: Muri Raporo ya Sprint, hitamo sprint hanyuma uhitemo Amakarita cyangwa Ingano hejuru y'imirongo, hanyuma usome ingano y'akazi ka buri munsi n'akazi gasigaye, hamwe n'amateka y'impinduka zose munsi. Mu Muvuduko, soma umurongo umwe kuri buri sprint yafunzwe. Ibyavuyemo biva ku mafoto yafashwe igihe buri sprint yatangiraga n'igihe yafungwaga, ku buryo impinduka z'ibigereranyo zakurikiyeho zitabihindura. Sohora ibika ibyavuyemo nka PDF cyangwa Excel, na Vugurura yongera gutangiza raporo.
help-board-view-burndown-what-it-is-desc: Ibi bishushanyo bya Scrum byerekana iterambere mu gihe. Burndown yerekana akazi gasigaye umunsi ku munsi na Burnup akarangiye, Umuvuduko werekana ibyo buri sprint yafunzwe yarangije, Burndown ishusho y'isohora ikurikirana akazi gasigaye mu isohora, na Aho ibikorwa binini bigeze herekana aho amakarita mubyeyi ageze.
help-board-view-burndown-how-it-works-de: Hitamo igishushanyo munsi ya Scrum muri menu Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara. Buri kimwe gishushanywa hashingiwe ku makarita na sprint by'ikibaho ubwacyo kandi cyerekana imibare mu mbonerahamwe munsi y'igishushanyo. Umuvuduko ukenera nibura sprint imwe yafunzwe, kandi ukwemerera guhitamo Amakarita cyangwa Ingano. Kanda Sohora hejuru kugira ngo ubike iyo mibare nka PDF cyangwa Excel. Igishushanyo kitaragira icyo gishushanya kivuga Nta gisubizo.
help-board-view-roadmap-what-it-is-descr: Gahunda itondekanya amakarita mu mirongo ukurikije agaciro k'umwanya wihariye, nk'isohora cyangwa epic, kandi igashushanya amakarita ya buri murongo ku murongo w'igihe. Ifasha kuri gahunda y'amasohora cyangwa y'insanganyamatsiko iyo iryo tondekanya risanzwe ribitswe mu mwanya wihariye.
help-board-view-roadmap-how-it-works-des: Ikibaho gikenera nibura umwanya wihariye umwe w'umwandiko cyangwa w'urutonde rumanuka. Hitamo uwo mwanya muri Tondekanya hejuru; buri gaciro kabona igishushanyo gito cya Gantt cy'amakarita yako, kandi amakarita adafite agaciro ashyirwa munsi ya Nta gaciro. Amakarita ashyirwa ukurikije amatariki yayo, bityo uyahe amatariki yo gutangira n'ntarengwa kugira ngo uyabone ku murongo w'igihe.
help-board-view-dashboard-what-it-is-des: Ibi bishushanyo by'Incamake bisubiza uko ikibaho gihuze n'uko akazi kacyo gakwirakwiye: Ikibaho na Umutima bitanga incamake y'ikibaho, Umutwaro w'akazi werekana ufite iki, Isaranganya uko amakarita agabanywa, Ikarita y'ibishingirwaho uko amakarita abuzanya cyangwa ashingiranaho, na Ikarita y'ubushyuhe bw'ibikorwa igihe abantu bakora ku kibaho.
help-board-view-dashboard-how-it-works-d: Hitamo igishushanyo mu itsinda ry'Incamake rya menu Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara. Buri paji ishushanya igishushanyo hashingiwe ku makarita n'amateka y'ikibaho kandi yerekana imbonerahamwe y'imibare iri inyuma yacyo. Kanda Sohora hejuru kugira ngo ubike ayo makuru nka PDF cyangwa Excel. Iyo nta kintu kiraboneka cyo gushushanya, igishushanyo kivuga Nta gisubizo.
help-board-view-bigboard-what-it-is-desc: Bigboard ikusanya ibibaho byose uri umunyamuryango wabyo ku paji imwe imanuka, buri kimwe n'intonde n'amakarita yacyo, ku buryo ukora ku bibaho byawe byose icyarimwe.
help-board-view-bigboard-how-it-works-de: Fungura Bigboard uhereye muri menu Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara hanyuma utegereze ko amakarita y'ibibaho byose agera. Buri gice cy'ikibaho gikora nk'ikibaho gisanzwe: kurura amakarita hagati y'intonde, fungura amakarita kandi uhindure intonde. Ushobora kandi gukurura ikarita mu rutonde rw'ikindi kibaho kiri kuri iyo paji, bikayimurira kuri icyo kibaho. Intonde zishobora gukururwa gusa mu kibaho cyazo. Kanda ku mutwe w'ikibaho kugira ngo ugifungure ukwacyo.
help-board-view-flow-what-it-is-descript: Ibishushanyo by'Uruzi rwa Kanban byerekana uko akazi kagenda mu kibaho: uruzi ruteranya, igenzura n'igihe cy'umuzenguruko, igihe cyo kugera, imikorere y'uruzi, umusaruro, WIP, akazi kamaze igihe, ibibuza, ibiteganywa by'igihe akazi kazarangira, imyitwarire y'inzira n'iba ibigereranyo binini bifata igihe kirekire. Bigufasha kumenya aho akazi kirundanyiriza n'igihe gafata koko.
help-board-view-flow-how-it-works-descri: Hitamo igishushanyo mu itsinda Uruzi rwa Kanban rya menu Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara. Soma inyandiko iri munsi y'umutwe, ivuga uko gipima, hanyuma igishushanyo n'imbonerahamwe iri munsi yacyo. Paji zimwe zisaba igenamiterere, nk'amakarita n'itariki by'intego kuri Monte Carlo — Igishushanyo cy'umusaruro cyangwa umwanya w'ingano kuri Ingano / Igihe cy'umuzenguruko, bishyirwa mu bikorwa na Koresha. Sohora hejuru ibika imbonerahamwe nka PDF cyangwa Excel.
help-board-view-reports-what-it-is-descr: Izi raporo zerekana uko akazi kagenda mu kibaho icyumweru ku kindi: amakarita yakozwe n'ayarangiye, uruzi rusigaye, igihe amakarita amara muri buri rutonde, imyaka ugereranyije y'amakarita afunguye, umusaruro w'icyumweru n'inshuro amatariki ntarengwa yubahirizwa.
help-board-view-reports-how-it-works-des: Hitamo raporo mu itsinda Uruzi rwa Kanban rya menu Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara: Byakozwe n'ibyakemuwe, Uruzi rusigaye, Igihe mu rutonde, Imyaka ugereranyije, Igishushanyo cy'umusaruro mu gihe cyangwa Kubahiriza itariki ntarengwa. Buri imwe yerekana igishushanyo kandi, munsi yacyo, imbonerahamwe y'imibare gishushanywaho. Kanda Sohora hejuru kugira ngo ubike iyo mbonerahamwe nka PDF cyangwa Excel.
help-board-view-map-what-it-is-descripti: Imigaragarire y'ikarita yerekana amakarita y'ikibaho nk'utumenyetso ku ishusho umuyobozi w'ikibaho ashyiraho, nk'igishushanyo cy'inzu cyangwa ikarita y'ahantu. Ibereye akazi gakorerwa ahantu, nk'ibyumba, imashini cyangwa ibibanza.
help-board-view-map-how-it-works-descrip: Umuyobozi w'ikibaho akanda Shyiraho ishusho y'ikarita y'ahantu agahitamo dosiye ya PNG, JPEG, GIF cyangwa WebP, kandi ashobora kuyikuraho nyuma atabuze imyanya y'amakarita. Abashobora guhindura ikibaho babona amakarita ataragera ku ikarita y'ahantu; kurura imwe kuri iyo shusho, cyangwa uyihitemo ukande aho ikwiye, kandi ukurure akamenyetso kugira ngo ukimure. Akamenyetso gafata ibara ry'ikirango cya mbere cy'ikarita, kandi kugakandaho bifungura ikarita.
help-board-view-email-what-it-is-descrip: Imigaragarire yo Kureba imeyili yerekana ikibaho nk'agasanduku k'amabaruwa: amakarita ni ubutumwa, intonde ni ububiko kandi ibirango ni ibirango. Ushobora kwandika no gusubiza imeyili ukoresheje aderesi y'ikibaho ubwacyo, ku buryo ibisubizo bigaruka ku kibaho nk'amakarita n'ibitekerezo.
help-board-view-email-how-it-works-descr: Kanda Izinjiye, Izoherejwe, Imeyili zose, urutonde cyangwa ikirango kugira ngo uhitemo ibigaragara, andika mu gasanduku ko gushakisha kugira ngo ugabanye imirongo, hanyuma ukande ku murongo kugira ngo ufungure ikarita, ibitekerezo byayo bikaba ari ikiganiro. Andika yandika imeyili nshya kandi umwambi wo gusubiza urasubiza, yoherezwa ivuye kuri aderesi y'ikibaho. Ikibaho kibanza gukenera kwakira imeyili, bifungurwa mu Igenamiterere ry'amamenyesha y'ikibaho munsi ya Imeyili ijya ku ikarita.
help-board-view-chat-what-it-is-descript: Imigaragarire yo Kureba ikiganiro yerekana ikibaho nk'ahantu h'ikiganiro: buri karita ifite ikiganiro ni umuyoboro kandi ibitekerezo byayo ni ubutumwa. Igiti cy'imiyoboro kirimo ibibaho byose ushobora kubona, hamwe n'umubare w'ubutumwa utarasoma.
help-board-view-chat-how-it-works-descri: Fungura ahantu h'akazi n'ikibaho muri Imiyoboro hanyuma ukande ku ikarita; ifungukira mu gice cyo hagati kandi ubutumwa bwayo bukagaragara mu gice cy'ikiganiro. Andika ubutumwa hanyuma ukande Enter cyangwa Ohereza; Shift+Enter itangira umurongo mushya. Kugira ngo utangire ikiganiro ku ikarita idafite ubutumwa, kanda Erekana amakarita yose kuri icyo kibaho hanyuma uhitemo ikarita. Ibice bihindurwa ku ndimi zandikwa kuva iburyo ujya ibumoso.
help-board-view-version-control-what-it-: Imigaragarire y'Igenzura ry'amaverisiyo yerekana ikibaho nk'ikurikirana ry'ibibazo by'ububiko bwa kode: amakarita ni ibibazo, ibirango ni ibirango, ibirango bifite itariki ntarengwa ni intambwe z'ingenzi, ibitekerezo ni ikiganiro kandi imigereka ni amadosiye. Yinjiza kandi igahuza ibibazo bivuye kuri GitHub, GitLab, Gitea na Forgejo.
help-board-view-version-control-how-it-w: Reba ibibazo bifunguye n'ibifunze, uyungurure ukurikije ikirango cyangwa intambwe y'ingenzi, kandi ufungure ikibazo kugira ngo usome kandi wongere ku kiganiro cyacyo. Ikarita ifatwa nk'ifunze iyo yabitswe cyangwa iri mu rutonde nka Byafunzwe cyangwa Byarangiye. Ibibazo bishya bihinduka amakarita mu rutonde rufunguye rw'ikibaho, kandi Funga cyangwa Ongera ufungure byimura ikarita hagati y'intonde zifunguye n'izifunze. Byose ni amakuru asanzwe y'amakarita, bityo impinduka zibikwa mu mateka y'ikibaho.
help-board-view-column-sets-what-it-is-d: Amatsinda y'inkingi agufasha gutondeka amakarita amwe mu bundi buryo, nk'uko yihutirwa, intambwe y'ingenzi cyangwa ingano, utavanye ikarita mu rutonde rwayo. Buri tsinda rifite inkingi zaryo z'amabara.
help-board-view-column-sets-how-it-works: Umuyobozi w'ikibaho yandika izina muri Itsinda rishya ry'inkingi agakanda Ongeraho, hanyuma akongeraho inkingi zifite izina n'ibara. Hitamo itsinda hejuru; buri karita iri mu nkingi imwe yaryo cyangwa muri Ntishyizwe ahantu. Kurura ikarita mu yindi nkingi kugira ngo uhindure umwanya wayo muri iri tsinda gusa; urutonde rwayo, umurongo, ibirango n'abanyamuryango ntibihinduka. Buri karita yerekana kandi utumenyetso duto tw'inkingi yayo mu yandi matsinda.
help-board-view-website-what-it-is-descr: Imigaragarire y'urubuga yerekana ikibaho nk'urubuga rwubatswe n'amakarita yacyo n'imigereka yacyo, nk'urubuga rwinjijwe ruvuye kuri WordPress, Ghost, Blogger cyangwa urubuga rudahinduka. Ikibaho rusange gishobora gufungukira muri iyi migaragarire, ku buryo abashyitsi babona urubuga kuri aderesi y'ikibaho.
help-board-view-website-how-it-works-des: Amakarita ari mu rutonde rwitwa Published ari ku rubuga, cyangwa amakarita y'intonde zose iyo urwo rutonde rutariho; amakarita yabitswe ntagaragara na rimwe. Amakarita ari mu murongo witwa Pages agize menu, ibikorwa bito bikaba paji nto, kandi andi makarita ni inyandiko kuri paji y'imbere, iza vuba mbere. Ibisobanuro by'ikarita ni umwandiko wa paji kandi imigereka yayo ni amashusho n'amadosiye yayo. Kugira ngo uyikoreshe nk'imigaragarire y'ikibaho rusange, yihitemo mu Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho / Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara.
help-board-view-shop-what-it-is-descript: Imigaragarire y'iduka yerekana ibicuruzwa biri ku makarita y'ikibaho nk'iduka ryo kuri interineti, rifite amashusho, ibiciro, ibyiciro, paji y'igicuruzwa, igitebo n'aho kwishyurira. Ikarita iri mu rutonde ruri ku isoko ihinduka igicuruzwa iyo umwanya w'igiciro cyayo ufite umubare, kandi ibirango byayo bihinduka ibyiciro.
help-board-view-shop-how-it-works-descri: Umuyobozi w'ikibaho ategura iduka mu Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho / Iduka: imyanya y'igiciro, kode y'igicuruzwa n'ibiri mu bubiko, urutonde rwa komande rwihariye, ifaranga, TVA, uburyo bwo kwishyura, intonde ziri ku isoko n'ibirango byerekanwa nk'ibyiciro, hanyuma agashyiraho akamenyetso kuri Iduka rirafunguye. Abaguzi bayungurura ukurikije icyiciro, bongera ibicuruzwa mu gitebo bakishyura. Buri komande ihinduka ikarita nshya mu rutonde rwa komande, kandi umuguzi abona imeyili yemeza.
help-sidebar-filter-what-it-is-descripti: Muyunguruzi yerekana gusa amakarita ahuye n'ibyo uhisemo, nk'ibirango, abanyamuryango, abahawe akazi, amatariki, agaciro k'imyanya yihariye, umwandiko w'ikarita cyangwa igihe amakarita amaze mu rutonde. Ntihindura ikarita cyangwa uburenganzira bw'uwo ari we wese, kandi uruvange rw'iyungurura rushobora kubikwa n'izina rugakoreshwa nanone.
help-sidebar-filter-how-it-works-descrip: Hitamo ibirango, abantu, amatariki cyangwa ibindi bisabwa ku ruhande, maze ikibaho cyerekane gusa amakarita ahuye. Munsi y'Ibirango, OR ihuza ikirango icyo ari cyo cyose cyahiswemo kandi AND isaba byose; kongera gukanda ku kirango cyahiswemo birakivanamo. Umwandiko w'ikarita ukora uko wandika. Gufunga igice bigumana iyungurura kugeza uriyikuyeho. Gushakisha hose, na ko kari hano, gushakisha amakarita mu bibaho byawe byose.
help-sidebar-search-what-it-is-descripti: Shakisha ibona amakarita n'intonde by'iki kibaho birimo ibyo wanditse, kandi yerekana buri karita yabonetse ku kibaho ubwacyo. Mu Bibaho byose, iyo buto igabanya urutonde rw'ibibaho byawe ukurikije umutwe.
help-sidebar-search-how-it-works-descrip: Andika mu mwanya hanyuma ukande Enter. Uruhande rutondeka intonde n'amakarita bihuye, kandi ikarita ya mbere ifungukira ku kibaho hamwe na konteri munsi y'umwanya. Kanda Enter nanone ku ikarita ikurikira cyangwa Shift+Enter ku ibanza; imyambi ikora kimwe kandi isubira ku ntangiriro. Kanda ku ikarita cyangwa urutonde mu bisubizo kugira ngo ubyerekane ku kibaho, hanyuma ukande Shakisha nanone kugira ngo ufunge uruhande.
help-sidebar-multiselection-what-it-is-d: Guhitamo Byinshi bigufasha gushyiraho akamenyetso ku makarita menshi hanyuma ugakora ikintu kimwe kuri yose icyarimwe: gushyiraho ikirango cyangwa umunyamuryango, guhindura ibara, kwimura, gukoporora cyangwa gushyira mu bubiko. Mu Bibaho byose, bihitamo ibibaho.
help-sidebar-multiselection-how-it-works: Fungura Guhitamo Byinshi mu mutwe w'ikibaho, hanyuma ushyire akamenyetso mu dusanduku tw'amakarita, cyangwa ukoreshe Shungura ku byahiswemo mu ruhande rwa Muyunguruzi kugira ngo uhitemo amakarita yose iyungurura ryerekana. Hitamo igikorwa ku ruhande, nka Gena akamenyetso ku byahiswemo, Imura ibyahiswemo cyangwa Imurira ibyahiswemo mu Bubiko. Kanda Zimya Guhitamo Byinshi, X iri iruhande rwa buto yo mu mutwe, umaze. Ukenera uburenganzira bwo guhindura ikibaho.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-what-it-is-de: Imyanya yihariye ni imyanya y'inyongera y'ikibaho ku makarita, nka verisiyo, ingengo y'imari, umukiriya, agasanduku ko guhitamo cyangwa ihitamo rivuye ku rutonde. Umwanya ushyirwaho rimwe ku kibaho, kandi buri karita ishobora kugira agaciro kayo kuri uwo mwanya.
help-sidebar-custom-fields-how-it-works-: Kanda + kugira ngo urema umwanya, uwuhe izina n'ubwoko (umwandiko, umubare, itariki, urutonde rumanuka, urutonde rumanuka rwo guhitamo byinshi, agasanduku ko guhitamo, ifaranga cyangwa icyitegererezo cy'umwandiko) hanyuma uhitemo aho ugaragara: ku ikarita, ku ikarita ntoyi, ku makarita mashya cyangwa ku makarita yose. Ubwoko ntibushobora guhindurwa nyuma. Imyanya y'umubare n'ifaranga ishobora kwerekana igiteranyo hejuru ya buri rutonde. Agaciro k'amakarita kuzuzwa ku ikarita ifunguye.
help-sidebar-archives-what-it-is-descrip: Ububiko burimo amakarita, intonde n'imirongo byashyizwe mu Bubiko. Gushyira mu bubiko bihisha ikintu utakibuze, ku buryo gishobora kugarurwa nyuma, mu gihe gusiba bigikuraho burundu.
help-sidebar-archives-how-it-works-descr: Hitamo agace Amakarita, Intonde cyangwa Imirongo hanyuma ukande Garura iruhande rw'ikintu, cyangwa Garura byose. Ikarita ntishobora kugarurwa mu gihe urutonde rwayo rwabitswe cyangwa rwuzuye ukurikije urugero rwa WIP, kandi Ububiko burabivuga. Abayobozi b'ikibaho babona kandi Siba na Siba byose, bidashobora gusubizwa inyuma. Ibibaho byabitswe bigarurwa uhereye kuri paji y'Ububiko y'Ibibaho byose.
help-sidebar-original-positions-what-it-: Imyanya y'umwimerere yerekana aho buri murongo, urutonde n'ikarita byashyizwe igihe byaremwaga, n'ibyimutse kuva icyo gihe. Bifasha nyuma y'itunganya rinini, cyangwa kubona umutwe ikarita yaremanywe.
help-sidebar-original-positions-how-it-w: Soma amatsinda atatu, Imirongo, Intonde n'Amakarita. Buri kintu cyerekana izina ryacyo ry'ubu, Byimuwe iyo kitakiri aho cyashyizwe, aho cyaremewe, umutwe wacyo w'umwimerere iyo wahindutse, n'igihe cyaremwe. Kanda Vugurura kugira ngo wongere usome amateka y'ikibaho. Ibintu byaremwe mbere y'uko imyanya yandikwa nta murongo bifite.
help-sidebar-summary-what-it-is-descript: Incamake ni raporo y'inama ya buri munsi y'ibyabaye ku kibaho, umuntu ku wundi, ikuwe mu byanditswe by'ikibaho ubwacyo. Isubiza icyo buri wese muri twe yakoze mu munsi cyangwa icyumweru giheruka, n'ibyarengeje igihe.
help-sidebar-summary-how-it-works-descri: Hitamo Umunsi uheruka cyangwa Icyumweru giheruka. Buri munyamuryango wagize icyo akora cyangwa ufite amakarita yarengeje igihe abona amatsinda y'amakarita Byarangiye, Byimuwe, Byongeweho na Yatanze igitekerezo, hamwe n'amakarita ye Byarengeje igihe, kandi buri karita ifungukira ku ihuza ryayo. Kanda Koporora nk'inyandiko kugira ngo ukoporore incamake yose, yiteguye gushyirwa mu kiganiro cyangwa muri imeyili.
