help-sidebar-since-last-visit-what-it-is: Kuva wasura ubwa nyuma itondeka ibyo abandi bantu bahinduye kuri iki kibaho kuva uheruka kugifungura: amakarita mashya, kwimura, ibitekerezo, impinduka z'amatariki ntarengwa n'abanyamuryango bongeweho. Ikintu cyo muri menu cyerekana umubare w'impinduka.
help-sidebar-since-last-visit-how-it-wor: Gufungura ikibaho byandika uruzinduko rwawe. Fungura iyi migaragarire kugira ngo ubone impinduka zitondekanyije ukurikije ikarita, iya vuba mbere, hanyuma ukande ku murongo kugira ngo ufungure iyo karita. Impinduka zawe ntizitondekwa. Umuyobozi ashobora guhisha iki kintu mu Buyobozi / Igenamiterere / Ibiranga.
help-board-visibility-what-it-is-descrip: Ukugaragara kugena ushobora kubona ikibaho: abantu bongewe kuri cyo gusa (Bwite), umukoresha wese winjiye wa WeKan (Abakoresha binjiye), cyangwa uwo ari we wese ufite ihuza (Rusange). Guhindura bigumana abanyamuryango b'ikibaho keretse umuyobozi w'ikibaho yemeye ukundi.
help-board-visibility-how-it-works-descr: Umuyobozi w'ikibaho akanda buto y'ukugaragara mu mutwe w'ikibaho agahitamo Bwite, Abakoresha binjiye cyangwa Rusange; ihitamo riri ho rifite akamenyetso, kandi buto ihita yerekana igenamiterere rishya. Ku kibaho cy'Abakoresha binjiye cyangwa Rusange, iyo umuyobozi abyemeye, umuyobozi w'ikibaho ashobora kandi gushyiraho akamenyetso kuri Buri wese winjiye ashobora guhindura. Ku bandi bantu, buto yerekana igenamiterere gusa.
help-board-watch-what-it-is-description: Kurikirana igena uko wumva amakuru y'iki kibaho: Gukurikirana kukumenyesha impinduka zose, Gukurikirana amakarita gusa impinduka z'amakarita waremye cyangwa uri umunyamuryango wayo, na Byacecekeshejwe nta kintu. Iri genamiterere ni iryawe; abandi banyamuryango bihitiramo ayabo.
help-board-watch-how-it-works-descriptio: Kanda buto yo gukurikirana mu mutwe w'ikibaho hanyuma uhitemo Gukurikirana, Gukurikirana amakarita cyangwa Byacecekeshejwe; urwego rwawe rw'ubu rufite akamenyetso kandi buto yerekana urwego rushya. Iyo impinduka yanzwe, ubutumwa buvuga impamvu kandi nta kintu gihinduka. Buto irahishwa iyo umuyobozi yazimije gukurikirana.
help-board-sort-cards-what-it-is-descrip: Tondeka amakarita ihindura uko amakarita agaragara akurikirana muri buri rutonde: ukurikije itariki ntarengwa, umutwe, igihe yakorewe, amajwi cyangwa uko ibirango by'ikibaho bikurikirana. Ihindura gusa ibyo ubona, kandi nta karita yimurwa.
help-board-sort-cards-how-it-works-descr: Kanda Tondeka amakarita mu mutwe w'ikibaho hanyuma uhitemo uko bikurikirana; amakarita ya buri rutonde arakurikiza, kandi buto ivuga Gutondeka birakora. Kanda X iri iruhande rwayo kugira ngo ukureho itondeka usubire ku buryo amakarita yakururiwemo. Amahitamo abikwa muri mushakisha yawe n'iyo wongeye gutangiza paji. Ku Uko ibirango bikurikirana, umuyobozi w'ikibaho ashobora guhindura uko ibirango bikurikirana akoresheje Kwimura hejuru na Kwimura hasi igihe ahindura ikirango.
help-board-settings-what-it-is-descripti: Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho rikusanya ibyo byose bigenwa kuri iki kibaho kimwe: amategeko yacyo, igenamigambi, ibara n'ishusho mbuganyuma, amatariki, imigaragarire, imirongo, intonde n'amakarita, gusohora no kwinjiza, amamenyesha, webhooks n'ububiko. Ibintu byinshi ni iby'abayobozi b'ikibaho; inshingano yawe n'igenamiterere ry'urubuga ni byo bigena ibyo ubona.
help-board-settings-how-it-works-descrip: Fungura uruhande rw'iburyo rw'ikibaho ukoresheje menu y'imirongo itatu hanyuma ukande Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho. Hitamo ikintu maze idirishya cyangwa paji yacyo bifunguke. Ibintu bitondekanyije mu matsinda: amategeko mbere, hanyuma isura y'ikibaho, hanyuma uko gishushanywa, hanyuma ibyinjira n'ibisohoka, maze ubwa nyuma ububiko.
help-board-settings-color-what-it-is-des: Hindura ibara igena isura y'amabara y'iki kibaho, ibonwa n'abanyamuryango bose kuri iki kibaho. Ni uburyo bwo gutandukanya ibibaho mu kanya gato. Abayobozi b'ikibaho bonyine ni bo bashobora kuyihindura.
help-board-settings-color-how-it-works-d: Kanda ku cyitegererezo cy'isura; ihita ikoreshwa, nta buto ya Bika. Ku masura asanzwe n'abonerana, ushobora kandi kwihitiramo amabara ukoresheje inziga z'amabara ukayareba mu cyitegererezo. Ibara wihitiyemo mu Igenamiterere ry'umunyamuryango riguma rifite agaciro kuruta ibara ry'ikibaho kuri wowe.
help-board-settings-announcement-what-it: Itangazo ry'ikibaho ni ubutumwa umuyobozi w'ikibaho yandikira abantu bose bari kuri iki kibaho, bwerekanwa mu murongo uri hejuru y'intonde z'ikibaho. Rikoreshe ku nyandiko abanyamuryango bose bagomba kubona, nk'itariki ntarengwa cyangwa impinduka mu buryo ikibaho gikoreshwa.
help-board-settings-announcement-how-it-: Andika umwandiko, kugeza ku nyuguti 2000 z'umwandiko usanzwe, shyiraho akamenyetso kuri Ryereke buri wese uri kuri iki kibaho, hanyuma ukande Bika. Abanyamuryango babona uwo murongo kugeza bawufunze na X yawo, iwuhisha kuri bo gusa. Iyo itangazo rihinduwe, ryongera kwerekwa bose.
help-board-settings-background-what-it-i: Ishusho mbuganyuma ni ishusho yerekanwa inyuma y'intonde z'ikibaho, kandi nk'agashusho k'ikibaho kuri paji y'Ibibaho byose. Ishobora kuba aderesi y'ishusho kuri interineti cyangwa ishusho yashyizweho ikabikwa muri WeKan.
help-board-settings-background-how-it-wo: Andika aderesi y'ishusho muri URL y'Ishusho y'Inyuma hanyuma ukande Bika, cyangwa ukoreshe Kuraho Ishusho y'Inyuma kugira ngo uyikureho. Kugira ngo ubike ishusho, kanda Shyiraho ishusho mbuganyuma hanyuma uhitemo dosiye; amashusho yashyizweho atondekwa munsi, aho gukanda imwe biyigira ishusho mbuganyuma y'ikibaho, kandi utumenyetso turayimanura cyangwa turayisiba.
help-board-settings-date-what-it-is-desc: Itariki yemerera umuyobozi w'ikibaho guhitamo imiterere imwe y'itariki kuri bose bari kuri iki kibaho, aho gukoresha imiterere yashyizweho ku rubuga rwose. Iryo dirishya rifite kandi buto yawe y'inomero y'icyumweru kandi, ku bayobozi b'ikibaho, ihuza rya kalendari rishyira amatariki ntarengwa y'amakarita muri kalendari ya CalDAV nka Nextcloud.
help-board-settings-date-how-it-works-de: Shyiraho akamenyetso kuri Imiterere y'Itariki y'ikibaho, hitamo imiterere hanyuma ukande Bika; kuraho akamenyetso kugira ngo wongere ukurikize igenamiterere ry'urubuga. Imiterere y'umunyamuryango yafunguye mu Igenamiterere ry'umunyamuryango iracyatsinda. Kwerekana icyumweru cy'umwaka bifungura cyangwa bizimya inomero z'ibyumweru kuri wowe ako kanya. Ku guhuza kalendari, andika aderesi ya kalendari, izina ry'ukoresha n'ijambobanga rya porogaramu, shyiraho akamenyetso ku gasanduku ko guhuza hanyuma Bika.
help-board-settings-all-boards-what-it-i: Igenamiterere ry'Ibibaho Byose rigena ibyo agashusho k'iki kibaho kerekana kuri paji y'Ibibaho byose, nk'umubare w'amakarita ya buri rutonde n'amashusho y'abanyamuryango. Rigena kandi gusaza kw'amakarita, gushyira mu bubiko byikora amakarita atakozweho, n'iba ubugari bw'intonde ari ubwa buri muntu cyangwa busangiwe.
help-board-settings-all-boards-how-it-wo: Shyiraho cyangwa ukureho akamenyetso ku murongo maze bibikwe ako kanya. Iyo gusaza kw'amakarita gufunguye, andika imibare itatu y'iminsi nyuma yayo amakarita agenda ahunyuka mu byiciro. Ku gushyira mu bubiko byikora, andika iminsi ikarita ishobora kumara nta gikorwa mbere yo gushyirwa mu bubiko, cyangwa urekere ubusa kugira ngo ubizimye. Inyandikorugero ntizishyirwa mu bubiko na rimwe.
help-board-settings-board-view-what-it-i: Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara gihitamo imigaragarire, nk'Imirongo, Intonde, Imbonerahamwe, Kalendari, Gantt cyangwa ibishushanyo, itangwa muri menu Uko Ikibaho Kigaragara y'iki kibaho, n'iyo ikibaho gifungukiramo. Bigenwa ukwabyo igihe ikibaho ari rusange n'igihe ari bwite.
help-board-settings-board-view-how-it-wo: Idirishya rifite umurongo umwe kuri buri migaragarire n'udusanduku tune: imigaragarire mburabuzi n'imigaragarire yerekanwa ku kibaho rusange, hamwe n'ibyo bibiri ku kibaho bwite. Shyiraho akamenyetso ku gasanduku Erekana k'imigaragarire kugira ngo uyitange muri menu, no ku gasanduku Mburabuzi kayo kugira ngo ikibaho gifungukiremo.
help-board-settings-swimlane-what-it-is-: Umurongo urimo igenamiterere ry'imirongo ku kibaho cyose: niba imirongo ishobora gukururwa, niba uburebure bwayo bushobora guhindurwa, niba imirongo yose isangira umurongo umwe w'imitwe y'intonde, n'imyanya ya Scrum umurongo werekana. Amatsinda y'Urugero rwa WIP, imipaka isangiwe y'akazi kari gukorwa ku ntonde nyinshi, na yo ari hano.
help-board-settings-swimlane-how-it-work: Shyiraho akamenyetso ku dusanduku ushaka; agasanduku Gishobora gukururwa kari mu mbonerahamwe iri hejuru. Umurongo umwe usangiwe w'imitwe y'intonde werekana imirongo yose n'intonde zose z'ikibaho munsi y'umurongo umwe w'imitwe uguma hejuru, udahinduye intonde. Kanda Amatsinda y'Urugero rwa WIP hasi kugira ngo wongereho cyangwa uhindure imipaka isangiwe.
help-board-settings-list-what-it-is-desc: Urutonde rurimo igenamiterere ry'intonde ku kibaho cyose: niba intonde zishobora gukururwa, niba ubugari bwazo bushobora guhindurwa, niba intonde zose zingana, n'umwanya wa Scrum urutonde rwerekana. Rufungura kandi amabwiriza y'Uruzi rwa Kanban: amabwiriza y'intonde, intonde zigabanyijemo Ibiri gukorwa n'Ibyarangiye, ingingo y'ukwiyemeza n'urugero rwa WIP ku muntu.
help-board-settings-list-how-it-works-de: Fungura buto ukeneye; agasanduku Gishobora gukururwa kari mu mbonerahamwe iri hejuru. Iyo guhindura ingano byemewe, kurura agafashe kari hagati y'intonde kugira ngo uhindure ubugari. Umurongo w'ibwiriza ry'uruzi ugaragara gusa iyo icyo kintu gifunguye ku rubuga, kandi iyo gifunguye, ibisobanuro byacyo bigenwa muri menu ya buri rutonde.
help-board-settings-shop-what-it-is-desc: Iduka rihindura amakarita y'ikibaho iduka ryo kuri interineti ryerekanwa mu migaragarire Uko iduka rigaragara. Umuyobozi w'ikibaho ahitamo imyanya yihariye igize igiciro, kode y'igicuruzwa n'ibiri mu bubiko, intonde ziri ku isoko, ibirango bigize ibyiciro, aho komande zandikwa n'uburyo bwo kwishyura butangwa.
help-board-settings-shop-how-it-works-de: Gena imirongo hanyuma ukande Bika; byose bibikwa hamwe kandi bikongera kugenzurwa na seriveri. Ikarita ifite igiciro iri mu rutonde ruri ku isoko ihinduka igicuruzwa. Komande zandikwa nk'amakarita mu Rutonde rwa komande, rugomba kuba ku kibaho bwite, kandi umuguzi ashobora kubona imeyili yemeza. Ushobora kandi kugira Iduka icyo abashyitsi b'ikibaho rusange babona.
help-board-settings-card-what-it-is-desc: Ikarita ihitamo ibyo amakarita mato n'amakarita afunguye y'iki kibaho byerekana, n'uko bikurikirana, buri kimwe ukwacyo. Uyikoreshe igihe ikibaho gishingira ku myanya mike, nko gushyira ibisobanuro cyangwa imyanya yihariye mbere, cyangwa kwerekana itariki ntarengwa mbere ku makarita mato.
help-board-settings-card-how-it-works-de: Idirishya rifite ibice bibiri, Erekana ku Ikarita Ntoyi na Erekana ku Ikarita. Shyiraho cyangwa ukureho akamenyetso ku gice cyangwa ku mwanya kugira ngo uwerekane cyangwa uwuhishe, kandi ukurure imirongo kugira ngo uhindure uko ikurikirana. Ibice bimwe bifite menu yabyo y'igenamiterere ryinshi, nk'Ibikorwa bito n'uburyo bwo gukurura ikarita.
help-board-settings-import-export-what-i: Sohora yandika iki kibaho, cyangwa igice cyacyo, muri dosiye: imiterere ya WeKan ubwayo, impapuro z'imibare, PDF, HTML, amadosiye ya kalendari n'imiterere y'ibindi bikoresho byinshi. Kwinjiza byongera ibirimo bivuye mu isohora rya WeKan kuri iki kibaho. Gusohora ikibaho si kopi y'umutekano y'urubuga rwose.
help-board-settings-import-export-how-it: Muri Sohora, banza uhitemo ibyo ushyiramo, hanyuma ukande ku miterere maze dosiye imanuke. Muri Kwinjiza, hitamo dosiye yasohowe na WeKan iri mu miterere ya json cyangwa zip maze ibirimo byongerwe kuri iki kibaho. Kwinjiza bisaba uburenganzira bwo kwandika ku kibaho, kandi kimwe muri ibyo umuyobozi w'urubuga ashobora kukizimya.
help-board-settings-notifications-what-i: Amamenyesha agena ibisanzwe by'iki kibaho ku mamenyesha ya imeyili no muri porogaramu, ibyibutsa igihe ntarengwa, imeyili ijya ku ikarita, n'uburyo amamenyesha agezwa. Amahitamo y'umunyamuryango ubwe agaragara ashobora kuruta ibisanzwe by'ikibaho.
help-board-settings-notifications-how-it: Ku Gasanduku k'amamenyesha no kuri imeyili, hitamo Mburabuzi kugira ngo ukurikize igenamiterere ry'urubuga, cyangwa Yego cyangwa Oya kugira ngo uriruteho kuri iki kibaho. Munsi ya Ibyibutsa igihe ntarengwa, andika iminsi yo kwibutsa, itandukanyijwe n'utwatuzo, aho 0 ari umunsi ntarengwa kandi imibare iri munsi ya zeru ari iminsi nyuma yawo, hanyuma ukande Bika. Ibice byo kugeza biri munsi bigena ibyo imenyesha ritwara, uko ahurizwa hamwe n'igihe.
help-board-settings-webhooks-what-it-is-: Webhooks Zisohoka zohereza ibikorwa by'iki kibaho kuri serivisi indi, nk'igikoresho cy'ikiganiro cyangwa ihuza ryawe, uko biba. Buri webhook yohereza umwandiko w'igikorwa hamwe n'amazina n'amahuza by'ikibaho, urutonde, umurongo, ikarita n'abantu bireba.
help-board-settings-webhooks-how-it-work: Andika izina, aderesi serivisi yakira yaguhaye kandi, iyo ibishaka, token, uhitemo ubwoko hanyuma ukande Kurema. Webhook yabitswe yerekana ubundi buryo: ibikorwa yohereza, ubutumwa bwihariye ku banyamuryango b'ikarita kuri Mattermost, n'uko ubutumwa bwayo buhurizwa hamwe n'igihe bwoherezwa. Yihindure hanyuma wongere Bika, cyangwa ukoreshe Zimya Iyi Webhook kugira ngo uyihagarike.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-what-: Ibikoresho bibiri by'inama za Scrum, biboneka ku munyamuryango wese w'ikibaho. Inama ya buri munsi ni isaha iha buri munyamuryango igihe kingana, kandi Ikibaho cy'isubiramo kirema ikibaho gishya cy'isubiramo rya Tangira, Hagarika, Komeza.
help-board-settings-scrum-meetings-how-i: Inama ya buri munsi itondeka abanyamuryango b'ikibaho mu buryo buvanze; Tangira ibara igihe cy'umuntu wa mbere, gihinduka umutuku iyo kirenze, kandi Ibikurikira iha ijambo undi kugeza ku wa nyuma. Isaha ikora gusa muri mushakisha yawe. Ikibaho cy'isubiramo kirema kandi kigafungura ikibaho gishya bwite gifite intonde Tangira gukora, Reka gukora, Komeza gukora na Ibikorwa bikenewe.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-wha: Itsinda ry'urugero rwa WIP ni urugero rumwe rw'akazi kari gukorwa rusangiwe n'intonde ebyiri cyangwa zirenga hamwe, hejuru y'urugero rwa buri rutonde. Rifasha igihe akazi kari gukorwa kari mu ntonde nyinshi, nk'Ibiri gukorwa, Isuzuma n'Igerageza, cyangwa igihe ushaka gushyira urugero ku murongo wose.
help-board-settings-wip-limit-groups-how: Munsi ya Ongeraho itsinda ry'urugero rwa WIP, shyiraho akamenyetso ku ntonde zo kubarirwa hamwe, cyangwa uhitemo umurongo ukande Shyira ku murongo kugira ngo ushyire akamenyetso ku ntonde zawo. Gena urugero hanyuma ukande Ongeraho itsinda ry'urugero rwa WIP. Itsinda risanzwe rishobora guhindurwa na Koresha, gufungurwa cyangwa kuzimwa na Koresha Urugero rwa WIP, cyangwa gukurwaho na Siba.
help-board-settings-subtasks-what-it-is-: Ibikorwa bito bigabanya ikarita nini mu makarita mato ashobora guhabwa abantu, guteganyirizwa igihe no kwimurwa ukwayo, mu gihe ikarita mubyeyi iyatondeka ikabara ayarangiye. Iri genamiterere rigena aho ibikorwa bito bishya biremerwa n'uko igikorwa gito cyerekana umubyeyi wacyo.
help-board-settings-subtasks-how-it-work: Hitamo uko ikarita ntoyi y'igikorwa gito yita umubyeyi wayo, niba amakarita y'ikibaho afite igice cy'Ibikorwa bito, n'ikibaho, urutonde n'umurongo ibikorwa bito bishya biremerwamo. Mu buryo mburabuzi bijya ku kibaho cyabyo. Ibikorwa bito ubwabyo byongerwaho uhereye mu gice cy'Ibikorwa bito cy'ikarita ifunguye.
help-rules-what-it-is-description: Amategeko atuma ikibaho gikora cyonyine: iyo hari ikintu kibaye, imbarutso, WeKan ikora ikintu, igikorwa. Urugero, iyo ikarita yimuriwe muri Byarangiye, yerekane ko yarangiye. Amategeko aremwa n'abayobozi b'ikibaho, kandi ikibaho gishobora kwemerera abanyamuryango bacyo kuyasoma.
help-rules-how-it-works-description: Andika umutwe, hitamo imbarutso wuzuze imyanya yayo, hanyuma uhitemo igikorwa; itegeko rirabikwa kandi rigakora kuva icyo gihe keretse rizimijwe. Mu migaragarire Uko urukurikirane rw'ibikorwa rugaragara ushobora kubaka amategeko ukurura imbarutso n'igikorwa. Amategeko ashobora guhindurirwa izina, gusibwa, gusohorwa no kwinjizwa, kandi itegeko rishobora kugira imbarutso n'ibikorwa byinshi mu bisobanuro byaryo.
help-member-settings-what-it-is-descript: Igenamiterere ry'umunyamuryango ni menu yawe bwite, ifungurwa uhereye ku izina ryawe ry'ukoresha cyangwa ishusho yawe iri hejuru iburyo. Irimo paji zawe nka Amakarita yanjye, Amakarita Agejeje Igihe na Byashyizweho inyenyeri, incamake z'ibibaho, n'igenamiterere ryawe ryose bwite, kuva ku mwirondoro n'ijambobanga kugeza ku rurimi n'imyandikire.
help-member-settings-how-it-works-descri: Kanda ku izina ryawe ry'ukoresha cyangwa ishusho yawe hanyuma uhitemo ikintu; paji cyangwa idirishya ryacyo rirafunguka. Ibyo ubona biterwa n'ubwoko bwa konti yawe, inshingano yawe n'igenamiterere ry'urubuga. Iyo umwirondoro w'ibiranga w'umuyobozi w'urubuga uhishe ibintu bimwe kuri wowe, menu ivuga umubare w'ibyahishwe.
help-member-edit-profile-what-it-is-desc: Hindura Umwirondoro ihindura uko abandi bantu bakubona muri WeKan: izina ryawe ryuzuye n'inyuguti z'intangiriro, kandi, iyo urubuga rubyemera, izina ryawe ry'ukoresha na aderesi ya imeyili. Iyo urubuga rubyemera, ushobora kandi gusiba cyangwa guhisha umwirondoro wa konti yawe hano.
help-member-edit-profile-how-it-works-de: Hindura imyanya hanyuma ukande Bika; idirishya rirafungwa iyo byakunze kandi rikerekana ikosa bitabaye ibyo. Izina ry'ukoresha cyangwa aderesi ya imeyili isanzwe ikoreshwa na konti indi irangwa, kandi aderesi ya imeyili yahinduwe yerekanwa ko itaremezwa. Siba ikuraho konti yawe nta gusubira inyuma, mu gihe Hisha umwirondoro wa konti igumana amateka yawe ariko igasimbuza izina ryawe.
help-member-change-settings-what-it-is-d: Hindura Igenamiterere irimo amahitamo yawe bwite yo guhindura no kwerekana, nk'udufashe two gukurura, kwerekana amakarita yahindutse kuva uheruka kuyafungura, umurongo w'ibandwaho, kubika ibyo uhindura na Enter, gufungura amakarita menshi icyarimwe n'ijwi ry'urutonde rw'igenzura. Akora kuri wowe gusa, ku bibaho byose.
help-member-change-settings-how-it-works: Kanda kuri buto kugira ngo uyifungure cyangwa uyizimye; akamenyetso kerekana ko ifunguye kandi bibikwa ako kanya. Ku Kwerekana umubare w'amakarita iyo urutonde rufite arenga, andika umubare hanyuma ukande Bika. Imiterere y'itariki, intangiriro y'icyumweru n'amamenyesha bifite ibintu byabyo mu Igenamiterere ry'umunyamuryango.
help-member-change-color-what-it-is-desc: Hindura ibara igena isura y'amabara yawe bwite ya WeKan. Iruta isura y'urubuga ahantu hose kandi n'ibara ry'ikibaho kuri paji z'ikibaho, ariko kuri wowe gusa.
help-member-change-color-how-it-works-de: Kanda ku cyitegererezo cy'isura; ihita ikoreshwa. Ku masura asanzwe n'abonerana, ushobora kwihitiramo amabara ukoresheje inziga z'amabara ukayabona mu cyitegererezo. Hitamo isura Mburabuzi kugira ngo ukureho amahitamo yawe wongere ubone amabara y'ikibaho cyangwa y'urubuga.
help-member-change-font-what-it-is-descr: Imyandikire ikwemerera kwihitiramo ubwoko bw'inyuguti, ingano y'umwandiko n'ibara ry'umwandiko by'isura yose ya WeKan. Bifasha gusoma, urugero n'ingano nini cyangwa ibara rihuye n'amaso yawe.
help-member-change-font-how-it-works-des: Kanda Mburabuzi cyangwa imwe muri buto z'imyandikire; imyandikire yashyizwe muri mushakisha yawe gusa ni yo itangwa. Hitamo ingano n'ibara ry'umwandiko ku ruziga rw'amabara, cyangwa ukande Kuraho kugira ngo usubire ku ibara ry'isura. Impinduka zikora ako kanya kandi zibikwa mu mwirondoro wawe, kandi umurongo w'icyitegererezo werekana ibyavuyemo.
help-member-change-avatar-what-it-is-des: Ishusho y'ukoresha ni ishusho nto ikugaragaza ku makarita, mu ntonde z'abanyamuryango, mu bitekerezo no mu mutwe. Hindura Ishusho y'Ukoresha igufasha gushyiraho amashusho, guhitamo ikoreshwa, kuyasiba, cyangwa gusubira ku nyuguti zawe.
help-member-change-avatar-how-it-works-d: Kanda Shyiraho ishusho y'ukoresha hanyuma uhitemo ishusho; yongerwa ku rutonde, kandi gukanda ku murongo wayo biyigira ishusho yawe, ifite akamenyetso. Kanda Inyuguti z'intangiriro kugira ngo werekane inyuguti zawe mu mwanya wayo. Akamenyetso k'igiseke gasiba ishusho umaze kwemeza. Idirishya ryerekana imipaka y'ingano n'ubwoko bwa dosiye iyo urubuga ruyishyizeho.
help-member-change-password-what-it-is-d: Hindura ijambobanga risimbuza ijambobanga winjirana muri WeKan. Ni iry'amakonti afite ijambobanga rya WeKan; konti zinjira zinyuze kuri serivisi indi zihindurira ijambobanga ryazo aho.
help-member-change-password-how-it-works: Andika ijambobanga ryawe ry'ubu, hanyuma ijambobanga rishya kabiri, maze wohereze. Urubuga rushobora gusaba uburebure buto no kwanga amagambobanga yegereye cyane izina ryawe ry'ukoresha cyangwa imeyili, cyangwa yabonetse mu makuru yamenetse azwi. Nyuma y'impinduka, ibihe byose bya konti yawe birasohorwa, ukongera kwinjira ukoresheje ijambobanga rishya.
help-member-passkeys-what-it-is-descript: Urufunguzo rwo kwinjira rukwemerera kwinjira ukoresheje igikumwe, isura, ifunga rya ekarani cyangwa urufunguzo rw'umutekano by'iki gikoresho aho gukoresha ijambobanga. Urufunguzo ruguma ku gikoresho cyawe kandi WeKan ibika igice cyarwo rusange gusa.
help-member-passkeys-how-it-works-descri: Andika izina nka Telefoni yanjye hanyuma ukande Ongeraho urufunguzo rwo kwinjira kuri iki gikoresho, hanyuma wemeze ukoresheje ifunga rya ekarani igihe mushakisha ibisabye. Imfunguzo zawe zitondekwa n'amazina yazo n'amatariki, kandi akamenyetso k'igiseke gakuraho rumwe. Iyo mushakisha idashobora kurema imfunguzo, idirishya rirabivuga.
help-member-sqrl-what-it-is-description: SQRL ikwemerera kwinjira usoma kode ya QR ukoresheje porogaramu ya SQRL, nta jambobanga. Hano wongeraho umwirondoro wawe wa SQRL kuri konti yawe rimwe, cyangwa ukongera ukawukuraho.
help-member-sqrl-how-it-works-descriptio: Kanda Ongeraho umwirondoro wanjye wa SQRL maze kode ya QR igaragare. Uyisome ukoresheje porogaramu ya SQRL, cyangwa ukande Fungura umukiriya wa SQRL ku mukiriya uri kuri iyi mudasobwa; idirishya rikumenyesha igihe umwirondoro wongeweho, cyangwa iyo kode yarenze igihe cyangwa yanze. Kuraho umwirondoro wanjye wa SQRL iwukura kuri konti yawe.
help-member-two-factor-what-it-is-descri: Kwemeza mu Bice Bibiri bituma kwinjira gusaba kode y'imibare 6 ivuye kuri porogaramu yo kwemeza iri kuri telefoni yawe nyuma y'ijambobanga, ku buryo ijambobanga ryibwe ryonyine ridahagije kwinjira muri konti yawe.
help-member-two-factor-how-it-works-desc: Kanda Gukoresha Kwemeza mu Bice Bibiri, hanyuma usome kode ya QR ukoresheje porogaramu yo kwemeza cyangwa wandike kode iri munsi yayo muri iyo porogaramu. Andika kode y'imibare 6 porogaramu yerekana hanyuma ukande Emeza kandi Ukoreshe. Kuva icyo gihe kwinjira gusaba kode, kandi iryo dirishya rishobora kubizimya keretse umuyobozi wawe abisaba.
help-member-hidden-boards-what-it-is-des: Ibibaho byahishwe bitondeka ibibaho wavuyemo washoboraga kugeraho unyuze mu itsinda, mu kigo cyangwa mu ndangarubuga ya imeyili yawe, bityo WeKan ikabiguhisha aho. Kuva mu kibaho nk'icyo ntibihindura ubunyamuryango bwawe mu itsinda cyangwa mu kigo.
help-member-hidden-boards-how-it-works-d: Idirishya ryerekana umurongo umwe kuri buri kibaho cyahishwe, cyangwa rikavuga ko nta na kimwe. Kanda Garura iruhande rw'ikibaho kugira ngo ugisubize mu Bibaho byose. Ibyo bigikura gusa ku rutonde rwawe rw'ibyahishwe; niba ushobora gufungura ikibaho biracyagenwa n'ikibaho ubwacyo.
help-member-change-language-what-it-is-d: Hindura Ururimi ihitamo ururimi rw'isura ya WeKan kuri wowe. Amahitamo yawe abikwa mu mwirondoro wawe, ku buryo agukurikira muri buri mushakisha. Kugeza uhisemo, WeKan ikurikiza indimi za mushakisha yawe ikisunga Icyongereza.
help-member-change-language-how-it-works: Indimi zitondekwa n'amazina yazo bwite, hamwe n'ibendera, umurongo w'akarere ku ndimi z'uturere n'inyandiko ku ndimi zandikwa kuva iburyo ujya ibumoso; urw'ubu rufite akamenyetso. Kanda ku rurimi maze isura ihinduke ako kanya.
help-member-invite-people-what-it-is-des: Tumira Abantu yohereza imeyili irimo kode y'ubutumire ku bantu batarafite konti, ku buryo biyandikisha mu gihe kwiyandikisha ubwawe kuzimije. Yemerera abanyamuryango b'indangarubuga ya imeyili y'ikigo kuzana abo bakorana nta muyobozi.
help-member-invite-people-how-it-works-d: Andika aderesi za imeyili, imwe ku murongo cyangwa zitandukanyijwe n'utwatuzo, shyiraho akamenyetso ku bibaho bagomba kwinjiramo igihe biyandikishije, hanyuma ukande Tumira. Idirishya rivuga niba ubutumire bwoherejwe. Ukenera inshingano y'ikibaho ishobora gutumira kuri buri kibaho cyashyizweho akamenyetso, kandi aderesi isanzwe ifite konti ihagarika kohereza.
help-member-date-what-it-is-description: Itariki ihitamo uko amatariki yandikwa kuri wowe, nk'umwaka-ukwezi-umunsi cyangwa umunsi-ukwezi-umwaka, hamwe n'isaha cyangwa idahari. Imiterere yawe wafunguye iruta iy'ikibaho n'iy'urubuga. Iryo dirishya rigena kandi umunsi wa mbere w'icyumweru n'uburyo bwa kalendari.
help-member-date-how-it-works-descriptio: Hejuru y'idirishya herekana imiterere y'urubuga n'iy'ikibaho cy'ubu, ku buryo ubona ibyo wazungura. Shyiraho akamenyetso kuri Igenamiterere ry'umunyamuryango: Imiterere y'Itariki uhitemo imiterere, gena intangiriro y'icyumweru n'uburyo bwa kalendari niba ubishaka, hanyuma ukande Bika. Kuraho akamenyetso ku miterere yawe ubike kugira ngo wongere ukurikize ikibaho cyangwa urubuga.
help-bookmarks-what-it-is-description: Itsinda ry'inyenyeri mu mutwe ni menu y'ibyo wibukije: igumana ibibaho, izindi paji za WeKan, kandi uhereye muri menu zabyo, imirongo, intonde n'amakarita, ku gukanda rimwe. Inyenyeri zawe ni izawe wenyine.
help-bookmarks-how-it-works-description: Kanda ku nyenyeri kugira ngo ushyireho cyangwa ukureho inyenyeri ku kibaho cyangwa ku paji uriho; umubare werekana izo ufite. Kanda ku kamenyetso cyangwa ku mubare kugira ngo ufungure urutonde hanyuma ukande ku murongo kugira ngo ujyeyo, cyangwa Reba ibintu byose bifite inyenyeri kuri paji yose ya Byashyizweho inyenyeri. Mu Bibaho byose / Byashyizweho inyenyeri ushobora gukuraho inyenyeri no gukurura udushusho kugira ngo uhindure uko bikurikirana.
help-card-similar-cards-what-it-is-descr: Amakarita asa atondeka amakarita y'iki kibaho umutwe n'ibisobanuro byayo bisa cyane n'iyi, ku buryo kopi ya kabiri y'igikorwa kimwe ibonwa mbere y'uko akazi gakorwa kabiri. Ihuye cyane yerekanwa nka Bishobora kuba byisubiyemo.
help-card-similar-cards-how-it-works-des: Kugeza ku makarita atanu asa yerekanwa hano, buri imwe n'urutonde irimo, kandi umutwe urayabara. Kanda imwe kugira ngo uyifungure. Kugereranya ni uguhuza umwandiko usanzwe gukorwa na seriveri, nta serivisi ya AI. Iki gice gishobora guhishwa mu Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho / Ikarita, umurongo Amakarita asa, Erekana ku Ikarita.
help-card-activities-what-it-is-descript: Ibikorwa ni amateka y'ikarita ubwayo: uwayiremye, uwahinduye umutwe wayo, uwongeyeho ikirango, uwayimuye, uwanditse igitekerezo cyangwa uwometseho dosiye, n'igihe. Bisubiza ibyabaye kuri iyi karita utabajije uwo ari we wese.
help-card-activities-how-it-works-descri: Ibyabaye vuba bitondekwa ku murongo, imitwe, ibirango, ibice by'ibitekerezo n'amazina y'amadosiye byerekanwa mu buryo bumwe nk'ubwo ku ikarita ubwayo. Kanda ku mutwe ufite ihuza kugira ngo ujye kuri iyo karita, urutonde cyangwa ikibaho. Umuyobozi w'urubuga ashobora guhitamo mu Buyobozi / Igenamiterere / Umutekano kwerekana umwandiko utunganyijwe nk'umwandiko usanzwe cyangwa nta mahuza akandwaho.
help-card-labels-what-it-is-description: Ibirango ni utumenyetso tw'amabara tw'ikibaho, dukoreshwa mu guhuriza hamwe no kuyungurura amakarita ukurikije insanganyamatsiko, ukwihutirwa cyangwa icyo itsinda ryemeranyijwe cyose. Ikirango gishobora kandi kugira itariki ntarengwa yacyo, igituma kiba intambwe y'ingenzi yoroheje nka Sprint 1 cyangwa v2.0 ku makarita yose agifite.
help-card-labels-how-it-works-descriptio: Kanda ku kirango cyangwa kuri buto yo kongeraho kugira ngo ufungure idirishya ry'ibirango, hanyuma ukande ku birango kugira ngo ubishyire ku ikarita cyangwa ubikureho; akamenyetso kerekana ibyahiswemo. Ikaramu iri iruhande rw'ikirango ihindura izina ryacyo, ibara n'itariki ntarengwa, kandi ikirango gifite itariki ntarengwa cyerekana iyo tariki iruhande rwacyo. Udushushondanga n'ahantu biri muri iki gice.
help-card-dates-what-it-is-description: Ikarita ifite amatariki ane adasabwa: Byakiriwe igihe igikorwa cyageze, Intangiriro igihe akazi katangiye, Igihe Ntarengwa ku gihe ntarengwa n'Iherezo igihe karangiye. Akamenyetso k'itariki ntarengwa gafite ibara bitewe n'ukwihutirwa kandi kabara iminsi isigaye, ku buryo akazi katinze kagaragara ku kibaho.
help-card-dates-how-it-works-description: Kanda ku kamenyetso ko kongeraho iruhande rw'itariki, cyangwa ku kamenyetso k'itariki, uhitemo umunsi n'isaha hanyuma ubike; itariki ntarengwa idafite isaha yahiswemo ihabwa 17:00. Ongera ufungure iryo dirishya kugira ngo uyihindure cyangwa uyisibe. Iyo utubuto tw'ihuse two kuri mwandikisho dufunguye, gukanda d ku ikarita bifungura itariki ntarengwa yayo. Ikarita ibara kandi inshuro itariki ntarengwa yayo yahinduwe.
help-card-members-what-it-is-description: Igice cy'Abanyamuryango kivuga abafite aho bahuriye n'ikarita: abanyamuryango bayo, abahawe akazi, uwayiremye, uwasabye akazi n'uwakatanze. Byasabwe na na Byashinzwe na bishobora kugira abanyamuryango b'ikibaho kandi n'inyandiko isanzwe, nk'izina rivuye mu kindi gikoresho cyo gukurikirana.
help-card-members-how-it-works-descripti: Kanda ku kamenyetso ko kongeraho kazengurutse mu murongo kugira ngo ufungure urutonde rw'abanyamuryango b'ikibaho uhitemo abantu; berekanwa nk'amashusho cyangwa inyuguti, kandi kongera gukanda ku ishusho birabakuraho. Munsi ya Byasabwe na na Byashinzwe na, ihuza Ongeraho riri munsi y'akamenyetso ryandika umwandiko usanzwe aho. Imirongo igaragara ihitwamo mu Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho / Ikarita.
help-card-fields-what-it-is-description: Igice cy'Ikarita kirimo imyanya y'akazi y'ikarita ubwayo, nk'ibishingirwaho byayo, uko ibujijwe, icyiciro cya serivisi, amanota y'ukwihutirwa, umubare wayo wo gutondeka na buto zayo. Ikarita ifunguye yerekana imyanya yose ikibaho cyahisemo kwerekana ku makarita, irimo ibintu cyangwa itabirimo, yiteguye kuzuzwa.
help-card-fields-how-it-works-descriptio: Uzuza cyangwa uhindure umwanya ako kanya muri iki gice. Ibigaragara hano, mu gice ikihe n'uko bikurikirana bigenwa ku kibaho cyose mu Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho / Ikarita, mu gice Erekana ku Ikarita: shyiraho cyangwa ukureho akamenyetso ku murongo, cyangwa uwukurure kugira ngo uhindure uko bikurikirana. Ikarita ntoyi ikurikiza igice Erekana ku Ikarita Ntoyi mu buryo nk'ubwo.
help-card-time-what-it-is-description: Gukurikirana igihe byandika amasaha yakoreshejwe ku ikarita, hamwe n'ikigereranyo kidasabwa, utumenyetso Byishyuzwa n'Igihe cy'ikirenga n'urutonde rw'umunsi ku munsi rw'uwakoze n'igihe yamaze. Igiteranyo kigaburira imigaragarire y'igihe, umutwaro w'akazi n'inyemezabuguzi by'ikibaho, kandi amasaha Igihe cy’Umuyoboro na Pomodoro ari hano arakongeraho.
help-card-time-how-it-works-description: Kanda ku kamenyetso k'igihe cyangwa kuri menu y'imirongo itatu iruhande rw'Igihe cyakoreshejwe kugira ngo ufungure Hindura igihe cyakoreshejwe, andika amasaha (imibare ifite akadomo iremewe), ikigereranyo n'utumenyetso niba ubishaka, hanyuma Bika. Munsi ya Igihe ku munsi, hitamo itariki, andika amasaha n'inyandiko hanyuma ukande Andika igihe; ushobora gukuraho ibyo wanditse kugeza byemejwe cyangwa byishyujwe. Akamenyetso gahinduka umutuku iyo Igihe cy'ikirenga gishyizweho akamenyetso.
help-card-custom-fields-what-it-is-descr: Imyanya yihariye ni imyanya y'inyongera y'ikibaho ku makarita yacyo, iruhande rw'imyanya isanzwe: verisiyo, ingengo y'imari, umukiriya, agasanduku ko guhitamo cyangwa ihitamo rivuye ku rutonde. Ishyirwaho rimwe ku kibaho, hanyuma buri karita ishobora kugira agaciro kayo.
help-card-custom-fields-how-it-works-des: Hano uhitamo imyanya yihariye y'ikibaho iyi karita ikoresha kandi ukuzuza agaciro kayo. Imyanya mishya iremerwa mu Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho / Ikarita, mu gice cy'Imyanya yihariye, uhitamo izina n'ubwoko nk'Umwandiko, Umubare, Itariki, Urutonde rumanuka, Agasanduku ko guhitamo cyangwa Ifaranga. Umwanya ushobora kwerekanwa no ku ikarita ntoyi, kandi imyanya y'imibare ishobora guteranywa hejuru ya buri rutonde.
help-card-planning-poker-what-it-is-desc: Poker yo Guteganya yemerera itsinda kugereranya ikarita hamwe. Buri wese ahitamo agaciro mu makarita atabonye ibyo abandi bahisemo, kandi itora rirangiye WeKan yerekana uwahisemo iki n'agaciro katsinze, ku buryo ikigereranyo cyemeranywa aho gukekwa n'umuntu umwe.
help-card-planning-poker-how-it-works-de: Fungura menu y'imirongo itatu y'iki gice, Hindura Poker yo Guteganya, wemerere abakoresha bose binjiye niba ubishaka kandi ushyireho igihe cyo kurangira, hanyuma Bika. Buri utora akanda ku gaciro kamwe; gukanda ku kandi bihindura itora. Umuyobozi w'ikibaho akanda Rangiza kugira ngo abone ibyavuyemo, akandika umubare hanyuma agakanda Gena Ikigereranyo. Ongera ukine ikuraho amatora ku cyiciro gishya.
help-card-scrum-what-it-is-description: Igenamiterere rya Scrum ririmo umwanya w'ikarita mu igenamigambi rya Scrum ry'ikibaho: sprint yayo na sprint zashize, isohora, ubwoko bw'ikibazo, ibisabwa ngo byemerwe n'urwego mu bitegereje. Ikarita ishobora kandi kwerekanwa nka Inkuru cyangwa Igikorwa, ibyo imigaragarire ya sprint n'ibitegereje ikoresha.
help-card-scrum-how-it-works-description: Fungura Hindura munsi y'imyanya kugira ngo uyihindure hanyuma Bika; abashobora guhindura ikarita bonyine ni bo bashobora kuyihindura. Menu y'imirongo itatu mu mutwe w'iki gice ihitamo ubwoko bw'ikarita: nta na kimwe, Inkuru cyangwa Igikorwa. Sprint ubwazo ziteganywa, zitangirwa kandi zifungwa mu migaragarire ya Scrum y'ikibaho, kandi imyanya igaragara igenwa mu Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho / Ikarita.
help-card-description-what-it-is-descrip: Ibisobanuro ni umwandiko w'ingenzi w'ikarita: ibisobanuro by'igikorwa, inyandiko, amahuza cyangwa inyandiko z'inama zashyizwemo. Byandikwa muri Markdown, ku buryo bishobora kugira imitwe, intonde, amahuza, emoji n'amashusho mu gihe biguma ari umwandiko usanzwe wo guhindura.
help-card-description-how-it-works-descr: Kanda ku bisobanuro kugira ngo ubihindure mu gasanduku k'umwandiko usanzwe. Andika ikimenyetso cya at n'intangiriro y'izina kugira ngo ubone ibyifuzo by'abanyamuryango. Bika, maze umwandiko werekanwe utunganyijwe. Amadosiye yashyizweho aguma mu gice cy'Imigereka kandi ashobora kuvugwa mu mwandiko.
help-card-checklists-what-it-is-descript: Urutonde rw'igenzura ni urutonde rw'ibintu biri ku ikarita, buri kimwe gishyirwaho akamenyetso iyo kirangiye, ku ntambwe, ibisabwa ngo byemerwe cyangwa ibikorwa bya buri gihe. Ikarita ishobora kugira nyinshi, kandi ikarita ntoyi ishobora kwerekana umubare w'ibintu byarangiye.
help-card-checklists-how-it-works-descri: Ongeraho urutonde rw'igenzura ukoresheje akamenyetso ko kongeraho, hanyuma wongereho ibintu ubishyireho akamenyetso uko birangira. Menu y'imirongo itatu ya buri rutonde rw'igenzura irimo ibikorwa byarwo: guhindura ibintu byose icyarimwe nk'umwandiko, gusohora cyangwa kwinjiza, kurwimura cyangwa kurukoporora, gushyiraho cyangwa gukuraho akamenyetso ku bintu byose, guhisha ibintu byarangiye, gushyiraho isubiramo ryikora rikuraho akamenyetso kuri byose buri munsi, buri cyumweru cyangwa buri kwezi, cyangwa kurusiba. Urutonde rw'igenzura rushobora kandi kugira itariki ntarengwa yarwo.
help-card-subtasks-what-it-is-descriptio: Ibikorwa bito bigabanya ikarita nini mu makarita mato ashobora guhabwa abantu, guteganyirizwa igihe no kwimurwa ukwayo, mu gihe iyi karita mubyeyi iyatondeka ikabara ayarangiye. Igikorwa gito ni ikarita isanzwe, ibikwa ku kibaho cyahiswemo ku bikorwa bito.
help-card-subtasks-how-it-works-descript: Kanda ku kamenyetso ko kongeraho, wandike umutwe hanyuma Bika kugira ngo urema igikorwa gito; shyiraho akamenyetso kuri Rarikira utumenyetso tw'ikarita mubyeyi kugira ngo ukoporore ibirango by'iyi karita kuri cyo. Akamenyetso k'ihuza kongeraho ikarita isanzwe iriho nk'igikorwa gito aho. Menu y'imirongo itatu ya buri gikorwa gito ifite Birebe, Jya ku Kibaho kandi, ku bayobozi b'ikibaho, Siba. Kanda ku mutwe w'igikorwa gito kugira ngo uwuhindure.
help-card-attachments-what-it-is-descrip: Imigereka ni amadosiye abikwa hamwe n'ikarita: inyandiko, amashusho, amashusho yimuka, inyandiko za porogaramu cyangwa ububiko bufunze. Ishusho ishobora kandi kuba ishusho y'igipfukisho yerekanwa ku ikarita ntoyi.
help-card-attachments-how-it-works-descr: Kanda ku kamenyetso ko kongeraho kugira ngo wongereho amadosiye avuye kuri mudasobwa yawe, ushyiremo cyangwa ujugunyemo ishusho, wometseho indi karita, cyangwa ushushanye ishusho nshya. Urugero rw'ingano n'ubwoko bw'amadosiye byemewe byerekanwa munsi y'ayo mahitamo. Kanda ku mugereka kugira ngo uwufungure mu kwerekana amashusho, kandi ukoreshe buto ziri iruhande rwawo kugira ngo uwumanure, uwuhindurire izina cyangwa uwusibe; menu yawo y'imirongo itatu irimo amahitamo y'ishusho y'igipfukisho.
help-card-comments-what-it-is-descriptio: Ibitekerezo ni ikiganiro cy'ikarita: ibibazo, ibisubizo, amakuru mashya n'ibyemezo, bibikwa hamwe n'akazi bireba. Igitekerezo gishobora gusubiza icyabanje, kandi igisubizo cyerekanwa munsi yacyo nk'urudodo.
help-card-comments-how-it-works-descript: Andika mu mwanya w'igitekerezo, ukoresheje Markdown kandi uvuga abantu ukoresheje ikimenyetso cya at, hanyuma ucyohereze. Kanda Subiza iruhande rw'igitekerezo kugira ngo ugisubize; ikimenyetso Mu gusubiza cyerekana icyo urimo gusubiza, kandi kugifunga bigira igitekerezo gisanzwe. Ushobora guhindura cyangwa gusiba ibitekerezo byawe, kandi ku bibaho bimwe uwanditse igitekerezo wenyine ni we ushobora kugihindura.
help-card-stickers-what-it-is-descriptio: Udushushondanga ni utumenyetso duto dushyirwa ku ikarita, nk'igikumwe hejuru, agakoko, isaha cyangwa igikombe, kugira ngo uyerekane mu kanya gato udakoresheje ikirango cyangwa ibara. Twerekanwa ku ikarita ntoyi no ku ikarita ifunguye.
help-card-stickers-how-it-works-descript: Kanda ku gashushondanga mu byo guhitamo kugira ngo ugashyire ku ikarita; akamenyetso kerekana ko kari ku ikarita, kandi kongera kugakandaho birakavanaho. Mu ikarita, umusaraba muto uri iruhande rw'agashushondanga urakavanaho. Kongeraho no gukuraho bisaba uburenganzira bwo guhindura ikarita.
help-card-locations-what-it-is-descripti: Ikarita ishobora kugira ahantu henshi, aho akazi gakorerwa, nk'ibiro by'umukiriya, ikibanza cyangwa aho ibirori bibera. Buri hantu hafite izina, aderesi kandi, iyo bizwi, ibipimo bifite ihuza Fungura ku ikarita y'ahantu.
help-card-locations-how-it-works-descrip: Uzuza izina ry'ahantu, aderesi, latitude na longitude hanyuma ukande Bika. Gushyiramo ihuza ry'ikarita y'ahantu bituma idirishya rimenya aho hantu ryonyine, ku buryo nta muntu ugomba kwandika ibipimo. Gukanda ku hantu ku ikarita byongera kuhafungura kugira ngo uhahindure cyangwa uhasibe, kandi umusaraba uri iruhande rwaho urahakuraho ako kanya.
help-card-dependencies-what-it-is-descri: Ibishingirwaho bihuza iyi karita n'andi makarita: irayabuza, ibuzwa na yo, irayakosora, iyasubiramo cyangwa ifitanye isano na yo. Iyo ibishingirwaho bifunguwe mu Igenamiterere ry'umunyamuryango, bishushanywa nk'imirongo y'imyambi y'amabara ku kibaho cyose, ku buryo uko akazi gakurikirana kagaragara mu kanya gato.
help-card-dependencies-how-it-works-desc: Hitamo ubwoko bw'isano n'ibara, hanyuma ushakishe ukande ku ikarita yo guhuza. Ihuza ryerekanwa mu Bishingirwaho by'ikarita no nk'umurongo ku kibaho. Kanda ku murongo, cyangwa ukoreshe Ibishingirwaho by'ikarita, kugira ngo uhindure ubwoko bwawo, ibara cyangwa akamenyetso, cyangwa kuwukuraho. Ushobora kandi gukurura agafashe ko guhuza k'ikarita ntoyi ukakajyana ku yindi karita.
help-card-action-items-what-it-is-descri: Ibikorwa bikenewe bihindura imirongo y'ibyo gukora iri mu nyandiko z'inama zashyizwemo amakarita. Imirongo nka TODO: Gufata aho inama izabera, umurongo w'igikorwa udashyizweho akamenyetso, cyangwa umurongo utangirwa no kuvuga umuntu iramenyekana ukurikije imiterere yayo, nta AI.
help-card-action-items-how-it-works-desc: Idirishya ritondeka amakarita yaremwa, buri imwe ifite akamenyetso n'umunyamuryango kuvugwa kwerekana. Kuraho akamenyetso ku byo udashaka hanyuma ukande Kurema. Amakarita mashya ajya mu rutonde rumwe n'iyi karita kandi asubira kuyihuza. Kuvugwa guhinduka umunyamuryango gusa iyo uwo muntu ari umunyamuryango ukora w'ikibaho.
help-card-history-what-it-is-description: Amateka ni urutonde rw'impinduka zose zakozwe kuri iyi karita: uwahinduye iki, ryari, n'agaciro kavuyeho n'akagiyeho. Impinduka iyo ari yo yose ishobora guhitwamo igasubizwaho, ku buryo ikosa rishobora gukosorwa no nyuma.
help-card-history-how-it-works-descripti: Andika muri Shakisha kugira ngo ugabanye imirongo, cyangwa ukande ku ishusho y'umuntu kugira ngo ubone impinduka ze gusa. Nyura mu paji ukoresheje imyambi. Shyiraho akamenyetso ku murongo umwe cyangwa irenga hanyuma ukande Garura; imirongo myinshi igarurwa uhereye ku ya kera nk'impinduka imwe, na yo ishobora gusubizwa inyuma. Ctrl+Z na Ctrl+Y na byo bisubiza inyuma kandi bigasubiramo impinduka yawe iheruka.
help-card-qr-code-what-it-is-description: Kode ya QR yerekana ihuza ry'iyi karita nka kode ushobora gusoma, kugira ngo ufungure ikarita kuri telefoni cyangwa tablete utanditse aderesi yayo. Nta cyo ihindura ku ikarita.
help-card-qr-code-how-it-works-descripti: Erekeza kamera ya telefoni kuri iyo kode hanyuma ufungure ihuza; aderesi yerekanwa kandi nk'umwandiko munsi yayo. Kode ishushanywa muri mushakisha yawe kandi nta kintu cyoherezwa ahandi. Uyisomye wese aracyakenera kwinjira no kugira uburenganzira ku kibaho. Ihuza rirerire cyane ku kode ya QR rivugwa aho.
help-card-move-what-it-is-description: Kwimura ikarita byimurira ikarita ahandi kuri iki kibaho cyangwa ku kindi kibaho. Bikora nk'ugukurura, kandi n'aho gukurura bidashobora kugera, nk'ikindi kibaho cyangwa umwanya nyawo mu rutonde rurerure.
help-card-move-how-it-works-description: Hitamo ikibaho, umurongo n'urutonde, hanyuma ikarita n'iba ujya hejuru cyangwa munsi yayo. Ushobora guhindura umutwe, kwandika impamvu yo kwimura idasabwa, no gushyiraho akamenyetso kuri Siga ihuza aho yari iri mbere kugira ngo ugumane ikarita ihujwe aho yari iri. Kanda Byarangiye iyo aho ujya hamaze kugera. Shift+M na yo ifungura iri dirishya, kandi aho ujya hibukwa kuri buri kibaho.
help-card-copy-what-it-is-description: Gukoporora ikarita birema kopi nshya yigenga y'ikarita kuri iki kibaho cyangwa ku kindi, ifite inomero yayo na kopi zayo z'ibitekerezo, intonde z'igenzura, imigereka n'ibikorwa bito.
help-card-copy-how-it-works-description: Hindura umutwe niba ubishaka; umutwe w'ubusa nta cyo ukoporora. Hitamo ikibaho, umurongo n'urutonde, hanyuma ikarita n'iba kopi ijya hejuru cyangwa munsi yayo, hanyuma ukande Byarangiye. Iyo kopi yanzwe, impamvu yerekanwa hano. Shift+C na yo ifungura iri dirishya, kandi aho ujya hibukwa kuri buri kibaho.
help-card-recurrence-what-it-is-descript: Gusubira kw'ikarita bituma WeKan irema kopi nshya y'iyi karita mu rutonde rumwe ukurikije gahunda, ku kazi gasubirwamo nka raporo y'icyumweru cyangwa inyemezabuguzi y'ukwezi byakongera kuremwa n'intoki.
help-card-recurrence-how-it-works-descri: Hitamo Buri munsi, Buri cyumweru cyangwa Buri kwezi, cyangwa Birazimye kugira ngo ubihagarike; Birazimye ni byo mburabuzi. Seriveri ihita ikora kopi yonyine, nta yindi tegura ikenewe. Gushyira ikarita mu bubiko na byo bibuza kurema izindi kopi, n'iyo igihe cyaba kigishyizweho.
help-card-copy-many-what-it-is-descripti: Kopera Inyandikorugero ku Makarita Menshi birema kopi nyinshi z'iyi karita icyarimwe. Ikarita ikora nk'icyitegererezo: intonde zayo z'igenzura, imigereka, ibirango n'indi myanya bijya kuri buri kopi, umutwe n'ibisobanuro gusa ni byo bitandukana.
help-card-copy-many-how-it-works-descrip: Mu gasanduku k'umwandiko, andika ikintu kimwe kuri buri karita gifite umutwe wayo n'ibisobanuro, ukurikije urugero rumaze kuzuzwa. Hitamo ikibaho, umurongo, urutonde n'umwanya uri iruhande rw'ikarita, hanyuma ukande Byarangiye. Iyo umwandiko utari mu miterere ikwiye, nta kintu kiremwa kandi ikosa ryerekanwa hano.
help-card-color-what-it-is-description: Gena ibara iha ikarita ibara ryayo ry'inyuma ku buryo igaragara cyane ku kibaho, nk'umutuku ku kazi kihutirwa cyangwa ibara ry'umukiriya. Umwandiko w'ikarita uhita ushobora gusomwa kuri iryo bara.
help-card-color-how-it-works-description: Kanda kuri rimwe mu mabara afite amazina, ibara ryihariye risanzwe rikoreshwa kuri iki kibaho, cyangwa uhitemo ibara iryo ari ryo ryose munsi ya Ibara ryihariye, hanyuma ukande Bika. Kuraho ikuraho ibara. Ibara rigaragara ku ikarita ntoyi no ku ikarita ifunguye, keretse rizimijwe mu Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho / Ikarita.
help-card-drawing-what-it-is-description: Igishushanyo kigufasha gushushanya cyangwa kwandika n'intoki ku ikarita ukoresheje imbeba, urutoki cyangwa ikaramu: igishushanyo gito, igishushanyo mbonera, umukono cyangwa inyandiko yanditswe n'intoki. Igishushanyo kiguma gishobora guhindurwa kandi ishusho yacyo ibikwa kandi nk'umugereka w'ikarita.
help-card-drawing-how-it-works-descripti: Hitamo ibara n'ubugari bw'umurongo hanyuma ushushanye. Siba igikorwa giheruka isubira intambwe inyuma, Igisibo gikuraho imirongo gikozeho, na Kibonerana gikuraho byose. Bika igumana imirongo ku ikarita kandi ibika ishusho nk'umugereka; igishushanyo gishya gihinduka ishusho y'igipfukisho y'ikarita. Ibishushanyo byabitswe bitondekwa hano kugira ngo wongere ubifungure ubihindure, na Manura nka SVG ibika kimwe nka dosiye.
help-card-more-what-it-is-description: Ibindi byerekana ihuza ry'ikarita, amakarita mubyeyi yayo n'igihe yaremwe. Ni ho ikarita igirwa igikorwa gito cy'indi karita, kandi ni ho umuyobozi w'ikibaho asiba ikarita burundu.
help-card-more-how-it-works-description: Kopera ihuza ry'ikarita mu bubiko bw'ibyakopewe ikoporora aderesi y'ikarita. Munsi ya Hindura umubyeyi w'ikarita, hitamo ikibaho cy'inkomoko n'ikarita mubyeyi, cyangwa nta na kimwe kugira ngo wongere uyigire ikarita yo hejuru; Ongeraho indi karita mubyeyi yongeraho ababyeyi, kandi umusaraba uri iruhande rw'umwe uramukuraho. Siba, ku bayobozi b'ikibaho gusa, ikuraho ikarita burundu nyuma yo kwemeza.
help-card-create-board-what-it-is-descri: Rema ikibaho uhereye kuri iyi karita ihindura ikarita ihuza ry'ikibaho gishya. Ni iy'ikarita yakuze ikaba umushinga wayo: akazi kimukira ku kibaho cyako, kandi ikarita iguma aho yari iri nk'inzira yo kwinjiramo.
help-card-create-board-how-it-works-desc: Izina ry'ikibaho gishya ryuzuzwa n'umutwe w'ikarita; rihindure niba ubishaka hanyuma ukande Rema ikibaho uhereye kuri iyi karita. Ikibaho kiremwa uri umuyobozi wacyo, hanyuma ikarita igafungura icyo kibaho. Nta kindi gihinduka ku ikarita. Iyo byanzwe, impamvu yerekanwa kandi nta kintu gihinduka.
help-card-link-to-board-what-it-is-descr: Ihuza ry'iki kibaho rishyira ikarita ihujwe n'iyi karita ku kindi kibaho gisanzwe kiriho. Ikarita ihita igaragara ku bibaho byombi: iy'umwimerere iguma aho iri, kandi ihuza ryerekana ibiyirimo aho uyishyize.
help-card-link-to-board-how-it-works-des: Hitamo ikibaho, umurongo n'urutonde, hanyuma ikarita n'iba ihuza rijya hejuru cyangwa munsi yayo, hanyuma ukande Byarangiye. Mu rutonde rw'ubusa ihuza rijya hasi. Ikarita y'umwimerere ntihinduka, kandi ibirango ntibikopororwa. Aho ujya hibukwa kuri buri kibaho.
help-card-actions-what-it-is-description: Menu y'imirongo itatu y'ikarita, Ibikorwa by'Ikarita, ikusanya ibyo byose ushobora gukora ku ikarita yose, aho kuba ku mwanya umwe wayo. Ibintu bigaragara biterwa n'inshingano yawe ku kibaho.
help-card-actions-how-it-works-descripti: Kwimura no gukoporora birimo Kwimura ikarita, Gukoporora ikarita, Bika nk'Icyitegererezo, Kopera Inyandikorugero ku Makarita Menshi, Gusubira kw'ikarita no kwimurira hejuru cyangwa hasi y'urutonde. Hanyuma haza Kurikirana na Shyiraho inyenyeri, na Isura irimo Gena ibara, Igishushanyo na Kora amakarita avuye mu bikorwa. Gusangiza birimo ihuza ry'ikarita, Ihuza ry'iki kibaho, Kode ya QR n'Amateka, hanyuma Sohora na Kwinjiza. Ububiko burimo Gushyira ikarita mu bubiko, Ibindi na Rema ikibaho uhereye kuri iyi karita.
help-admin-version-what-it-is-descriptio: Igice cy'Integuro cyerekana ibyo iyi WeKan ikoresha: integuro ya WeKan n'uko yashyizweho, sisitemu y'imikorere, Meteor, ububiko bw'amakuru na Node.js. Ni igice cya mbere cy'Ubuyobozi / Igenamiterere kandi ni amakuru yo gukoporora muri raporo y'ikosa igihe usaba ubufasha.
help-admin-version-how-it-works-descript: Soma imbonerahamwe, itondekanyije mu matsinda ya Platform, OS, Meteor, Database na Node. Kanda Genzura Integuro kugira ngo ugereranye n'integuro nshya zasohotse za WeKan, FerretDB, Meteor, Node na NPM; mu gihe birimo gukora bivuga ko birimo gutangira, kandi iyo igenzura ryanze ubona ubutumwa bumwe bw'ikosa aho.
help-admin-appearance-what-it-is-descrip: Isura igena uko iyi WeKan igaragara n'ibyo Ibibaho byose byerekana: ibice byahishwe nk'ibibaho rusange cyangwa ibikorwa by'ikibaho, abashobora kurema ibibaho, imiterere y'itariki, ubugari ibisobanuro by'ikarita bifungukana, aderesi z'amahuza, ihuza ryikora ry'igikoresho cyo hanze cyo gukurikirana ibibazo, izina ry'igicuruzwa, amabara n'ibirango.
help-admin-appearance-how-it-works-descr: Hindura imyanya y'itsinda rimwe hanyuma ukande Bika y'iryo tsinda, ibika iryo tsinda gusa. Utumenyetso munsi ya Ibibaho Byose: Hisha bisobanura ko icyo kintu gihishwe, keretse ibibaho umukoresha wese winjiye ashobora guhindura, bishyirwaho akamenyetso iyo byemewe. Hindura ibara ribika nta buto ya Bika kandi ni ryo tsinda ryonyine umuyobozi bwite w'ikigo abona.
help-admin-features-what-it-is-descripti: Ibiranga ni ho umuyobozi w'urubuga afungura cyangwa azimya ibice bya WeKan bidasabwa ku rubuga rwose: imigaragarire y'ikibaho, ibikoresho byo gufasha, ibikoresho bya Kanban na Scrum, imyanya y'ikarita, Umutwaro w'akazi n'ubushobozi, Ingengo y'imari n'inyemezabuguzi, SQRL, ActivityPub, Amategeko yo gusoma gusa n'ama-API ahuye adasabwa. Imirongo n'intonde bihoraho.
help-admin-features-how-it-works-descrip: Kuraho akamenyetso ku byo iyi WeKan idakwiye gutanga, harimo imyanya y'ikarita nta kibaho gikwiye kwerekana, hanyuma ukande Bika. Ikintu cyakuweho akamenyetso kivanwa ku isura ya bose kandi seriveri na yo irakanga, ariko amakuru yacyo arabikwa. Ushobora gusaba kwemeza ku biranga ivugurura rya WeKan ryongeraho, no kuvuga abakoresha b'igerageza bakibona ibiranga bizimije.
help-admin-feature-profiles-what-it-is-d: Umwirondoro w'ibiranga uha abakoresha, amatsinda cyangwa ibigo byahiswemo WeKan ntoya ubahishe ibiranga bimwe bidasabwa, mu gihe abandi bose bakomeza kubona byose. Ushobora guhisha ibiranga nk'ibyo igice cy'Ibiranga gishobora kuzimya.
help-admin-feature-profiles-how-it-works: Kanda Ongeraho umwirondoro, uwuhe izina, shyiraho akamenyetso ku biranga uhisha kandi utondeke abakoresha, amatsinda n'ibigo byawo, hanyuma ukande Bika y'igice. Amazina atahuye n'uwo ari we wese avugwa nyuma yo kubika kandi ntabikwa. Imyirondoro igeragezwa ukurikije uko ikurikirana kuri paji, kandi menu y'umunyamuryango ibwira umukoresha umwirondoro uhisha ibiranga bingahe.
help-admin-security-what-it-is-descripti: Umutekano urimo buto za seriveri yose z'ibyo umwandiko utunganyijwe ushobora gukora n'ibyo bishobora kwinjizwa cyangwa gusohorwa. Uzikoreshe kugira ngo uhagarike amahuza akandwaho, werekane umwandiko wose utunganyijwe nk'inkomoko isanzwe, ubuze kwinjiza cyangwa gusohora, ugabanye ingano yo kwinjiza, ureke amashusho y'abakoresha, cyangwa usimbuze imyirondoro nyayo y'abakoresha amazina atazwi.
help-admin-security-how-it-works-descrip: Fungura buto maze ibikwe ako kanya; ingano nini yo kwinjiza ibikwa iyo uvuye mu mwanya, kandi agaciro k'ubusa gasobanura ko nta rugero. Buri buto izimije mu buryo mburabuzi kandi ishyirwa mu bikorwa na seriveri, ku buryo kwinjiza cyangwa gusohora byazimijwe byangwa n'iyo umuntu abihamagara ubwe.
help-admin-activities-what-it-is-descrip: Buto eshatu za seriveri yose ku mbuga zigomba kugabanya ikurikirana ry'ibikorwa: guhagarika kwandika uwakoze iki, guhagarika kohereza amamenyesha y'ibikorwa, cyangwa kubuza abakoresha gukurikirana ibibaho, intonde n'amakarita.
help-admin-activities-how-it-works-descr: Fungura buto maze ibikwe ako kanya. Iyo ibikorwa bizimijwe, nta gishya cyandikwa kandi ibyanditswe bisanzwe ntibikigaragara. Iyo amamenyesha azimijwe, nta mamenyesha yo muri porogaramu, ya imeyili cyangwa andi yoherezwa. Iyo gukurikirana kuzimijwe, nta wushobora guhindura urwego rwo gukurikirana. Kuraho akamenyetso kugira ngo wongere ubifungure; ibikorwa bitanditswe muri icyo gihe ntibigaruka.
help-admin-delete-what-it-is-description: Gusiba muri WeKan mu buryo busanzwe bishyira gusa ikimenyetso ku ntonde, amakarita n'imigereka ko byasibwe ku buryo bishobora kugarurwa. Iki gice kirimo buto imwe ituma umuyobozi w'urubuga ashobora gusenya ibyo bintu burundu.
help-admin-delete-how-it-works-descripti: Shyiraho akamenyetso kuri Emerera Global Admin gusiba burundu; bibikwa ako kanya kandi nta cyo bisiba ubwabyo. Utumenyetso two gusiba duhita tugaragara aho gusiba burundu gutangwa, nk'urutonde mu giseke cy'ibyajugunywe cyangwa ikibaho cyabitswe mu bubiko bw'Ibibaho byose. Buri mpinduka y'igenamiterere na buri igerageza ryo gusiba burundu byandikwa muri Kugarura. Kuraho akamenyetso umaze.
help-admin-announcement-what-it-is-descr: Itangazo ry'urubuga rwose ryo kumenyesha umukoresha wese winjiye ikintu icyarimwe, nk'ihagarara ryo gutunganya, aderesi nshya cyangwa impinduka y'amabwiriza. Ritandukanye n'itangazo ry'ikibaho.
help-admin-announcement-how-it-works-des: Shyiraho akamenyetso kuri Itangazo Rikora muri Sisitemu Yose, wandike ubutumwa hanyuma ukande Bika. Itangazo rigaragara hejuru ya Ahabanza, Ibibaho byose n'ibibaho abakoresha ari abanyamuryango babyo. Umukoresha ashobora kurifunga, kandi riguma rifunze kuri we kugeza uhinduye umwandiko. Kuraho akamenyetso ku gasanduku kugira ngo urikureho kuri bose.
help-admin-accessibility-what-it-is-desc: Paji yo korohereza abantu bose ni ho iyi WeKan ibwira abayikoresha uko yoroheye bose n'uwo bavugisha ku mbogamizi. Iki gice gifungura iyo paji kandi kigena umutwe wayo n'ibiyirimo.
help-admin-accessibility-how-it-works-de: Shyiraho akamenyetso kuri Paji yo korohereza abantu bose irakora, bibikwa ako kanya, hanyuma wandike umutwe n'ibirimo ukande Bika. Ibirimo bitunganywa nk'ibisobanuro by'ikarita. Abanyamuryango b'ikibaho bahita babona ihuza ry'Ukorohereza abantu bose mu ruhande rw'iburyo rw'ikibaho. Kuraho akamenyetso kugira ngo wongere uhishe ihuza.
help-admin-translation-what-it-is-descri: Imyandiko y'ubusobanuro yihariye isimbura imyandiko ya WeKan isanzwe kuri uru rubuga, kuri buri rurimi, nko gukoresha ijambo ry'ikigo cyawe ku kibaho cyangwa gukosora umwandiko mbere y'uko ubusobanuro bukosowe bugera.
help-admin-translation-how-it-works-desc: Kanda Gishya, hitamo ururimi, andika urufunguzo rw'umwandiko wo gusimbura (si interuro y'Icyongereza) n'umwandiko wo kwerekana aho, hanyuma Bika. Umwandiko w'ubusobanuro w'umurongo uriho gusa ni wo ushobora guhindurwa, kandi umurongo ushobora gusibwa uhereye muri menu yawo. Ibisimbura bikora ku mwandiko seriveri ikora, nka imeyili; muri mushakisha ubu bigaragara gusa ku bayobozi b'urubuga.
help-admin-pwa-what-it-is-description: Igice cya PWA kigenzura ibyo mushakisha na telefoni bisoma kuri WeKan ubwayo: ibimenyetso by'inyongera bya meta na link kuri buri paji, web manifest ikoreshwa iyo WeKan ishyizweho nka porogaramu, na dosiye y'amahuza ya porogaramu ya Android ituma porogaramu ya Android ifungura amahuza ya WeKan.
help-admin-pwa-how-it-works-description: Shyiraho akamenyetso ku gice ushaka gutunganya, bibikwa ako kanya, shyiramo ibimenyetso byawe cyangwa JSON hanyuma ukande Bika. JSON itari yo irangwa kandi nta kintu kibikwa. Ibimenyetso bya meta byongerwa gusa nk'ibice bya meta, ku buryo inyandiko za porogaramu, imiterere n'ibimenyetso byongera gutangiza paji bivanwaho. Iyo buto izimije, WeKan ikoresha ibisanzwe byayo.
help-admin-global-webhooks-what-it-is-de: Webhooks za Hose zohereza ubutumwa kuri aderesi indi, nk'ikiganiro cyangwa seriveri y'ikoranabuhanga ryikora, igihe cyose hari ikibaye ku kibaho icyo ari cyo cyose cy'iyi WeKan. Zikoresha ifishi imwe n'iya webhooks z'ikibaho. Iki gice gitondeka kandi imashini z'imbere webhooks zishobora kugeraho na webhook yo kwinjira no kwiyandikisha.
help-admin-global-webhooks-how-it-works-: Uzuza ifishi y'ubusa n'izina, aderesi, token idasabwa n'ubwoko, bw'icyerekezo kimwe cyangwa bibiri, hanyuma ukande Kurema. Kuri webhook yabitswe ushobora kuyizimya, guhitamo ibikorwa yohereza n'uko igeza, hanyuma Bika. Tondeka imashini ziri ku murongo wa WeKan munsi ya Aho imbere bigera, imwe ku murongo, ku buryo webhooks zemererwa kuzigeraho.
help-admin-shared-labels-what-it-is-desc: Ibirango bisangiwe biha ikirango izina rimwe n'ibara rimwe ku bibaho byinshi icyarimwe: ku bibaho byose, ku bibaho by'ikigo, cyangwa ku bibaho by'itsinda. Ubikoreshe ku birango nka Byihutirwa cyangwa Umukiriya bikwiye kugaragara kimwe hose.
help-admin-shared-labels-how-it-works-de: Ongeraho ikirango mu murongo wa nyuma gifite izina, ibara n'urutonde, hanyuma ukande Ongeraho ikirango gisangiwe; buri murongo ubika cyangwa usiba ukwawo. Ku birango by'ikarita, abanyamuryango b'ikibaho babona ibirango bisangiwe ikibaho cyabo gishobora gukoresha bakanda kimwe kugira ngo bacyongereho. Guhindura izina cyangwa ibara hano birahindura ku bibaho byose, kandi kugisiba bikigumana kuri ibyo bibaho nk'ikirango cyabyo bwite.
help-admin-email-what-it-is-description: Igice cya E-mail kigena uko WeKan yohereza ubutumwa, haba hakoreshejwe igenamiterere rya imeyili rya seriveri ubwayo cyangwa umutanga serivisi wagenwe hano, kandi kirimo igenamiterere rifitanye isano: indangarubuga ya imeyili ishobora gutumira abantu igihe kwiyandikisha ubwawe kuzimije, niba abakoresha bashobora guhindura aderesi yabo, icyo gukora ku butumwa bwagarutse, n'inyandikorugero za imeyili z'ubutumire n'iz'ibikorwa.
help-admin-email-how-it-works-descriptio: Shyiraho akamenyetso kuri Emera munsi y'igenamiterere rya imeyili, hitamo SMTP cyangwa umutanga serivisi uri muri porogaramu, uzuze izina ry'ukoresha, ijambobanga na aderesi y'wohereza hanyuma ukande Bika; ijambobanga ryabitswe rigumanwa iyo umwanya usizwe ari ubusa. Iyoherereze imeyili yo kugerageza kugira ngo urebe ko bikora. Nta kamenyetso, igenamiterere rya imeyili rya seriveri ubwayo rikomeza gukoreshwa. Imyanya y'inyandikorugero y'ubusa igumana imeyili zisanzwe.
help-admin-notifications-what-it-is-desc: Ibisanzwe by'urubuga rwose ku mamenyesha: niba Agasanduku k'amamenyesha ko muri porogaramu na imeyili bifunguye cyangwa bizimije kuri bose, n'uko imeyili, agasanduku na webhooks zisohoka bigeza mu buryo mburabuzi. Igenamiterere ry'ikibaho n'irya buri munyamuryango rishobora kubiruta mu rwego rwaryo.
help-admin-notifications-how-it-works-de: Hitamo Yego cyangwa Oya kuri Agasanduku k'amamenyesha no kuri Imeyili; amahitamo abikwa ako kanya. Fungura umuyoboro kugira ngo ugene imiterere yawo, ibyo werekana, uko amamenyesha ahurizwa hamwe n'igihe yoherezwa, buri kimwe kibikwa ako kanya. Abayobozi b'ikibaho n'abanyamuryango bashobora guhitamo Mburabuzi kugira ngo basubire ku byo wagennye hano. Igenamiterere rya imeyili ijya ku ikarita riri muri iki gice.
help-admin-domains-what-it-is-descriptio: Indangarubuga zitondeka indangarubuga za imeyili zose zikoreshwa na konti kuri iyi WeKan, hamwe n'umubare w'abakoresha kuri buri imwe. Ni uburyo bwihuse bwo kubona ibigo biri kuri uru rubuga no kubona indangarubuga itari yitezwe udasomye urutonde rwose rw'abakoresha.
help-admin-domains-how-it-works-descript: Soma imbonerahamwe, umurongo umwe kuri buri ndangarubuga n'umubare w'abakoresha bayo. Andika igice cy'indangarubuga mu gasanduku ko gushakisha hanyuma ukande Enter kugira ngo uyibone, kandi ugende hagati ya paji ukoresheje buto za Ibanza na Ibikurikira. Nta kintu kibikwa; imbonerahamwe ibarwa bushya igihe cyose yerekanwe.
help-admin-organizations-what-it-is-desc: Ibigo bikusanya abakoresha ukurikije sosiyete, ishami cyangwa umukiriya ku buryo ibibaho n'ibibaho by'inyandikorugero bishobora gusangizwa bose, abanyamuryango babyo bashobora guhuzwa n'ububiko nka LDAP, kandi, iyo hari uburyo bw'abakiriya benshi, ikigo gishobora kugira indangarubuga zacyo, ibirango n'abayobozi bacyo.
help-admin-organizations-how-it-works-de: Kanda Gishya mu mutwe w'inkingi ya mbere kugira ngo urema kimwe, Hindura kugira ngo uhindure umurongo, na menu y'umurongo kugira ngo uwusibe cyangwa ushyireho abayobozi b'ikigo. Buto z'umurongo z'inyandikorugero zisangiwe, kongera abanyamuryango ku bibaho no guhuza abanyamuryango bavuye ku mutanga serivisi yo kwinjira zibikwa ako kanya. Shyiraho akamenyetso kuri Ongeraho abanyamuryango b'ikibaho bava mu Kigo kimwe gusa kugira ngo ugabanye abashobora kongerwa ku bibaho.
help-admin-teams-what-it-is-description: Amatsinda akusanya abakoresha bakorana ku buryo ikibaho cyangwa ibibaho by'inyandikorugero bishobora gusangizwa itsinda ryose, abanyamuryango bashobora guhuzwa n'ububiko nka LDAP, kandi urutonde rw'Abantu rushobora kugabanywa ku itsinda rimwe. Akora nk'ibigo nta gice cy'umukiriya.
help-admin-teams-how-it-works-descriptio: Kanda Gishya mu mutwe w'inkingi ya mbere kugira ngo urema itsinda, Hindura kugira ngo urihindure, cyangwa menu y'umurongo kugira ngo urisibe. Buto z'umurongo zibikwa ako kanya. Kugira ngo ushyire abantu mu matsinda, bashyireho akamenyetso mu Buyobozi / Abantu / Abantu hanyuma ukande Amatsinda. Shyiraho akamenyetso kuri Ongeraho abanyamuryango b'ikibaho bava mu Itsinda rimwe gusa kugira ngo ugabanye abashobora kongerwa ku bibaho.
help-admin-people-what-it-is-description: Abantu batondeka konti zose kuri iyi WeKan hamwe na imeyili yazo, niba ari umuyobozi, umwirondoro w'ibiranga, niba ikora, ibihugu yinjiriyemo, niba ifunze, igikorwa cya nyuma n'itariki yaremweho. Ni ho urema, uhindura, uzimya, ufungura, wiyitirira, uhisha kandi usiba konti.
help-admin-people-how-it-works-descripti: Shakisha ukoresheje izina ry'ukoresha, izina cyangwa imeyili hanyuma ukande Enter, kandi ugabanye ukoresheje Erekana na Itsinda. Kanda Gishya kugira ngo urema umukoresha na Hindura kugira ngo umuhindure. Kanda ku kimenyetso cyo gukora kugira ngo uzimye cyangwa ufungure, n'ingufuri itukura cyangwa Fungura bose kugira ngo ufungure. Menu y'umurongo irimo kwiyitirira, guhisha no gusiba; shyiraho akamenyetso ku bantu benshi hanyuma ukande Amatsinda kugira ngo uhindure amatsinda yabo.
help-admin-locked-users-what-it-is-descr: Kwirinda ibitero byo gukeka amagambobanga bifunga konti nyuma y'uko kwinjira kwanze inshuro nyinshi. Iki gice kigena inshuro zanze zituma ifungwa, igihe bimara n'igihe inshuro zanze zibarirwamo, ukwabyo ku mazina y'abakoresha ariho no ku mazina y'abakoresha atariho.
help-admin-locked-users-how-it-works-des: Uzuza inshuro zanze, igihe cyo gufungwa n'igihe cyo kubara, mu masegonda, ku bakoresha bazwi n'abatazwi hanyuma ukande Bika; agaciro gashya gakora ako kanya nta kongera gutangiza. Kugira ngo ubone kandi ufungure konti zafunzwe, fungura Ubuyobozi / Abantu / Abantu, hitamo Abakoresha bafunzwe gusa hanyuma ukande ku ngufuri itukura, cyangwa Fungura bose.
help-admin-audit-log-what-it-is-descript: Igitabo cy'igenzura ni inzira y'ibyo abayobozi b'urubuga bakoze, ibya vuba mbere: ryari, nde, igikorwa ikihe, niba cyagenze neza, ibisobanuro byacyo na aderesi cyaturutseho. Gisubiza uwahinduye ikintu n'igihe ku igenamiterere ry'abantu, kwinjira, ububiko na kopi z'umutekano.
help-admin-audit-log-how-it-works-descri: Soma imbonerahamwe y'Igihe, Umuyobozi, Igikorwa, Ibisobanuro na IP; igikorwa cyanzwe gishyirwaho ikimenyetso cy'ikosa ryacyo. Andika mu gasanduku ko gushakisha kugira ngo ugabanye imirongo ukurikije umuyobozi, igikorwa cyangwa ibisobanuro, kandi ukoreshe imyambi iri munsi y'imbonerahamwe kugira ngo ugende hagati ya paji.
help-admin-roles-what-it-is-description: Inshingano zihitamo inshingano z'ikibaho zishobora gutumira abantu ku kibaho, zigufasha kubaka inshingano zihariye uhereye ku byo umunyamuryango w'ikibaho ashobora gukora, kandi zerekana ibyo buri nshingano ishobora gukora. Abayobozi b'urubuga bahorana uburenganzira bwose.
help-admin-roles-how-it-works-descriptio: Munsi ya Emera Gutumira ku Kibaho, shyiraho akamenyetso ku nshingano zishobora gutumira hanyuma ukande Bika. Munsi ya Inshingano zihariye, andika izina, shyiraho akamenyetso ku byo inshingano ishobora gukora hanyuma ukande Ongeraho inshingano; buri murongo ubika cyangwa usiba ukwawo, kandi abayobozi b'ikibaho bashobora guhita baha abanyamuryango iyo nshingano. Imbonerahamwe Imiterere y'Inshingano yerekana ibyavuye mu tumenyetso twawe, ndetse mbere y'uko ubika.
help-admin-shared-templates-what-it-is-d: Inyandikorugero zisangiwe zigufasha kureba ibibaho by'inyandikorugero by'abakoresha bishobora gusangizwa ukurikije ikigo, itsinda cyangwa indangarubuga ya imeyili. Utumenyetso tugena kandi ubwoko bw'amatsinda ikibaho cy'inyandikorugero gishobora gusangizwa uhereye mu Bibaho byose / Inyandikorugero.
help-admin-shared-templates-how-it-works: Shyiraho akamenyetso kuri Ibigo, Amatsinda cyangwa Indangarubuga; buri kamenyetso kabikwa ako kanya ku rubuga rwose. Munsi ya buri rwego rwashyizweho akamenyetso ubona buri tsinda, abakoresha baryo n'ibibaho byabo by'inyandikorugero, kandi gukanda ku kibaho cy'inyandikorugero biragifungura. Niba inyandikorugero z'itsinda zigera ku banyamuryango baryo bigenwa kuri buri kigo n'itsinda mu bice byabyo.
help-admin-login-what-it-is-description: Kwinjira kugena ibyemewe igihe cyo kwinjira, nko kwibagirwa ijambobanga, kwiyandikisha ubwawe, guhindura izina ry'ukoresha, gusiba konti yawe n'uguhitamo uburyo. Kandi kugufasha gusimbuza igenamiterere ryo kwinjira rya seriveri nta kongera gutangiza, nko kwinjira n'ijambobanga, uburyo mburabuzi, uburebure bw'igihe cyo kwinjira, gusohoka byikora, amabwiriza y'ijambobanga no Kwemeza mu Bice Bibiri bitegetswe.
help-admin-login-how-it-works-descriptio: Shyiraho cyangwa ukureho akamenyetso ku dusanduku twa Kwinjira: Emera; buri kamwe kabikwa iyo ukakanzeho. Iyo kwiyandikisha ubwawe kuzimije, koresha Tumira Abantu kugira ngo utumire aderesi ku bibaho byahiswemo. Mu ifishi y'igenamiterere, buri mwanya uvuga agaciro gakora; andika cyangwa uhitemo agaciro ubike, cyangwa urekere ubusa cyangwa uhitemo Mburabuzi kugira ngo usubire ku igenamiterere rya seriveri. Buri buryo bwo kwinjira bufite igice cyabwo muri menu y'Abantu.
help-admin-saml-what-it-is-description: Kwinjira na SAML kwemerera abantu kwinjira banyuze ku mutanga umwirondoro w'ikigo cyawe aho gukoresha ijambobanga rya WeKan. Umutanga yemeza abo ari bo akoresheje ubutumwa bushyizweho umukono maze WeKan ikabinjiza, ikarema konti mu kwinjira kwa mbere.
help-admin-saml-how-it-works-description: Andika aderesi yo kwinjira y'umutanga umwirondoro n'icyemezo cyo gushyiraho umukono, izina ry'utanga ry'iyi WeKan n'ubundi buryo buri muri iki gice, cyangwa mu igenamiterere rya seriveri; agaciro kabitswe hano karuta aka seriveri. Iyo bifunguye, paji yo kwinjira yerekana buto Injira ukoresheje SAML ijyana umukoresha ku mutanga umwirondoro ikamugarura.
help-admin-ldap-what-it-is-description: Kwinjira na LDAP kwemerera abantu kwinjira bakoresheje izina ry'ukoresha n'ijambobanga basanzwe bafite mu bubiko bwanyu, nka Active Directory cyangwa OpenLDAP. WeKan igenzura ijambobanga kuri ubwo bubiko, ikarema konti mu kwinjira kwa mbere kandi ishobora guhuza amazina, imeyili, niba umuntu ari umuyobozi, ibigo n'amatsinda n'ubwo bubiko.
help-admin-ldap-how-it-works-description: Uzuza aderesi y'ububiko, port, uburinzi, base n'uko abakoresha bashakishwa, hanyuma ubike; agaciro kabitswe karuta igenamiterere rya seriveri kandi Mburabuzi isubiza agaciro ka seriveri. Kanda Gerageza ihuza rya LDAP kugira ngo ugerageze igenamiterere rikora, na Huza abakoresha ba LDAP nonaha kugira ngo ukoreshe ihuza ryo inyuma ako kanya. Hitamo LDAP nk'uburyo mburabuzi mu gice cya Kwinjira.
help-admin-oauth2-what-it-is-description: Kwinjira na OAuth2 na OpenID Connect kwemerera abantu kwinjira bakoresheje konti kuri serivisi indi, nka Keycloak, Authelia cyangwa GitLab, aho gukoresha ijambobanga rya WeKan. Bitandukanye n'abatanga kwinjira bo ku mbuga nkoranyambaga badahinduka, ubyerekeza ku mutanga uwo ari we wese umuhaye aderesi ze.
help-admin-oauth2-how-it-works-descripti: Iyandikishe WeKan nka porogaramu ku mutanga, hanyuma wandike client id yayo, ibanga, aderesi ya seriveri, endpoints n'uko imyanya y'abakoresha bayo ihuzwa na WeKan hano; agaciro kabitswe hano karuta igenamiterere rya seriveri kandi gakora mu kwinjira gukurikira nta kongera gutangiza. Paji yo kwinjira ihita yerekana buto yo kwinjira umwandiko wayo ugenwa mu gice cya Kwinjira.
help-admin-cas-what-it-is-description: CAS ni uburyo bwo kwinjira rimwe: abantu binjira rimwe kuri seriveri ya CAS y'ikigo cyawe, kandi WeKan yizera itike isubiza, ku buryo WeKan itigera ibona ijambobanga.
help-admin-cas-how-it-works-description: Andika aderesi za base, kwinjira no kwemeza za seriveri ya CAS hano hanyuma uyifungure; agaciro kabitswe hano karuta igenamiterere rya seriveri. Hitamo CAS nk'uburyo mburabuzi mu gice cya Kwinjira, cyangwa ureke abakoresha bayihitemo mu guhitamo uburyo. Kwinjira bijyana mushakisha kuri paji yo kwinjira ya CAS hanyuma bikagarura kuri WeKan, umaze kwinjira.
help-admin-header-login-what-it-is-descr: Kwinjira ukoresheje imitwe y'ubutumwa byemerera proxy y'umuhuza yizewe imaze gukora kwinjira rimwe kubwira WeKan uwo umukoresha ari we, ku buryo umukoresha yinjira nta jambobanga kandi konti ikaremwa mu gusura kwa mbere.
help-admin-header-login-how-it-works-des: Iri genamiterere ryerekanwa hano ryo gusoma gusa kandi ntirishobora kubikwa uhereye mu Buyobozi, kuko proxy yizewe ishobora kwinjira nk'uwo ari we wese; rigenwa mu igenamiterere rya seriveri hamwe no kongera gutangiza. Proxy igomba kwemeza umukoresha, kohereza imitwe y'umwirondoro no gukuraho imitwe nk'iyo yose yoherejwe n'abakiriya, kandi aderesi za proxy zatondetswe gusa ni zo zizerwa.
help-admin-oauth-providers-what-it-is-de: Izi ni buto zateguwe zo kwinjira unyuze ku mbuga nkoranyambaga: Google, GitHub, Facebook, Twitter, Meteor Developer, Weibo na Meetup. Buri imwe ikenera gusa app id n'ibanga umutanga aguha, kandi zishobora gukoreshwa hamwe no kwinjira kwa OAuth2 gusanzwe.
help-admin-oauth-providers-how-it-works-: Rema porogaramu ku rubuga rw'abakoraporogaramu rw'umutanga ukoresheje aderesi yo kugaruka ya WeKan, hanyuma wandike id yayo n'ibanga hano ufungure umutanga; agaciro kabitswe hano karuta igenamiterere rya seriveri. Buto yo kwinjira y'uwo mutanga ihita igaragara kuri paji yo kwinjira.
help-admin-passwordless-what-it-is-descr: Kwinjira nta jambobanga byemerera umukoresha kwinjira akoresheje kode y'inshuro imwe WeKan imwoherereza kuri imeyili, aho gukoresha ijambobanga. Ni uburyo bworoshye ku bantu bibagirwa amagambobanga, si intambwe ya kabiri yo kwemeza, kandi umutekano wabwo ungana n'uw'agasanduku k'ubutumwa k'umukoresha.
help-admin-passwordless-how-it-works-des: Reba ko imeyili zisohoka zikora, hanyuma ubifungure hano; agaciro kabitswe hano karuta igenamiterere rya seriveri. Paji yo kwinjira ihita itanga kohereza kode yo kwinjira kuri imeyili: umukoresha yandika aderesi ye, akabona kode ikora igihe gito, akayandika maze akinjira.
help-admin-backup-what-it-is-description: Kopi y'umutekano ifata ububiko bw'iyi WeKan ubu cyangwa ukurikije gahunda, amakuru y'umwandiko, imigereka n'amashusho y'abakoresha bikaba amahitamo atandukanye, kandi ikayigarura. Umuyobozi w'urubuga abika urubuga rwose cyangwa ikigo kimwe; umuyobozi bwite w'ikigo abika ibibaho byacyo gusa. Kopi y'umutekano ikomeza yo yohereza buri mpinduka ku buryo ushobora kugarura ku kanya ako ari ko kose.
help-admin-backup-how-it-works-descripti: Hitamo urwego, shyiraho akamenyetso ku byo ushyiramo hanyuma ukande Bika kopi y'umutekano ubu; kopi yuzuye ikenera byose uko ari bitatu n'urubuga rwose. Gena gahunda ya buri munsi, buri cyumweru cyangwa buri kwezi hanyuma Bika. Kanda Erekana kopi z'umutekano hanyuma ugarure imwe, haba wongeraho amakuru abura gusa cyangwa usimbuza byose. Muri Kopi y'umutekano ikomeza, gena ububiko bw'intego, ibirimo n'igihe cyo kubika, hanyuma uhitemo ingingo yo kugarura.
help-admin-attachments-what-it-is-descri: Ibice by'Imigereka bihitamo aho imigereka y'amakarita n'amashusho y'abakoresha bibikwa, ingano bishobora kugira, igihe bimara bibitswe n'uko byimurwa hagati y'ububiko. Amadosiye ashobora kubikwa kuri disiki ya seriveri, mu bubiko bw'amakuru cyangwa mu bubiko bw'igicu nka S3, MinIO, Azure, Google Cloud Storage cyangwa WebDAV.
help-admin-attachments-how-it-works-desc: Hitamo igice muri menu y'ibumoso. Gena ububiko amadosiye mashya ajyamo, tunganya buri bubiko na buto zabwo zo gusoma no kwandika, kandi wimure imigereka cyangwa amashusho y'abakoresha uva mu bubiko bumwe ujya mu bundi. Imipaka igena ingano yo gushyiraho no kumanura, Kubika gusiba imigereka ya kera nyuma y'iminsi runaka, na Kwimura ububikoshingiro byimura amakuru y'umwandiko hagati ya MongoDB na FerretDB.
help-admin-problems-summary-what-it-is-d: Paji ya mbere y'Ubuyobozi / Ibibazo n'igenzura ryawe rya buri munsi rya seriveri yose. Ikubwira ibirimo gukora ubu, ibitagenda neza ubu, n'umubare w'ibibazo bishya buri raporo yakusanyije, hamwe na buto zo kubikosora cyangwa kwemeza ko wabibonye.
help-admin-problems-summary-how-it-works: Imiterere itondeka iyimurwa n'isanwa birimo gukorwa, bishobora gutinza kwinjira, hanyuma buri kibazo n'umubare wacyo n'icyo gukora, na buto Sana amakarita yangiritse, Garura cyangwa Kosora aho ikenewe. Isanwa risiba amakuru rigusaba gukanda Emeza mbere. Munsi ya Ubuzima bw'amakuru, Tangira ikora igenzura ryo inyuma. Munsi ya Ibibazo, shyiraho akamenyetso kuri raporo wasuzumye hanyuma ukande Emeza ko wabibonye kugira ngo usubize ku busa umubare wazo mushya, cyangwa Kibonerana kugira ngo usibe imirongo yazo.
help-admin-problems-security-what-it-is-: Buri igerageza umurinzi w'umutekano yanze cyangwa yabonye: icyo cyari cyo, uko gikomeye, uwakigerageje, aho yaturutse n'inshuro zingahe. Byerekana ko hari uwagerageje, si gusa ko icyuho gifunzwe. Buto z'umutekano ubwazo ziri mu Buyobozi / Igenamiterere / Umutekano.
help-admin-problems-security-how-it-work: Imirongo itondekwa iya vuba mbere, kandi igerageza risubirwamo ni umurongo umwe umubare wawo w'Kugerageza ugenda wiyongera, mu gihe Ibisobanuro bivuga ibyo umurinzi yabonye. Andika izina, icyiciro, inkomoko, izina ry'ukoresha cyangwa aderesi mu gasanduku ko gushakisha kugira ngo uyungurure uko wandika, kandi ukande ku izina ry'ukoresha kugira ngo ufungure iyo konti. Emeza ko wabibonye cyangwa ukureho raporo kuri Ibibazo / Incamake.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-what-i: Inzira y'igenzura y'abayobozi bakora nk'abandi bakoresha. Kwiyitirira byemerera umuyobozi kubona WeKan nk'uko umukoresha umwe ayibona, nko gusohora ikibaho bwite, kandi iyi raporo igumana ubwo bubasha bugaragara nyuma.
help-admin-problems-impersonation-how-it: Umurongo wandikwa iyo umuyobozi ahisemo Iyitirire ukoresha mu Buyobozi / Abantu, arema token yo kwinjira y'undi mukoresha anyuze kuri REST API, cyangwa asohora ikibaho, ikarita cyangwa umugereka ari mu kwiyitirira. Buri murongo werekana itariki, umuyobozi, umukoresha wiyitiriwe, ikibaho n'impamvu, ibya vuba mbere. Kanda ku izina kugira ngo ufungure uwo mukoresha, kandi ushakishe ukoresheje Enter. Nta kintu hano gihindura cyangwa gisiba umurongo.
help-admin-problems-password-length-what: Byerekana abinjira bakoresheje ijambobanga rigufi kuruta uburebure buto, aho baturutse, n'iba barahinduye kuva icyo gihe. Ushobora kubona abo byagiraho ingaruka mbere y'uko utegeka uburebure buto ku magambobanga mashya.
help-admin-problems-password-length-how-: Gena Uburebure buto bw'ijambobanga, shyiraho akamenyetso kuri Gutegeka uburebure buto kugira ngo wange amagambobanga mashya magufi, hanyuma ukande Bika. Kwinjira ntikwigera kwangwa, ariko iyo itegeko rikora, konti ifite ijambobanga rya kera rigufi isabwa kubanza kurihindura. Imbonerahamwe ifite umurongo umwe kuri buri konti n'ukwinjira kwa mbere n'ukwa nyuma, aderesi, umubare w'ukwinjira n'igihe byakosowe. Yungurura ukurikije Ijambobanga rigufi cyane, Byakosowe hakoreshejwe ijambobanga rirerire bihagije cyangwa Byose. Konti zinjira zinyuze kuri LDAP, OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, CAS cyangwa Sandstorm ntizitondekwa.
help-admin-problems-performance-what-it-: Isobanura uko WeKan itangiza amakarita y'ikibaho, ibyo bigena uko ikibaho kinini gihenda gufungura. Ni ibisobanuro gusa, nta cyo gukanda cyangwa kubika.
help-admin-problems-performance-how-it-w: Uburyo amakarita atangirwa bwikora kuri buri kibaho: ikibaho gifite amakarita arenga 500 gitangiza gusa amakarita agaragara muri buri rutonde uko umanuka, imibare ivuye kuri seriveri, kandi ikibaho gito gitangiza amakarita yose. Ukoresha seriveri ashobora gutegeka gutangiza byose cyangwa buhoro buhoro, cyangwa guhindura umubare w'amakarita, mu igenamiterere rya seriveri hanyuma akongera gutangiza. Imigaragarire y'Imibare y'ikibaho yerekana uburyo gikoresha.
help-admin-problems-speed-what-it-is-des: Itondeka ubusabe bwa paji z'urubuga na REST API bwatinze gusubizwa, ku buryo ubona paji cyangwa amahamagara atinda n'inshuro bibaho.
help-admin-problems-speed-how-it-works-d: Buri busabe uretse amadosiye adahinduka burapimwa igihe, kandi ubufata amasegonda abiri cyangwa arenga mu buryo mburabuzi buranditswe. Ubusabe nk'ubwo butinda bubikwa nk'umurongo umwe umubare wawo n'itariki bigenda byiyongera, kandi Ibisobanuro byerekana uburyo, inzira n'igihe bwafashe. Gushakisha biyungurura uko wandika, kandi Ibibazo / Incamake iremeza cyangwa ikabukuraho. Urugero, cyangwa kubuzimya, bigenwa mu igenamiterere rya seriveri. Ibihe nyabyo by'amahamagara ya methods na publications biri muri Ibikoresho byo gupima aho.
help-admin-problems-tests-what-it-is-des: Igenzura rya seriveri irimo gukora ryanze. Nyuma gato yo gutangira, WeKan igenzura ko ububiko bw'amakuru busubiza, ko ububiko bw'amadosiye bushobora kwandikwamo, ko ububiko bw'agateganyo bugifite umwanya kandi ko disiki ifite umwanya.
help-admin-problems-tests-how-it-works-d: Igenzura rikorwa rimwe, nk'amasegonda 15 nyuma y'uko seriveri itangira, kandi kwanga gusa ni ko kurema umurongo: Aho biva hita igenzura kandi Ibisobanuro bitanga ubutumwa bw'ikosa ryaryo. Nta bibazo bishya bisobanura ko nta kintu cyanze kuva raporo iheruka gukurwaho. Iki gice nta buto gifite yo kongera kurikora, bityo ongera utangize WeKan. Emeza ko wabibonye cyangwa ubikureho kuri Ibibazo / Incamake.
help-admin-problems-cpu-what-it-is-descr: Gikurikirana umutwaro wa porosesa y'imashini yose, kuko WeKan n'ububiko bwayo bw'amakuru kuri mudasobwa imwe bishobora gukoresha CPU nyinshi ku buryo bitinza izindi porogaramu. Ibihe by'ikoreshwa rinini rya CPU rimara igihe byandikwa hano, kandi ibikorwa birebire biratinda mu gihe imashini ihuze.
help-admin-problems-cpu-how-it-works-des: Umurongo wo hejuru werekana Imikoreshereze ya CPU y'ubu, umubare w'imitima, impuzandengo y'umutwaro, nibura, impuzandengo n'ntarengwa bya vuba, n'ibyo WeKan irimo gukora, bigavugururwa buri masegonda 5. Imbonerahamwe iri munsi itondeka ibihe byashize byo guhugira: umurongo w'intangiriro, nibura umurongo umwe ku gutinza, n'umurongo w'iherezo ufite igihe byamaze, isonga n'iba gutinza byafashije. Gushakisha biyungurura uko wandika. Imipaka, cyangwa kuzimya ikurikirana, biri mu igenamiterere rya seriveri.
help-admin-problems-ram-what-it-is-descr: Gikurikirana uko imashini yose ikoresha ububiko bw'agateganyo na swap, kandi kikandika igihe ikoreshwa rinini ry'ububiko ritangiye n'igihe rirangiye. Kubura ububiko, cyangwa gukoresha swap, bitinza cyangwa bigahagarika WeKan n'izindi porogaramu kuri iyo mashini.
