help-admin-problems-ram-how-it-works-des: Umurongo wo hejuru werekana ikoreshwa ry'ububiko ry'ubu ku ijana no mu ma-gigabyte akoreshwa n'ayose, hamwe na swap iyo imashini iyifite, bigavugururwa buri masegonda 5. Munsi yaho, imbonerahamwe ifite umurongo umwe w'intangiriro n'umwe w'iherezo kuri buri gihe cy'ikoreshwa rinini, ibya vuba mbere, imirongo 10 kuri paji, hamwe n'agasanduku ko gushakisha. Emeza ko wabibonye cyangwa ubikureho kuri Ibibazo / Incamake. Imipaka iri mu igenamiterere rya seriveri kandi isomwa iyo seriveri itangiye.
help-admin-problems-disk-what-it-is-desc: Gikurikirana umwanya usigaye kuri disiki zirimo ububiko bw'amakuru, imigereka n'ibyashyizweho. Disiki yuzuye ituma gushyiraho byanga kandi ikabuza ububiko bw'amakuru kwandika, bityo iki gitanga umuburo hakiri kare mbere y'uko ibyo biba.
help-admin-problems-disk-how-it-works-de: Umurongo umwe ukora kuri buri disiki werekana ijanisha ryakoreshejwe, ama-gigabyte asigaye n'ayose, aho iri n'ibyo WeKan iyibikamo, bigavugururwa buri masegonda 30, kandi disiki iri mu gihe cy'ikoreshwa rinini irashyirwaho ibara. Imbonerahamwe iri munsi ifite umurongo w'intangiriro n'uw'iherezo kuri buri gihe cy'ikoreshwa rinini, kandi gushakisha biyungurura uko wandika. Emeza ko wabibonye cyangwa ubikureho kuri Ibibazo / Incamake. Izindi disiki zo gukurikirana zishobora kongerwa mu igenamiterere rya seriveri.
help-admin-problems-instrumentation-what: Ibibarura bikora by'ibyo iyi seriveri ya WeKan irimo gukora: amahuza angahe afunguye, n'inshuro buri method na publication bihamagarwa, inshuro byanga n'igihe bifata. Byerekana igice cya WeKan gihuze cyangwa kirimo kwanga ubu nta gikoresho cyihariye cyo gukurikirana.
help-admin-problems-instrumentation-how-: Umurongo wo hejuru werekana amahuza akora, yafunguwe n'ayafunzwe n'igihe ibarura ryatangiye. Imirongo kuri buri gice, nk'Amakarita, Ibibaho, Kwinjira cyangwa Imigereka, yerekana amahamagara, igihe ugereranyije n'amakosa; kanda ku gice kugira ngo werekane imirongo yacyo gusa, wongere ukande kugira ngo werekane byose. Imbonerahamwe itondeka amahamagara, ayarangiye, amakosa, n'igihe ugereranyije n'ntarengwa. Ivugururwa buri masegonda atanu, ibara gusa iki gikorwa cya seriveri, kandi yongera gutangirira kuri zeru iyo yongeye gutangizwa.
help-admin-problems-broken-cards-what-it: Itondeka amakarita nta kibaho gishobora kwerekana, kuko ikibaho, umurongo cyangwa urutonde birimo bitakiriho. Irimo ibibaho byose kuri seriveri, waba uri umunyamuryango cyangwa utari we.
help-admin-problems-broken-cards-how-it-: Buri murongo werekana umutwe w'ikarita, id yayo, imitwe y'ikibaho, umurongo n'urutonde bikiriho, ubwoko bwayo n'igihe yaremwe; umwanya w'ubusa ni cyo gice kibura. Andika igice cy'umutwe hanyuma ukande Enter kugira ngo ushakishe, kandi unyure mu paji ukoresheje buto za Ibanza na Ibikurikira. Iki gice gitondeka gusa amakarita: uyasane ukoresheje Sana amakarita yangiritse kuri Ibibazo / Incamake. Gufungura ikibaho na byo bisana amakarita yacyo.
help-admin-problems-files-what-it-is-des: Itondeka imigereka ibitswe kuri iyi seriveri, hamwe na buto zigenzura ibyo ububiko bw'amakuru buvuga kuri buri mugereka n'ishusho y'ukoresha ugereranyije n'ibiri koko mu bubiko. Igenzura ribona amadosiye abura, atavugwa cyangwa afite ikimenyetso kitari cyo, n'amateka ashobora kubisobanura.
help-admin-problems-files-how-it-works-d: Imbonerahamwe yerekana icyitegererezo, izina rya dosiye, ingano, ubwoko na id z'umugereka, ikibaho n'ikarita, hamwe n'agasanduku ko gushakisha. Check files and history, Check file types and extensions cyangwa Check missing and untracked files itangiza igenzura; Cancel check iraryihagarika. Nyuma yaho, soma imibare, uko byagenzuwe n'icyitegererezo cy'ibyabonetse, cyangwa ukoreshe Download status summary. Igenzura ntiryigera rihindura, ryimura cyangwa risiba dosiye cyangwa inyandiko.
help-admin-problems-rules-what-it-is-des: Itondeka amategeko yose yikora ari kuri seriveri hamwe n'ikibaho cyayo, ku buryo ubona ahantu hamwe ibyo WeKan ikora yonyine ku bibaho byose, nk'igihe ushakisha itegeko ryimura amakarita utabyiteze.
help-admin-problems-rules-how-it-works-d: Imbonerahamwe yerekana umutwe w'itegeko, ikibaho cyaryo, ubwoko bw'igikorwa cyaryo n'ubwoko bw'igikorwa cy'imbarutso yaryo, imirongo 10 kuri paji, itondekanyije ukurikije ikibaho. Andika igice cy'umutwe w'itegeko hanyuma ukande Enter kugira ngo ushakishe, kandi usibe ibyanditswe mu gasanduku ukande Enter kugira ngo wongere ubone byose. Iki gice ni icyo gusoma gusa: kugira ngo uhindure itegeko, fungura ikibaho cyaryo uriruhindurire mu mategeko y'icyo kibaho.
help-admin-problems-webhooks-what-it-is-: Imbonerahamwe ya webhooks zose ziri kuri seriveri, iza buri kibaho n'iza hose: ikibaho buri imwe ifitanye isano, uwayongeyeho n'aho yohereza. Bifasha mbere yo kuzimya webhooks, nyuma y'ikibazo, cyangwa igihe amakuru ajya ahantu nta wibuka ko yabitunganyije.
help-admin-problems-webhooks-how-it-work: Umurongo umwe kuri buri webhook, iya vuba mbere, werekana ikibaho, nyirayo, izina, aderesi, ubwoko, niba ifunguye cyangwa izimije, ibikorwa yohereza, niba token yashyizweho, n'igihe yongewe. Yungurura Webhooks zose, Ifunguye cyangwa Izimije, kandi ushakishe ukoresheje Enter. Token n'amagambobanga ntibyigera byerekanwa. Kanda ku mutwe w'ikibaho kugira ngo ufungure ikibaho uhindurireyo webhook yacyo, mu gihe webhooks za hose ziri mu Buyobozi / Igenamiterere / Webhooks za Hose.
help-admin-problems-boards-what-it-is-de: Itondeka ibibaho byose biri kuri seriveri n'ukugaragara kwabyo, abanyamuryango, ibigo n'amatsinda. Isubiza ibibaho biriho, ushobora kubona buri kimwe n'abakiriho, udafunguye buri kibaho.
help-admin-problems-boards-how-it-works-: Buri murongo werekana umutwe, id, uburenganzira, niba ikibaho cyabitswe, abanyamuryango bakora, n'ibigo n'amatsinda gisangiwe na byo. Andika igice cy'umutwe hanyuma ukande Enter kugira ngo ushakishe, cyangwa uhitemo Byose, Rusange, Abakoresha binjiye cyangwa Bwite munsi y'Uburenganzira; byombi byongera gutangirira kuri paji ya mbere. Nyura mu paji ukoresheje buto za Ibanza na Ibikurikira. Nta kintu gishobora guhindurwa hano.
help-admin-problems-cards-what-it-is-des: Itondeka amakarita yose ari kuri seriveri, aho iri n'abayiriho, ku bibaho byose waba uri umunyamuryango cyangwa utari we. Isubiza aho ikarita iri n'abanyamuryango bayo n'abahawe akazi abo ari bo, udafunguye ibibaho kimwe kimwe.
help-admin-problems-cards-how-it-works-d: Buri murongo werekana umutwe w'ikarita, ikibaho cyayo, umurongo n'urutonde, n'amazina y'abakoresha b'abanyamuryango bayo n'abahawe akazi. Andika igice cy'umutwe hanyuma ukande Enter kugira ngo ushakishe, byongera gutangirira kuri paji ya mbere, kandi unyure mu paji ukoresheje buto za Ibanza na Ibikurikira. Nta kintu gishobora guhindurwa hano.
help-admin-problems-recovery-what-it-is-: Aho urinda ububiko bw'amakuru kandi ukarangiza ibikorwa byahagaze hagati. Herekana amateka y'igenzura ry'ububiko bw'amakuru, kopi z'umutekano n'igarura, kandi hakwemerera guhitamo ibiba kuri imeyili zahagaze, amamenyesha, imeyili z'amategeko, ibikorwa byo guhuza intonde n'iyinjiza ry'ibibaho ryahagaritswe.
help-admin-problems-recovery-how-it-work: Uhereye hejuru ubona buto zo kugenzura amadosiye, hanyuma ibice nk'umurongo wa imeyili zitegereje koherezwa, amamenyesha y'ibikorwa ategereje, imeyili z'amategeko, ibikorwa byo guhuza intonde n'iyinjiza ryahagaritswe, buri kimwe gifite buto nka Hagarika by'akanya, Komeza, Ongera ugerageze, Reka cyangwa Gumana. Emeza igihe ubisabwe, kandi iyo igikorwa gihuze, kanda Vugurura wongere ugerageze. Imbonerahamwe iri hasi yandika ibijyanye n'igarura byose n'ibyemezo; erekana Byose, Byarangiye, Byanze cyangwa Byasibwe kandi ushakishe ukoresheje Enter.
help-admin-problems-offices-what-it-is-d: Ibara ukwinjira kwagenze neza ukurikije umuntu na aderesi, ku buryo ubona aho buri konti yinjirira n'aderesi konti nyinshi zisangiye. Aderesi isangiwe ishobora kuba ibiro, VPN cyangwa ihuza ry'umuyoboro risangiwe; ntigaragaza ko izo konti ari iz'umuntu umwe.
help-admin-problems-offices-how-it-works: Abantu batondekwa umwe umwe, buri wese n'umurongo kuri buri aderesi: IPv4, IPv6, ukwinjira kwa mbere n'ukwa nyuma, umubare w'ukwinjira, n'aho ari iyo proxy iri imbere ya WeKan ihatanga. Andika izina ry'ukoresha, izina ryuzuye, aderesi cyangwa aho ari hanyuma ukande Enter kugira ngo ushakishe, kandi unyure mu paji ukoresheje buto za Ibanza na Ibikurikira. Nta kintu kibuzwa kubera iyi raporo, ku buryo aderesi isangiwe itigera ifungira abantu hanze.
help-admin-problems-api-what-it-is-descr: Yerekana endpoints za REST API zikoreshwa, abazikoresha n'inshuro. Ibindi bice bivuga ibyagenze nabi; iki kivuga ibyo seriveri isabwa gukora. Kuri seriveri REST API idafunguyeho, kiguma ari ubusa.
help-admin-problems-api-how-it-works-des: Buri murongo ni konti na endpoint, ihuze cyane mbere: umubare w'amahamagara, igihe yahamagawe ubwa mbere n'ubwa nyuma, na aderesi za IPv4 na IPv6 za vuba n'aho ziri. Izina ry'ukoresha ry'ubusa risobanura amahamagara y'umuntu udafite konti, amenyekana ukurikije aderesi. Andika endpoint, method, izina ry'ukoresha cyangwa aderesi kugira ngo uyungurure uko wandika, kandi unyure mu mirongo 10 icyarimwe.
help-admin-problems-database-what-it-is-: Isobanura ibyo ububiko bw'amakuru bwavuze. Ikosa rivuye kuri MongoDB, SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB cyangwa SAP HANA ubusanzwe ryandikirwa abakoraporogaramu, bityo iki gice kivuga izina ry'ububiko bw'amakuru, gishyira ikibazo mu bwoko nka disiki, kwinjira, imyandikire cyangwa igihe cyarenze, kandi cyongeraho ibisobanuro byoroshye n'intambwe ikurikira.
help-admin-problems-database-how-it-work: Imirongo itondekwa iya vuba mbere. Ibisobanuro bivuga icyo ikibazo gisobanura n'icyo gukora, hanyuma ubutumwa bw'ububiko bw'amakuru ubwabwo, kandi izindi nkingi zerekana ububiko bw'amakuru, ubwoko, uburemere, igikorwa, nde n'aho yaturutse iyo bizwi, n'inshuro zingahe. Gushakisha biyungurura uko wandika, harimo n'amagambo y'ububiko bw'amakuru ubwabwo. Iyo cyakemuwe, emeza ko wakibonye cyangwa ugikureho kuri Ibibazo / Incamake.
help-admin-problems-integrity-what-it-is: Byerekana niba iyi seriveri yahagaze neza, icyayihagaritse, n'iba kopi y'umutekano ikomeza yaranze, hamwe na buto zo kugenzura amadosiye nk'izo muri Raporo ya dosiye. Reba hano nyuma y'ihagarara ritari ryitezwe.
help-admin-problems-integrity-how-it-wor: Umurongo wandikwa ku kongera gutangira nta guhagarara neza, nk'ukongera gutangira vuba iyo seriveri yagarutse mu minota itatu cyangwa nk'ihagarara ry'impanuka iyo yamaze igihe kirekire ihagaze, ku ikosa ritafashwe hamwe n'ubutumwa bwaryo, n'igihe kopi y'umutekano ikomeza yanze. Imirongo itondekwa iya vuba mbere, 10 kuri paji, kandi gushakisha biyungurura uko wandika. Buto zo kugenzura amadosiye ziri hejuru nta dosiye cyangwa inyandiko zihindura. Emeza ko wabibonye cyangwa ubikureho kuri Ibibazo / Incamake.
help-admin-cloud-what-it-is-description: Igice cy'Igicu ni paji y'ukoresha serivisi zo kwakira imbuga yo gucunga indangarubuga nyinshi za WeKan z'abakiriya ahantu hamwe: amatariki yazo, ububiko bw'amakuru, inyemezabuguzi, amatike y'ubufasha n'ikiganiro, inyandiko za DNS n'inzira za seriveri y'urubuga. Kiriho gusa iyo igenamiterere rya seriveri rigifunguye ku ndangarubuga yacyo, kandi abayobozi b'urubuga baho gusa, Cloud Admins, ni bo bakibona.
help-admin-cloud-how-it-works-descriptio: Ongeraho indangarubuga z'abakiriya hamwe n'amatariki yazo n'iba buri imwe ifite WeKan yayo n'ububiko bw'amakuru cyangwa isangira iyi, gerageza ihuza ry'ububiko bw'amakuru, kandi wandike inyemezabuguzi. Buri ndangarubuga ibona ikibaho cy'ubufasha cy'amatike n'ikiganiro. Genzura kandi uvugurure inyandiko za DNS, shyiramo inzira za seriveri y'urubuga, kandi utondeke aderesi zemewe kugira ngo ugabanye aho Cloud Admins bashobora kwinjirira. Abakiriya binjira kugira ngo babone indangarubuga yabo.
help-all-boards-what-it-is-description: Ibibaho byose ni paji itondeka ibibaho byawe. Menu y'ibumoso ihitamo ibibaho byerekanwa, nka Byashyizweho inyenyeri, Ibisigaye, Ahabanza, Inyandikorugero, Ububiko, ahantu h'akazi cyangwa ikigo cyangwa itsinda, kandi umurongo wo mu mutwe ufite gutondeka, gushakisha, gusohora no Guhitamo Byinshi.
help-all-boards-how-it-works-description: Kanda ku gice muri menu y'ibumoso hanyuma ku kibaho kugira ngo ugifungure. Koresha Tondeka ibibaho ku buryo bwo gukurura bwihariye cyangwa ukurikije umutwe, na menu y'imigaragarire kugira ngo uhindure hagati y'udushusho tw'ibibaho n'imbonerahamwe. Fungura Guhitamo Byinshi ushyireho akamenyetso ku bibaho kugira ngo ubishyire mu bubiko, ubikoporore, ubisohore cyangwa ugire kimwe ikibaho cyawe cy'Ahabanza, cyangwa ukurure ikibaho ku Bubiko.
help-workload-what-it-is-description: Umutwaro w'akazi n'ubushobozi byerekana, icyumweru ku kindi, uko buri muntu afite akazi kenshi ugereranyije n'amasaha afite, ku bibaho byose ukoraho. Byerekana ufite ibirenze, ushobora kwakira byinshi, n'ibyo umushinga uje ukeneye mbere y'uko hagira uvugwa izina.
help-workload-how-it-works-description: Hitamo icyumweru cya mbere, ibyumweru bingahe n'iba werekana amasaha cyangwa amanota y'inkuru, hanyuma ukande ku cyumweru kugira ngo ubone amakarita yacyo. Ibyumweru bifite akazi karenze amasaha ni umutuku. Gena igihe cyawe cy'akazi, ubumenyi n'ibihe utazaba uhari, abayobozi b'ikibaho bongeraho ibyagenwe n'imyanya y'inshingano, kandi abayobozi bongeraho iminsi mikuru rusange.
help-billing-what-it-is-description: Ingengo y'imari n'inyemezabuguzi ni ho abayobozi b'ikibaho bateganyiriza kandi bakishyuza akazi k'ikibaho: ingengo y'imari yacyo, ibyo akazi katwaye n'ibyo kazatwara, ibiciro by'isaha, amafaranga yakoreshejwe, amafaranga adahinduka, ibiciro byateganyijwe n'inyemezabuguzi, hashingiwe ku gihe cyakurikiranywe ku makarita.
help-billing-how-it-works-description: Hitamo ifaranga n'ibiciro by'isaha kuri buri munyamuryango n'igisanzwe cy'ikibaho, gena ingengo y'imari, kandi wongereho amafaranga yakoreshejwe n'amafaranga y'imirimo. Igihe cyanditswe ku makarita gihita cyerekanwa nk'icyakoreshejwe n'icyateganyijwe ugereranyije n'ingengo y'imari. Niba ubishaka, emeza igihe mbere yo kwandika inyemezabuguzi. Uzuza amakuru y'utanga inyemezabuguzi rimwe, hanyuma urema inyemezabuguzi z'igihe runaka, uzimanure, uzerekane ko zoherejwe kandi wandike ubwishyu, cyangwa urema igiciro giteganyijwe cy'akazi gasigaye.
gitea-not-configured: Nta bubiko bwa Gitea bwashyizweho. Shyiraho GITEA_APP_INI ku rupapuro rw'Igenamiterere.
gitea-not-local: Ntibiri kuri disiki y'imbere, bityo ntibyapimwe:
gitea-not-sqlite: Omi isoma gusa Gitea ikoresha SQLite. Iyi Gitea ikoresha:
gitea-read-only: Izi paji zisoma gusa ububiko bwa Gitea; nta kintu hano kibuhindura.
gitea-tree: Urutonde rwa tree -s rw'ububiko bwa Gitea, si ngombwa
gitea-delete: Siba uyu mukoresha cyangwa uyu muryango
gitea-dry-run: Nta kintu kirahinduka; ibi ni byo gusiba byakora.
gitea-delete-plan: Gusiba bikuraho iyi mirongo n'izi dosiye:
gitea-delete-confirm: Ibi bisiba burundu umukoresha cyangwa umuryango, ububiko bwawo n'amakuru yabwo yose mu bubiko bwa Gitea. Andika izina kugira ngo ukomeze:
gitea-delete-wrong-name: Izina wanditse si izina rya nyirabyo. Nta kintu cyasibwe.
gitea-running: Gitea irakora. Banza uyihagarike: Omi yandika gusa muri Gitea ihagaze.
gitea-backup-first: Banza ubike kopi: kopi ya github-to-gitea ya nyirabyo, kuva kuri GitHub ujya muri BACKUPS_DIR. Gusiba bikomeza gusa iyo kopi igenze neza.
gitea-no-backup: Nta kopi ya github-to-gitea ya nyirabyo iri muri BACKUPS_DIR.
gitea-job-done: Byarangiye hamwe na kode yo gusohoka
gitea-import-help: Yinjiza umuryango cyangwa umukoresha wa GitHub, cyangwa bimwe mu bubiko bwawo, mu bubiko bwa Gitea mu buryo butaziguye: git, ibibazo, ibisabwa byo gukurura, ibitekerezo, ibirango, intambwe, isohora n'imigereka. Gitea igomba kuba ihagaze. Ongera uyikoreshe kugira ngo uzane gusa ibishya cyangwa ibyahindutse.
gitea-github-token: Tokeni ya GitHub, ibikwa muri dosiye kandi ntigaragazwa na rimwe
gitea-token-rejected: GitHub ntiyemera tokeni: ni mbi, yarataye agaciro cyangwa yavanyweho. Bika indi nshya muri Igenamiterere.
gitea-job-stop-requested: Birahagarikwa: umurimo urahagarara mbere y'icyifuzo gikurikira kuri GitHub.
gitea-bad-name: Iryo si izina ryemewe rya nyirabyo cyangwa ry'ububiko.
gitea-doer: Umukoresha wa Gitea kwinjiza bikorwa mu izina rye
gitea-sync-exclude-file: urutonde rw'ububiko github-to-gitea na Omi bitagihuza
gitea-delete-repo-confirm: Ibi bisiba burundu ububiko, wiki yabwo n'amakuru yabwo yose mu bubiko bwa Gitea. Andika nyirabyo/izina kugira ngo ukomeze:
gitea-delete-repo-wrong-name: Izina wanditse si nyirabyo/izina ry'ububiko. Nta kintu cyasibwe.
gitea-exclude-too: Bukure no mu guhuza, kugira ngo guhuza gukurikira kutabugarura
gitea-packages-unlinked: Amapaki afitanye isano nabwo agumana na nyirabyo, adafitanye isano:
gitea-index-stale: Ntibigezweho kuva habayeho gusiba: ongera upime kugira ngo ubone ingano nyayo.
gitea-db-migration-version: Verisiyo y'iyimurwa ry'ububiko bw'amakuru bwa Gitea
gitea-orphans-delete-confirm: Ibi bisiba burundu mu bubiko bwa Gitea amadosiye y'impfubyi nta kintu na kimwe mu bubiko bw'amakuru gikoresha, n'imirongo y'ububiko bw'amakuru yabuze idosiye yayo. Ikintu cyose gikoreshwa igihe gisibwa kirabikwa. Andika umubare w'impfubyi kugira ngo ukomeze:
gitea-orphans-delete-wrong-number: Umubare wanditse si umubare w'impfubyi. Nta kintu cyasibwe.
